quests.description_chs: 为了消除风魔龙的威胁，你们需要消灭废墟中残留的力量。为此，你前往西风之鹰的庙宇，安柏正在庙宇门口等待你们。
quests.description_en: To stop Stormterror's siege, you must venture out and eliminate the elemental flows left within the ruined Temples of the Four Winds. Amber is waiting for you at the Temple of the Falcon.

quests.description_chs: 北风之狼的庙宇由骑士凯亚与你们一道探索。
quests.description_en: Kaeya will accompany you to explore the Temple of the Wolf.

quests.description_chs: 丽莎负责与你们共同扫查南风之狮的庙宇。
quests.description_en: Lisa is in charge of clearing the Temple of the Lion alongside you.

quests.description_chs: 一阶段结束后，与派蒙对话的隐藏任务$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: After completing the first stage, talk to Paimon for a hidden quest

quests.description_chs: 神带走了你唯一的血亲，而你也被神封印，陷入沉眠。醒来后你先是独自流浪，后来又与奇妙的伙伴「派蒙」相遇，开启了提瓦特大陆的探索之旅…
quests.description_en: The god took away your only kin, and you were sealed and cast into a deep slumber. Upon your awakening, you wandered alone for a time until you met a strange companion named Paimon, thus beginning your journey through the continent of Teyvat...

quests.description_chs: 从坠星山谷启程，你和派蒙走走看看，一路前行。
quests.description_en: You begin your journey in Starfell Valley, exploring the land and seeing its sights together with Paimon.

quests.description_chs: 在你们前进的道路上，出现了一座奇特的「七天神像」。在派蒙的建议下，你上前查看。
quests.description_en: As you advanced, a Statue of The Seven appeared on the horizon ahead of you. At Paimon's suggestion, you go to investigate.

quests.description_chs: 在前往蒙德城的路上，你们意外打搅了巨龙与神秘人的相会。在带着疑惑继续前行的你面前，一位轻盈的少女突然出现，挡住了你的去路。
quests.description_en: On the path to Mondstadt, you inadvertently eavesdropped on a meeting between a huge dragon and a mysterious figure. As you proceeded with various doubts in mind, a perky young girl showed up to block your path.

quests.description_chs: 令人意外的是，七天神像中的风元素之力竟与你产生了呼应。你们决定，先从提瓦特七神中的风神开始调查，于是，你们的第一步，便是前往风神护佑之地：蒙德城。
quests.description_en: Unexpectedly, the power of Anemo within the Statue of The Seven resonated with you. You decided to begin your investigation with the Anemo Archon of Teyvat's Seven Archons. As such, the first order of the day is to reach the land under the Anemo Archon's protection: Mondstadt.

quests.description_chs: 有了你们的帮助，麻烦很快解决。在安柏的带领下，你们来到了自由城邦——蒙德。
quests.description_en: With your help, the problem was resolved quickly. Led by Amber, you reach the city of freedom — Mondstadt.

quests.description_chs: 本该宁静祥和的蒙德城中，巨龙突然来袭。它正是安柏提到的风魔龙，亦是你们先前在林中遇见的巨兽。
quests.description_en: The usually peaceful Mondstadt was suddenly assailed by a dragon. This is the Stormterror that Amber spoke of, and was the gigantic creature that you encountered in the forest earlier.

quests.description_chs: 你们艰难击退了来袭的风魔龙。来自西风骑士团的凯亚目睹了这一过程，此后，你们受邀前往骑士团总部一叙。
quests.description_en: You repelled Stormterror with some difficulty. Kaeya of the Knights of Favonius witnessed the battle, and you were invited to make a trip to the Knights headquarters.

quests.description_chs: 隐藏任务，控制蒙德城的天气和三地城的光线特效$HIDDEN
少女名为安柏，身为侦察骑士的她提出护送你们前往蒙德。但是在那之前，她得先解决城外四处游荡的丘丘人，这是她此次出城的任务。
quests.description_en: The girl's name is Amber, and her duty as an Outrider is to escort you to Mondstadt. However, she has another task to attend to first, which is to clean out the hilichurls that have been wandering around outside the city.

quests.title_chs: (test)控制第一幕开始的隐藏任务$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 在你们的努力下，蒙德的元素流动终于回归了正常，是时候回到蒙德，向琴回报你们的进展了。
quests.description_en: Thanks to your efforts, Mondstadt's elemental flow has returned to normal. It's time to report back to Jean.

quests.description_chs: 你们回到蒙德城，偶然遇到了琴与「愚人众」的冲突。此后你向琴展示了在森林中发现的风龙泪滴，在琴的请求下，你又一次参与到了对风魔龙特瓦林的调查之中。
quests.description_en: Returning to Mondstadt, you encountered a clash between Jean and the Fatui. Afterward, you showed Jean the dragon tear that you found in the forest, and at her request, once again joined the investigation into Stormterror Dvalin.

quests.description_chs: 正准备出发调查的你们，在骑士团总部的门外，见到了跟风魔龙对话的神秘家伙。
quests.description_en: As you were heading out to investigate, you happened upon the mysterious guy that you saw talking to the dragon.

quests.description_chs: 这位神秘人自称吟游诗人温迪，你还没等到温迪解释清与巨龙的联系，他便自顾自离开了。追着他的脚步，你们来到了风起地的巨树下。
quests.description_en: The mysterious fellow claimed to be a bard named Venti, but left on his own accord before you could get him to explain his relationship with the dragon. You follow him to the giant tree at Windrise.

quests.description_chs: 终于停下脚步的温迪向你解释，他在低语森林中与特瓦林相见时，本想为它清除诅咒，却没能成功。现在，如果想要让特瓦林恢复本心，不得不依赖「天空之琴」的力量。
quests.description_en: Stopped at last, Venti explained that he had tried and failed to cleanse Dvalin's curse during their previous meeting. Now, he has been forced to rely on the Holy Lyre der Himmel's power if he is to restore Dvalin.

quests.description_chs: 温迪准备用花言巧语将天空之琴骗到手的计划毫不意外的失败了，于是温迪想了个新计划，这个新计划看来需要你的帮助。
quests.description_en: Venti's plan to sweet talk his way into getting the Holy Lyre back backfires. He's come up with a new plan, but seems he'll need your help for it to work.

quests.description_chs: 你几乎完美地执行了温迪的计划，眼看天空之琴即将到手，一个陌生人突然出现拿走了天空之琴。而你们的动静也惊动了守卫，一行人只得仓皇逃出大教堂。
quests.description_en: Venti's plan to steal the Holy Lyre went off without a hitch. Well, almost — when the Lyre was almost in your hands, a stranger stole it from under your noses. Your movements alerted the guards, forcing you to flee the Cathedral.

quests.description_chs: 从大教堂中逃出的你们慌不择路的逃进了迪卢克的酒馆，但是迪卢克意外的决定庇护并帮助你。于是，在迪卢克的引荐下，你们在打烊后的酒馆遇到了意想不到的人。
quests.description_en: In your haste fleeing from the confusion, you found yourself in Diluc's tavern, where — to your surprise — he decided to help hide you. Diluc agrees to meet back at the tavern after nightfall with his "contacts" — who could they be?

quests.title_en: State of the Holy Lyre der Himmel
quests.description_chs: 你们历经战斗，终于从愚人众的手中取回了失窃的天空之琴。不知道为什么，温迪对天空之琴表现得甚为怀念。
quests.description_en: After a fierce battle, you managed to seize the Holy Lyre der Himmel back from the hands of the Fatui. For some reason, Venti seems to express a great nostalgia for the Lyre...

quests.description_chs: 天空之琴的状态已经不如以往，但是通过风龙泪滴，你们成功地将风元素注入到天空之琴中。为了让天空之琴进一步恢复力量，你们需要更多的风龙泪滴。
quests.description_en: The Holy Lyre is in poor condition, but you manage to restore some of its Anemo power by using Dvalin's tears. To restore its full power, you will need to look for more tears.

quests.description_chs: 特瓦林的足迹遍布蒙德，其中一颗泪滴掉落在林中废墟。
quests.description_en: Dvalin's footprints are all over Mondstadt, and one of his tears fell upon a ruin deep within the forest.

quests.description_chs: 被污染的风龙泪滴甚至吸引了丘丘人，你不得不向丘丘人讨回泪滴。
quests.description_en: The corrupted dragon tear has even attracted hilichurls. You must get it back from them.

quests.description_chs: 泪滴收集完毕，你们一行人再度汇合。
quests.description_en: After completing the retrieval of the tears, you meet up with the rest of the group.

quests.description_chs: 借助风龙泪滴的力量，天空之琴完全恢复了力量。净化风魔龙的准备已经完成。
quests.description_en: Dvalin's tears restored the Holy Lyre back to its full power. Now, you are finally ready to purify Stormterror.

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会会介绍给你蒙德周边的冒险情报。情报都是公开免费的哦~$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: The Adventurers' Guild can give you Adventure Reports on the area surrounding Mondstadt. All reports are free!

quests.description_chs: 你们来到风龙废墟，再次试图拯救特瓦林，而风魔龙的住所正被暴风的障壁包围着。但幕后黑手无意让你们就这么轻松地突破风障。
quests.description_en: You came to Stormterror's Lair to once again attempt Dvalin's rescue. However, it is surrounded by wind barriers made by Stormterror, and the dark forces at work have no intention of letting you break through those barriers so easily.

quests.description_chs: 敌人来袭，你们意识到这一路上不会轻松。进入风龙废墟的道路上充满了障碍，你们不得不小心观察，从残垣断壁中寻找道路。
quests.description_en: Assailed by many enemies, you realize that this road will not be an easy one. The way into Stormterror's Lair is strewn with obstacles, and so you must proceed with caution to find a path along the ruined walls.

quests.description_chs: 风龙废墟的入口就在眼前，光之封印阻挡了你进入废墟深处。为了解除封印，你再次面临考验。
quests.description_en: The entrance to Stormterror's Lair is just ahead, but the light seals bar the way in. You must once again face a trial in order to break those seals.

quests.description_chs: 三层封印一一被你解除，决战的道路已经打开。为了终结这一切，你们回到了废墟入口。
quests.description_en: The three light seals have each been broken by you in their turn, and the path to the decisive showdown is open. You once again return to the lair's entrance to put an end to things.

quests.description_chs: 追逐着被深渊法师蛊惑的特瓦林，你们即将迎来与它的正面对决。
quests.description_en: After a long and daring pursuit of Dvalin, who has been led astray by the Abyss Mages, you are about to finally confront him once and for all.

quests.description_chs: 听安柏说，琴团长正在大教堂等你，似乎与天空之琴事件的收尾事宜有关…
quests.description_en: Amber says that Jean is waiting for you at the Cathedral. Apparently, it's something to do with the Holy Lyre der Himmel...

quests.description_chs: 你们用天空之琴唤来了风魔龙，却在深渊教团的阻挠下，没能成功挽回它的心意。但你们并没有放弃，迪卢克很快得到了新的线索…
quests.description_en: You used the Holy Lyre der Himmel to summon Stormterror, only to be prevented from saving it due to the interference of the Abyss Order. But you haven't given up yet — and Diluc has been able to swiftly obtain a new lead...

quests.description_chs: 在你们的努力下，特瓦林终于被解救。风带来的故事，是否就此随之落幕了呢？
quests.description_en: You finally managed to save Dvalin. Is this where the story of the wind ends?

quests.description_chs: (test)拆qq人营地奖励$HIDDEN

quests.title_chs: (test)任务结束后与温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)任务结束后与温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN
自称蛐蛐裁判的神秘路人兴致勃勃的邀请你玩据说在璃月广受欢迎的游戏…$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: A mysterious man calling himself the Cricket Referee excitedly invites you to play a game popular with the masses in Liyue.

quests.description_chs: 在果酒湖畔，困惑的女性向你表达了她的烦恼。$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: At Cider Lake, a woman explained her troubles to you.

quests.description_chs: 热情的史莱姆饲养师邀请你来跟史莱姆一起玩。$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: An enthusiastic slime breeder invites you to play with them.

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述$UNRELEASED
据利文斯通博士说，<color=#00E1FFFF>达达乌帕谷</color>的剑冢周围一共有三个丘丘人部落，分别是北方的「好肉族」、南方的「好睡族」和东边谷地中的「黑日族」。解开剑冢封印的线索，也许就在这些丘丘人部落里…
quests.description_en: According to Dr. Livingstone, there are three hilichurl tribes surrounding the Sword Cemetery in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>. To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe. The key to breaking the seals on the Sword Cemetery may lie within their encampments...

quests.description_chs: 黑日族的元素机关位于中心破败祭坛的中心，由暴徒、萨满、法师守护着，想办法分头击破可能是个好办法。
quests.description_en: The Eclipse tribe's Elemental Monument stands at the center of their dilapidated altar. It is being defended by samachurls, mitachurls and Abyss Mages, so it might be best to find a way to pick them off.

quests.description_chs: 好睡族的元素机关位于中心的大树下，由暴徒和一众丘丘人守护着，击败暴徒便可解除元素机关封印，据说他们晚上睡得特别早，到时候动手偷偷击杀暴徒是个好办法哦。
quests.description_en: The Sleeper tribe's power lies beneath a large tree, defended by mitachurls and a heap of hilichurls. Defeating mitachurls will break the seal on the Elemental Monument. It is said that mitachurls sleep early, so surprising them at night might be a good idea.

quests.description_chs: 好肉族崇尚力量，只要去完成他们大擂台上的好肉族封印挑战即可解锁他们的屏障了。
quests.description_en: The Meaty tribe worships power. Challenge them in the arena to break the seal.

quests.description_chs: 小精灵被附近的丘丘人抓走了，生命树非常伤心。如果能把他们找回来，也许生命树会响应我们的祈祷呢。
quests.description_en: The fairies were kidnapped by nearby hilichurls, devastating the Tree of Life. If we manage to save the fairies, perhaps the Tree of Life will respond to our prayers.

quests.description_chs: 原来那本书不是指南，而是童话…这之后你在蒙德野外接受了第一场考试，第二场考试则是在蒙德城。为此，安柏正在城内等你。
quests.description_en: As it turned out, the book Amber gave you wasn't a manual, but a fairy tale... After completing the first test out in the wild, you learn that the second test is to take place within the city of Mondstadt itself. Amber is waiting for you there.

quests.description_chs: 掉下去，吹起来$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: Set the Fallen Afloat

quests.description_chs: 你与派蒙决定探访蒙德的人烟稀少之地，奔狼领，全然不知这片生态原始的领域中潜藏着怎样的危险。
quests.description_en: You and Paimon decide to pay a visit to Wolvendom, a place in Mondstadt that few people pass through, without any knowledge of the dangers that may await you within this primordial territory.

quests.description_chs: 奔狼领中的巨大史莱姆袭击了你们，在你力气快要耗尽的时候，名叫雷泽的少年帮助了你们。以狼群为家人的雷泽提到了一个「红色、很烫的女孩子」，关于这个女孩的身份，你们似乎有了猜想。
quests.description_en: On your last legs from being attacked by an enormous slime, you were rescued by a young man named Razor. Razor, who calls a wolf pack family, mentioned a "red one, burny girl." You have your guesses as to who that is...

quests.description_chs: 那个「红色、很烫的女孩子」好像并不是你们以为的安柏，但从安柏口中，你们听说了「醉汉峡」的狼群袭击事件。狼群、少年、袭击…事情变得复杂了起来，你们决定仔细调查一番。
quests.description_en: It seems that the "red, burny girl" was not Amber, as you had thought. But you receive news from Amber about wolf pack attacks in Drunkard Gorge. The wolf pack, the boy, the attacks... things are getting more complicated. This calls for a thorough investigation.

quests.title_chs: 卢皮卡，即是命运的选择
quests.description_chs: 再次被线索领到了奔狼领。这枚钩钩果种子是否真的就是铁证，雷泽和他的狼群是否就是袭击的罪魁祸首？  然而，钩钩果其实还有另外的意义…
quests.description_en: You are yet again led to Wolvendom. Are these Wolfhook seeds solid evidence? Are Razor and his wolf pack really behind the attack? Or are the Wolfhooks indicative of something else?

quests.description_chs: 在骑士团总部，你们遇到了龙灾时结识的骑士，凯亚。
quests.description_en: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.

quests.description_chs: 据凯亚说，他的海盗爷爷留下一处「剑」之宝藏，埋藏于「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」。为了抢在窃贼之前将宝藏保护起来，你们四处打听，努力收集有关「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」的情报。
quests.description_en: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.

quests.description_chs: 你们绞尽脑汁，终于解开了情报中的谜题。「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」近在眼前！
quests.description_en: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!

quests.description_chs: 最近的蒙德城中，似乎流传着有关「暗夜英雄」的传闻…
quests.description_en: Recently, rumors about a certain Darknight Hero have been circulating around Mondstadt...

quests.description_chs: 经过多方打听，「暗夜英雄」的身份似乎正要浮出水面。但就在此时，你们竟恰好遇到了「暗夜英雄」。而他的真实身份即是——「晨曦酒庄」的老板迪卢克。并且，这位暗中守护蒙德的英雄似乎早已引起了骑士团的注意…
quests.description_en: Your inquiries were slowly bringing the Darknight Hero's identity to light, but just then, you met the man himself. His true identity is Diluc, owner of the Dawn Winery — and his actions have long since attracted the attention of the Knights of Favonius...

quests.title_chs: 暗夜英雄的不在场证明
quests.description_chs: 骑士团的霍夫曼告诉你们，深渊教团正欲对「暗夜英雄」不利，为防变故，骑士团决定对「暗夜英雄」进行监视。得知消息的你们，与迪卢克商量出了破解之法，你们做足了准备，只待深渊教团与骑士团双双动手。
quests.description_en: Knight Huffman has informed you that the Abyss Order is plotting against the Darknight Hero. As a precaution, the Knights have decided to monitor the Darknight Hero's actions. You shared this information with Diluc and discussed countermeasures. Having made your preparations, you now lie in wait for both the Knights and the Abyss Order to act.

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城外，冒险家琳小姐似乎正在准备进行烹饪…
quests.description_en: On the outskirts of the city of Mondstadt, the adventurer Lynn is currently preparing to make a meal...

quests.description_chs: 野猪们不断袭击着葡萄园，特纳先生正在犯愁…
quests.description_en: Boars keep attacking the vineyards, and Tunner is getting anxious...

quests.description_chs: 派蒙提议你去七天神像那里看看。
quests.description_en: Paimon suggests you go to a Statue of The Seven.

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城中漫步时，派蒙被一股食物的香气所吸引…
quests.description_en: As you walk through Mondstadt, Paimon is attracted by the aroma of food...

quests.description_chs: 安柏专门为你准备了一场考试，在那之前，她还给了你一本「飞行指南」，要你考试前通读一遍。
quests.description_en: Amber has specially prepared a gliding exam for you. She has also provided a gliding manual, which she has asked you to read before taking the exam.

quests.description_chs: 安柏想要与你讨论关于使用风之翼的问题…
quests.description_en: Amber wishes to discuss the matter of how you've been using your wind glider...

quests.description_chs: 飞行轰炸玩法$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: Gliding Bombardment Minigame

quests.description_chs: 考试途中骑士奥特错将你当成文物盗贼「怪鸟」的同伙拦下。你们向他澄清误会后，自告奋勇帮忙缉捕「怪鸟」。一场追踪开始了。
quests.description_en: During the exam, you were mistaken for the thief Raptor by Otto, a Knight of Favonius, and were stopped. After clearing the misunderstanding, you volunteer to help arrest Raptor — and so begins the chase.

quests.description_chs: 循着踪迹，你们一路追至「怪鸟藏身地」。为了将他抓捕归案，你们毫不犹豫向深处挺进。
quests.description_en: During your pursuit, you track Raptor to his hideout. You plunge into its depths without hesitation. Time to bring this criminal to justice.

quests.description_chs: 「猎鹿人」餐馆的莎拉小姐，似乎有事要拜托骑士团…
quests.description_en: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...

quests.title_chs: 委托人玛格丽特的思念
quests.description_chs: 琴因为过劳而病倒，你们被拜托分担琴的工作，协助处理城内居民的委托。玛格丽特走丢的猫「小王子」究竟跑到哪里去了呢？
quests.description_en: While Jean is ill from overwork, you've been tasked with handling some citizens' commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret's pet cat Prince run off to this time?

quests.description_chs: 不知查尔斯拿到他要的税收报表了吗？
quests.description_en: Has Charles managed to get hold of the tax forms he needs?

quests.description_chs: 莎拉小姐还在因为食材未送到的事而焦急…
quests.description_en: Sara's delivery of ingredients still hasn't arrived, and she's growing more anxious by the minute...

quests.description_chs: 解决了城内居民的委托后，你们决定再到教堂探望琴的情况…
quests.description_en: Today's commissions are done and dusted. Time to check up on Jean at the Cathedral.

quests.description_chs: 离开酒馆酒保出现$HIDDEN
风花节期间，本该轻松快乐的蒙德城却有些反常…
quests.description_en: The Windblume Festival should be a joyous affair, but not all is as it seems in Mondstadt...

quests.description_chs: 一切结束得过于突然，你来不及犹豫就与众人一同投身到战斗中…
quests.description_en: Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else...

quests.description_chs: 遵循「理」的准则，人们学得知识，懂得界限，习得敬畏。这一思维是安全的边界，也是疯狂者的束缚。
quests.description_en: Following the principles of "truth," people gain knowledge, learn of boundaries, and nurture reverence. This mindset provides a safe borderline — while also shackling the mad.

在璃月之地的海边，有一座伫立于坚岩的城市，「璃月港」。庇护着这座城市与璃月全境的，是你所要寻找的岩之神摩拉克斯，又名「岩王帝君」。你抵达璃月港时，恰逢一年一度的「七星请仙典仪」。每年的这一日里，岩王帝君都会赐下神谕，指引这一年璃月经营的方向。
quests.description_en: In the land of Liyue by the sea, a city sits atop the solid bedrock. That city is Liyue Harbor, and it has flourished under the protection of its guardian Morax — also known as "Rex Lapis," the Geo Archon you have been looking for. You could not have arrived at a more fortuitous time, as the annual "Rite of Descension" has just begun. Every year on this day, Rex Lapis graces this land with his prophecy, giving guidance on the economic path Liyue should follow in the coming year.

quests.description_chs: 绝对领域控制$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: Absolute Territorial Domination

quests.description_chs: 典仪吉时，仙驾如约而至。然而当云散霞收，落在香案上打翻了供品的，却是毫无生气的神躯。全场陷入迷茫与混乱，七星下令搜捕刺客。你难以洗清嫌疑，不得不在逃离过程中接受了愚人众执行官「公子」的帮助，按照他的指引，前往仙人隐居的「绝云间」…
quests.description_en: During the rite, the appointed moment arrived. Yet when the clouds parted, a divine carcass crashed down to earth, knocking all the offerings over. Amid the chaos and confusion, the Qixing ordered that the assassin be arrested. Unable to prove your innocence, you were forced to accept the help of Childe of the Fatui, and as suggested by him, you are now headed for Jueyun Karst, a hidden abode where the adepti dwell...

quests.description_chs: 你在绝云间遇仙，仙人「削月筑阳真君」见信物出手，从千岩军手中保护了你。当「削月筑阳真君」得知神明死讯，又了解到你的冤情之后，它认为七星的表现令人失望，甚至推断七星可能正是幕后黑手，暗害了神明，以图执掌璃月大局。在它的授意下，你前去寻访各位隐居的仙人，转达口信。
quests.description_en: You came across an adeptus, "Moon Carver." Seeing the keepsake you bore, he lent you his aid and protected you from the Millelith soldiers pursuing you. Upon learning of Rex Lapis' passing and the unjust accusations laid against you, Moon Carver expressed disdain for the Qixing's actions and began to suspect that they were behind what happened. He has sent you to find several other adepti and deliver a message to them.

quests.description_chs: (test)表现控制逻辑$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: Appearance control logic

quests.description_chs: (test)海灯节活动完成记录$HIDDEN
(test)海灯节遇到魈的标记$HIDDEN
(test)守卫岩神尸体$HIDDEN
遵循着「削月筑阳真君」的指点，你们来到了「琥牢山」，想要面见「理水叠山真君」。
quests.description_en: Following the instructions of Moon Carver, you arrive at Mt. Hulao in order to meet with Mountain Shaper.

quests.description_chs: 遵循着「削月筑阳真君」的指点，你们来到了「奥藏山」，想要面见「留云借风真君」。
quests.description_en: Following Moon Carver's instructions, you arrive at Mt. Aocang in order to seek out Cloud Retainer.

quests.description_chs: 访仙归来之后，你得知岩神的仙体被「璃月七星」藏匿。「公子」答应为你寻找破局之人，为此，你再次前往「北国银行」…
quests.description_en: Upon your return from visiting the Adepti, you discover that the Qixing have hidden the Geo Archon's vessel away. Childe promised he'd find someone to break the stalemate, so you pay another visit to Northland Bank.

quests.description_chs: 「公子」为你介绍的人是「往生堂」的客卿，钟离。为了达成重见岩神的目标，你答应与他一起筹办「送仙典仪」。
quests.description_en: Childe introduced you to Zhongli, a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You agree to help Zhongli organize the Rite of Parting in the hope of seeing the Geo Archon again.

quests.description_chs: 钟离不关心谋杀神明的奇案，只关心璃月的传统：辞行久远之躯。挑完仪式所用的夜泊石后，你们又开始准备祭神用的香膏。
quests.description_en: Zhongli isn't concerned with the deicide itself, but with upholding Liyue's sacred traditions by giving a proper farewell to an archaic lord. Having selected a suitable batch of Noctilucous Jade, your next task is to prepare some perfumes as an offering to the Geo Archon.

quests.description_chs: 未曾想到的是，萍姥姥竟是一位仙人。离开她隐居的「壶中洞天」之后，你们前往吃虎岩的市井，继续办事。
quests.description_en: Who would have guessed — Madame Ping is an adeptus! After leaving her household, which turned out to be a realm within a teapot, you proceed to Chihu Rock to continue preparations.

quests.description_chs: 挑选出岩王帝君最中意的香膏之后，钟离拜托你去玉京台找一位朋友，萍姥姥，向她借取「涤尘铃」。奇怪的是，钟离似乎想对那位朋友避而不见…
quests.description_en: After identifying Rex Lapis' preferred scent, Zhongli sends you to Yujing Terrace to seek out an old friend of his, Madame Ping, and borrow a certain Cleansing Bell. Strange... Zhongli seems to be avoiding his old friend...

quests.description_chs: 为取「永生香」，你来到了璃月港最有名的药庐「不卜庐」。但这一次的行程，似乎也没有那么简单…
quests.description_en: You came to renowned purveyor of Liyue herbal medicine, Bubu Pharmacy, to procure some Everlasting Incense. But what started out as a straightforward trip to the pharmacy has turned into a far more complicated affair...

quests.description_chs: 「不卜庐」的事件错综复杂，令人感慨（或者也没有那么感慨）。解决之后，钟离为表感谢，决定请客…？！
quests.description_en: That Bubu Pharmacy trip turned into quite an exhilarating ride. (Okay, maybe not that exhilarating.) In yet another remarkable twist, Zhongli has offered to treat you to dinner!

quests.description_chs: NPC调查对话$HIDDEN
寻访完诸位仙人、完成了削月筑阳真君的嘱托之后，你重新回到璃月港内，寻找「公子」。而从后者那里，你听说了一个消息：对于神祇之死，「璃月七星」的反应十分耐人寻味…
quests.description_en: Having sought out the adepti and completed the task Moon Carver entrusted to you, you return again to Liyue Harbor to look for Childe. He tells you that the Liyue Qixing's response to the archon's passing has given him some food for thought...

quests.description_chs: 因在意层岩巨渊最下方的情况而与派蒙一同前去调查，谁知，竟在那里遇见了意料之外的人…
quests.description_en: Concerned about the situation down in The Chasm, you and Paimon decide to go investigate the area, only to run into someone altogether unexpected there...

quests.description_chs: 在港口老窖「三碗不过港」，神秘使者甘雨现身，自称受凝光之托，请你前往天上的宫殿「群玉阁」一叙。为此，你与派蒙来到了能够遥望群玉阁的天衡山间。
quests.description_en: The mysterious emissary Ganyu appeared before you at Third-Round Knockout. Claiming to have come at Ningguang's behest, she invited you to the skyfaring palace known as the Jade Chamber. To that end, you and Paimon have come to Mt. Tianheng, from where you can see the Jade Chamber in the distance.

quests.description_chs: 未曾想到，你在天衡山归终机附近，遇到了同为七星之一的刻晴。她指点了你登上群玉阁的真正方法。从刻晴的话里，派蒙捕捉到了「见面礼」这个关键词…
quests.description_en: After arriving at the Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng, you are surprised to meet another member of the Qixing there. Her name is Keqing, and she gives you detailed instructions on how to ascend to the Jade Chamber. Paimon, however, is preoccupied with another detail that Keqing mentioned: the custom of bringing a greeting gift.

quests.description_chs: 终于登上群玉阁时，凝光正在那里等待你。她收下了派蒙的礼物，并以另一件礼物回报。你与凝光聊了许多，话题有神灵，有「魔神」，还有愚人众…
quests.description_en: You finally ascended to the Jade Chamber, where Ningguang was waiting for you. She graciously accepted Paimon's gift, and offered one in return. You spoke at length about many things: deities, archons... and the Fatui...

quests.description_chs: 随凝光所指，确认了愚人众关于「百无禁忌箓」的阴谋之后，你继续与钟离一起筹办典仪，在荻花洲再次遇见了甘雨。在那之后，你们返回璃月港，却发现似乎有大事发生。
quests.description_en: At Ningguang's advice, you verified the Fatui's schemes regarding the Sigil of Permission before continuing to help Zhongli prepare for the rite. You met Ganyu once again at Dihua Marsh before returning to Liyue Harbor — only to find that things in the city seem to be spiraling out of control.

quests.description_chs: 仙人与七星在城外对峙，山雨欲来之际，你前往黄金屋阻止「公子」夺取神之心，却又发生了变故。神之心似乎并不在黄金屋，而「公子」为逼岩神现身，用「百无禁忌箓」召唤出了远古的魔神。
quests.description_en: The adepti faced off against the Qixing outside the city. Just as things were coming to a head, you went to the Golden House to intercept Childe as he attempted to seize the Gnosis, only to find yet another twist: The Gnosis was never at the Golden House to begin with. Childe swiftly switched to his backup plan, attempting to force the Geo Archon to make an appearance by summoning an ancient god with Fatui-forged Sigils of Permission...

quests.description_chs: 一番激战与牺牲，魔神重被镇压。尘埃落定之后，你在璃月的旅途也将随着「送仙典仪」的召开而接近终结了。但在这之前，还有一些与岩神有关的谜团等待你去揭开。
quests.description_en: The ancient god was subdued once again following a fierce battle and much sacrifice. The dust settles, and your journey in Liyue is reaching its conclusion with the Rite of Parting. But before that, there are still some mysteries regarding the Geo Archon that need unraveling.

quests.description_chs: 寻人启事$HIDDEN
活动开启间隔内NPC闲置对话$HIDDEN
层岩巨渊底层的地面突然崩裂，在场众人无一例外跌入其中。地底下竟有一处不知名的空间，为了离开此地，众人齐心协力展开调查…
quests.description_en: The ground at the bottom of The Chasm suddenly collapsed, causing everyone to fall in. As it turns out, there is an unknown space further below, and everyone works together to investigate...

quests.description_chs: 为了逃离地底，众人养精蓄锐，休息过后试图再探出路…
quests.description_en: In order to escape from underground, the party keeps searching for a way out after getting some rest...

quests.description_chs: 与魈成功会合后，众人怀着担忧，就地下种种怪事展开讨论…
quests.description_en: After rendezvousing with Xiao, you and the others go over the curious and unsettling things you have seen underground...

quests.description_chs: 所有人齐心协力，终于在千钧一发之际逃离地底，重见天日…
quests.description_en: You and the others make a valiant joint effort and finally manage to escape from the underground at the very last minute...

quests.description_chs: 活动开启间隔内NPC闲置对话$HIDDEN
普斯帕咖啡馆内的玛达赫，正苦恼于没有新的故事可讲…
quests.description_en: Maddah, who is at the Puspa Café, is currently fretting over not having any new tales to tell...

quests.description_chs: 卡里米的富翁哈特姆似乎在为某件事情发愁…
quests.description_en: Hatim, a rich fellow from Kalimi, seemed to be bothered by something...

quests.description_chs: 一位来自稻妻的「远国御用」正在勤奋工作…
quests.description_en: A foreign attaché from Inazuma is hard at work...

quests.description_chs: 哈特姆的期货交易日已经到了，不知道他的收获如何呢？
quests.description_en: The day for Hatim to conduct some futures trading has arrived. What will he get from this trade?

quests.description_chs: 弄蛇人古拉布吉尔似乎遇到了点麻烦…
quests.description_en: Snake Handler Gulabgir seems to be in trouble...

quests.description_chs: 哈特姆的期货交易日已经到了，不知道他的收获如何呢？
quests.description_en: The day for Hatim to conduct some futures trading has arrived. What will he get from this trade?

quests.description_chs: 「健康之家」的戈尔珊小姐正在为医院内的卫生状况发愁…
quests.description_en: Golshan of Bimarstan is worrying about the sanitation conditions in the hospital...

quests.description_chs: 须弥城的阿金，似乎对平时常用的泥土材料产生了一些新的想法…
quests.description_en: Akim of Sumeru City seems to be having some new ideas regarding commonly used soils...

quests.description_chs: 经过不断尝试与研究，阿金似乎终于收获了新的进展…
quests.description_en: After constant research and testing, Akim has finally made some progress...

quests.description_chs: 阿金似乎正在为某事而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Akim seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 热爱美食的学者贾法尔今天也在研究「吃」…
quests.description_en: The foodie researcher Jafar is still studying "eating" today...

quests.description_chs: 在须弥城里，你看见了一个熟悉的身影…
quests.description_en: You see a familiar face in Sumeru City...

quests.description_chs: 莎莉似乎正在因为她的猫而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Sareh seems to be concerned about her cats...

quests.title_chs: 加尔恰的赞歌·关键物品
quests.description_chs: 加尔恰和路通似乎正在因为某事而犯愁…
quests.description_en: Garcia and Lutong seem to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 加尔恰似乎又遇见了什么难题…
quests.description_en: Garcia seems to have run into trouble again...

quests.title_chs: 加尔恰的赞歌·轴承在上
quests.description_chs: 加尔恰似乎正在和阿汉格尔争论某事…
quests.description_en: Looks like Garcia and Ahangar are arguing about something...

quests.title_chs: 加尔恰的赞歌·某人的回响
quests.title_en: Garcia's Paean: The Echo of Someone
quests.description_chs: 在加尔恰身边，似乎多了一个人…
quests.description_en: There seems to be someone new by Garcia's side...

quests.description_chs: 「健康之家」的扎卡里亚正在为他的病人们煞费苦心…
quests.description_en: Zakariya of Bimarstan is taking great pains to help his patients.

quests.description_chs: 拉菲克正因为船只设计问题而苦恼…
quests.description_en: Rafiq seems to be quite disturbed by some design issues with his ship...

quests.description_chs: 拉菲克的设计进入了最后的冲刺阶段…
quests.description_en: Rafiq's design has entered its final stretch...

quests.description_chs: 终于，拉菲克的设计来到了检验的阶段…
quests.description_en: At last, Rafiq's design has entered its testing phase...

quests.description_chs: 拉菲克由之前的测试总结出了一些经验…
quests.description_en: Rafiq has learned some lessons from his previous tests...

quests.description_chs: 瓦尔坦与古尔根的须弥蔷薇似乎快要绽放了…
quests.description_en: Vardan and Gurgen's Sumeru Rose seems to be blooming...

quests.description_chs: 一名想要「测量世界」的学者，似乎遇到了研究的瓶颈…
quests.description_en: A researcher who wants to measure the world seems to have run into a bottleneck...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城冒险家协会的凯瑟琳小姐似乎有什么事想要告诉你…
quests.description_en: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.

quests.description_chs: 在踏上下一段旅程之前，先和派蒙整理一下思绪与心情吧…
quests.description_en: You share your feelings with Paimon before embarking on the next phase of your journey.

quests.description_chs: 在了解了参赛者的状况之后，你预计这是一次很轻松的比赛。但比赛结果事关前往稻妻的船票，所以万不可掉以轻心。
quests.description_en: After meeting some of the contestants, you reckon that this will be a milk run. Still, your ticket to Inazuma is at stake here. Best not to let your guard down during the tournament.

quests.description_chs: 「南十字武斗会」的决赛即将开始，对手的真容也将浮出水面，距离夺冠只差一步。
quests.description_en: The grand final of the Crux Clash is about to begin, and you will soon meet your opponent. Victory is but one step away...

quests.description_chs: 初次登上稻妻的主岛——鸣神岛，你拿着邀请函前往「木漏茶室」，又会有什么新的邂逅呢？
quests.description_en: Setting foot on Inazuma's main island — Narukami Island — for the first time, you carry your Invitation Letter to Komore Teahouse, not knowing what might happen next...

quests.description_chs: 失去了神之眼的村庄守护者，似乎忽然忘却了留在此地的意义…
quests.description_en: The village guardian who has lost his Vision seems to have forgotten why he had remained there in the first place...

quests.title_chs: 愿仁义之人被仁义以待
quests.description_chs: 失去神之眼后被民众所「刁难」的武士，究竟经历过什么才会使他落得这般田地？
quests.description_en: How did the samurai who lost his Vision become stuck in a quagmire of troubles brought upon him by the people?

quests.title_chs: 剑道家的道路铺满剑道梦的碎片
quests.title_en: A Swordmaster's Path Is Paved With Broken Blades
quests.description_chs: 以天下第一为目标的剑道家在失去神之眼后忽然陷入疯狂，你决定帮助他的徒弟调查原因…
quests.description_en: The swordmaster who aimed to be the greatest under heaven descended into madness after losing his Vision. You decide to help his disciples investigate the cause...

quests.title_en: A Flower Blooms in a Prison
quests.description_chs: 在实现了神里绫华的三个心愿后，你成功获得了她的信任，那么下一步行动是…
quests.description_en: After fulfilling Kamisato Ayaka's three wishes, you successfully win her trust. And now the next step is...

quests.description_chs: 木漏茶室空无一人，太郎丸在不安地吠叫，一种不祥的预感涌上你的心头。
quests.description_en: Komore Teahouse is empty, silent as the grave but for Taroumaru's uneasy barking. You have a bad feeling about this...

quests.title_en: In the Name of the Resistance
quests.description_chs: 与雷电将军的初次见面，发生了超乎预想的冲突。被稻妻通缉的你，现在唯有投靠珊瑚宫的反抗军才能扭转局面。
quests.description_en: Your first meeting with the Raiden Shogun leads to a clash beyond your expectations. With a warrant out for you, your only option to reverse the situation now is to throw your lot in with the Sangonomiya resistance.

quests.description_chs: 循着与珊瑚宫心海的约定，你决定前往反抗军本部的珊瑚宫做客…
quests.description_en: At Sangonomiya Kokomi's invitation, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine, the headquarters of the resistance army.

quests.description_chs: 与北斗一起前往稻妻的约定已经过去一段时间了，你决定前去打听一下事情的进展…
quests.description_en: It has been a while since you struck an agreement with Beidou to go to Inazuma together. You decide to check on how things are progressing...

quests.description_chs: 顺利抵达稻妻的离岛，并与接头人托马相遇。不过异乡人似乎在离岛并不怎么受欢迎…
quests.description_en: You arrive at Ritou in Inazuma smoothly and meet up with your contact, Thoma. But it seems that outlanders are far from welcome here...

quests.description_chs: 如何靠自己的力量离开离岛，这是托马留给你的下一环考验，否则旅途就只能停滞不前…
quests.description_en: Thoma has set you a test to leave Ritou by your own power, lest your journey end here...

quests.title_en: Those Who Yearn for the Gods' Gaze
quests.description_chs: 你晋升成为了反抗军「剑鱼二番队」队长，没想到哲平也同样受到了提拔…
quests.description_en: You take up the post of leader of Swordfish II. Unexpectedly, Teppei has also received a promotion...

quests.description_chs: 作为反抗军救命稻草的「秘密武器」竟是邪眼，战友哲平的死使你难以抑制对愚人众的怒火…
quests.description_en: The secret weapon and last resort of the resistance is, in fact, Delusions. Teppei's death ignites an unquenchable flame of rage within you...

quests.description_chs: 被愤怒冲昏头脑的你落入了「散兵」的陷阱之中，在你昏迷前的一瞬间，却见到了八重神子的身影…
quests.description_en: Blinded by fury, you fall into a trap laid by Scaramouche. But as you are about to black out, you catch a glimpse of Yae Miko's form...

quests.description_chs: 三天时限内，为了向九条裟罗证明九条家已经背叛幕府的事实，你需要赶快找到证据。
quests.description_en: You hurry to find proof of your claims to Kujou Sara that the Kujou Clan has betrayed the Shogunate within three days.

quests.description_chs: 天领奉行背叛幕府的证据已经到手，如此一来，九条裟罗的立场是否会发生转变呢？
quests.description_en: The evidence of the Tenryou Commission's treason is in your hands. How will Kujou Sara's viewpoint change?

quests.description_chs: 九条裟罗愤怒地冲向天守阁，你意识到这是自己再次见到雷电将军的机会，可在将军的御座之前，赫然出现了另一个熟悉的身影…
quests.description_en: Kujou Sara storms towards Tenshukaku in a fury. You realize that this is your chance to meet the Raiden Shogun again, but an unexpected yet familiar figure greets you before the throne...

quests.description_chs: 在雷电将军的武艺面前，你意识到想要实现八重神子的计划并没有那么容易，先离开天守阁再做打算吧…
quests.description_en: Before the Raiden Shogun's martial might, you sense that initiating Yae Miko's plan may not be as easy as you thought. It might be best to leave Tenshukaku and make further plans from there...

quests.description_chs: 你没有辜负那些寄托在你身上的愿望，雷电将军最终废除了眼狩令。风波暂时平息，去见见八重神子吧。
quests.description_en: You did not betray the ambitions that had been entrusted to you — the Vision Hunt Decree has been abolished by the Raiden Shogun. The turbulent waves have calmed for now. Time to go see Yae Miko.

quests.description_chs: (test)离岛封锁表现处理$HIDDEN
(test)稻妻主线下-父任务10$HIDDEN
(test)解锁离岛外锚点$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part II
quests.description_chs: 经历了一天的忙碌，你和派蒙已然可以应付日常的后厨工作，除非有口味挑剔且要求严苛的客人上门…
quests.description_en: After a day's hard work, you and Paimon are now able to deal with the daily kitchen grind. That is, unless some truly picky customers come calling...

quests.title_en: The Subterranean Trials of Drake and Serpent
quests.description_chs: 为了财宝和海祇岛的未来，你接受了露子的委托，准备前往渊下宫…
quests.description_en: For treasure and for the future of Watatsumi Island, you accept Tsuyuko's commission and prepare to descend into Enkanomiya...

quests.description_chs: 维多利亚修女似乎因为某事而发愁…
quests.description_en: Sister Victoria seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 在奔狼领中，突然有人大声呼喊着芭芭拉…
quests.description_en: Someone suddenly starts calling for Barbara in Wolvendom...

quests.description_chs: 在芭芭拉的拜托下，先回到蒙德城，向维多利亚修女回报。
quests.description_en: At Barbara's request, you head back to Mondstadt to report to Sister Victoria.

quests.description_chs: 为了制作辣味饮料，芭芭拉拜托你前往石门附近，寻找新鲜的绝云椒椒。
quests.description_en: To make some Chilibrew, Barbara has asked you to look for some fresh Jueyun Chilis near the Stone Gate.

quests.title_en: Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!
quests.description_chs: 击退所有盗宝团，救下被盗宝团胁迫的商人。
quests.description_en: Repel the Treasure Hoarders and rescue the merchant being threatened by them.

quests.description_chs: 为了制作辣味饮料，你准备和芭芭拉一同去低语森林附近采集甜甜花。
quests.description_en: To make some Chilibrew, you prepare to go with Barbara to the Whispering Woods to look for some Sweet Flowers.

quests.description_chs: 击退可疑人士。
quests.description_en: Defeat the suspicious person

quests.description_chs: 为了给乌维治疗，你和芭芭拉一同前往低语森林搜集小灯草。
quests.description_en: To heal Uwe, you accompany Barbara to search the Whispering Woods for Small Lamp Grass.

quests.description_chs: 处理完了教堂的清扫事宜，你准备前往猫尾酒馆附近与芭芭拉汇合。
quests.description_en: After helping to clean up the Cathedral, you get ready to meet Barbara at The Cat's Tail.

quests.description_chs: 早柚被鹿野奈奈发现，不得不返回镇守之森修习忍术。在早柚的央求下，你也只能同往…
quests.description_en: Sayu has been discovered by Kano Nana, and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...

quests.description_chs: 你行走在稻妻城中，突然感受到周围某处投来了异样的视线…
quests.description_en: As you walk through Inazuma City, you feel a strange gaze from somewhere around you.

quests.description_chs: 你告诉早柚想要长高的话需要补充足够的能量，于是她兴冲冲地和你前往稻妻城…
quests.description_en: You tell Sayu that she needs enough nutrition to grow tall. She follows you enthusiastically to Inazuma City...

quests.description_chs: 相比起工作和训练，早柚觉得还是抓紧时间睡觉更重要。
quests.description_en: Rather than working or training, Sayu thinks that sleeping is of the utmost urgency and importance.

quests.description_chs: 原来早柚想让你学会忍术，这样就可以代替她工作了。
quests.description_en: So Sayu wanted you to learn ninjutsu so that you could replace her at work...

quests.description_chs: 你决定亲自去调查「终末番」之事，于是你打算和早柚一起把下达命令的人引出来…
quests.description_en: You decide to investigate the Shuumatsuban personally. You and Sayu decide to lure the person who gave the order out...

quests.description_chs: 云翰社的经理韵宁，似乎正在璃月港的冒险家协会外，为某人的失踪发愁…
quests.description_en: Yunning of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe is currently outside Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild, fretting over someone's disappearance.

quests.description_chs: 在八重堂附近遇到了五郎与八重神子，不知为何五郎看上去有些困扰…
quests.description_en: You meet Gorou and Yae Miko near Yae Publishing House. Gorou seems to be somewhat troubled...

quests.description_chs: 为了帮助五郎克服恐惧，你决定与五郎一起寻找战胜八重神子的方法。
quests.description_en: You decide to help Gorou find a way to defeat Yae Miko so that he may exorcise his fears.

quests.description_chs: 为了帮助五郎克服恐惧，你决定扮演五郎不擅长应对的人。然而…
quests.description_en: To help Gorou exorcise his fears, you play the roles of people he is not good at dealing with. However...

quests.description_chs: 行至璃月港码头附近，有一位衣着不同寻常的少年想要向你打听一些奇怪的见闻…
quests.description_en: As you approach the wharf of Liyue Harbor, an unusually-dressed young man comes up to you, asking after some really strange business...

quests.description_chs: 少年方士重云掌握了很多听上去不太可靠的妖邪情报，在你提醒了他之后，他显得有些沮丧。在他用吃冰棍的方法压制纯阳之体的时候，你们都感觉到了从一旁投过来的视线。
quests.description_en: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits. He seems a little dejected when you point this out. As he uses a popsicle to suppress his pure-yang spirit, you both feel someone's gaze on you from the side.

quests.description_chs: 将冰棍分了一半给大隆之后，大隆满意地离开了。小插曲之后，你和重云的话题又回到了「妖邪」之上。重云希望能借助你丰富的冒险经验，判断「妖邪」的真伪，于是，你们一起前往了「万文集舍」。
quests.description_en: Dalong leaves after having been given half the popsicles, feeling quite pleased. After this small interlude, you and Chongyun continue discussing evil spirits. Chongyun hopes to tap on your abundant experience as an adventurer to adjudge the truth or falsehood of information concerning evil spirits. To that end, you head to Wanwen Bookhouse together.

quests.description_chs: 重云将所有的冰棍都送给了大隆，大隆非常开心地离开了。对重云来说，冰棍是压制纯阳之体必不可少的东西，必须随身携带。于是，为了获得更多的冰棍，你和重云决定前往「万民堂」。
quests.description_en: Dalong leaves after having been given all the popsicles, feeling most pleased. For Chongyun, these popsicles are essential to suppressing his pure-yang spirit, and so he must have some on his person at any given time. The two of you head to Wanmin Restaurant to restock.

quests.description_chs: 做好更多的冰棍之后，重云还惦记着之前那个名叫「大隆」的孩子。于是，你和重云结伴前往吃虎岩，打算把新做的冰棍送到他手上。
quests.description_en: Chongyun's mind is still on that kid named Dalong even after you've made some more popsicles. The two of you head to Chihu Rock, intending to give the new popsicles to him as well.

quests.description_chs: 本来想前往八重堂望风，没想到…
quests.description_en: You were here at Yae Publishing House to keep watch, but...

quests.description_chs: 写回信时看到部下的来信，五郎似乎也陷入了新的烦恼…
quests.description_en: While writing replies, Gorou encounters a letter from one of his subordinates and is once again troubled...

quests.description_chs: 五郎说自己有一个盒子在冒险家协会，跟五郎一起去问问凯瑟琳吧。
quests.description_en: Gorou says that his box is at the Adventurers' Guild. Go with him to ask Katheryne.

quests.description_chs: （test）处理桌椅隐藏$UNRELEASED
少年方士重云掌握了很多听上去不太可靠的妖邪情报，出于礼貌，你并没有当面拆穿这一点。在重云看来，最有可能有妖邪出没的地方，是正在举办试胆大会的无妄坡。由于试胆大会需要双人结伴入场，你答应了重云的邀请，与他同往…
quests.description_en: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits, but you decide not to expose this fact out of courtesy. The way Chongyun sees it, the most likely spot for evil spirits to show up is Wuwang Hill, where a Test of Courage is currently taking place. The test requires two people to go in together, so you accept his invitation and accompany him there...

quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，然而妖邪的踪迹找到一半，重云突然觉得体内阳气躁动，不得不停下来休息。为了让重云的体质不要失控，你急忙去寻找能够压制阳气的东西…
quests.description_en: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. To prevent his constitution from going out of control, you look for something that might help suppress his pure-yang spirit...

quests.description_chs: 重云的纯阳之体终于得到了控制，但重云也知道了试胆大会的怪异事件都是人为引起的事实。然而你们并不甘心，在重云的建议下，你们分头行动，继续寻找妖邪的踪影…
quests.description_en: Chongyun's pure-yang spirit has finally been brought under control, but he is now aware that the strange goings-on during the Test of Courage are a result of human activity. However, neither of you is ready to give up yet, and at Chongyun's suggestion, you split up and continue to search for traces of the paranormal...

quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，虽然引起了一些误会，但也掌握了一些关于妖邪的情报。兼备期待与警惕，你们走向会场的更深处。
quests.description_en: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, and despite causing a misunderstanding, you also gain knowledge of evil spirits. The two of you proceed deeper, equal parts expectant and cautious.

quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，然而妖邪的踪迹找到一半，重云突然觉得体内阳气躁动，不得不停下来休息。可是寻不到妖邪也很可惜，于是在让重云留下来休息之后，你独自前往更深处探索。
quests.description_en: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. But it would be a shame to leave without having found any evil spirits. And so you forge on alone, leaving Chongyun behind to rest.

quests.description_chs: 在和工作人员交谈之后，你发现试胆大会的怪异事件果然都是人为引起的。虽然这是意料之中的事，但是告诉重云的话，他还是会很失望吧…
quests.description_en: After a conversation with the Test of Courage staff, you discover that the spooky things happening there are all instigated by humans. While you expected as much, you imagine that Chongyun would be quite disappointed if you told him so...

quests.description_chs: 万端珊瑚侦探社发布了一项奇怪的委托，究竟是什么案件，连侦探社也束手无策吗？
quests.description_en: Bantan Sango Detective Agency issued a curious commission. You wonder what case it is that even detectives have gotten out of their depths.

quests.description_chs: 云堇为寻灵感深入险地，幸得你及时出手相助。 为了答谢你的帮助，云堇与你相约在演出结束后再见一面…
quests.description_en: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to meet you after her performance...

quests.description_chs: 自称来自蒸汽鸟报社的主编与记者临时采访了云堇，但他们的言行却有些可疑…
quests.description_en: The self-proclaimed Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird and a journalist come for an ad-hoc interview with Yun Jin, but they seem somewhat suspicious...

quests.description_chs: 先前不见踪影的侦探少年，原来一直在海祇岛调查着一桩奇异的案件，他声称这片岛屿缺少了重要的东西，会是什么呢？
quests.description_en: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?

quests.description_chs: 云堇推却了诸多邀请，与你一同前往螭虎岩放松心情…
quests.description_en: Yun Jin declines a great number of invitations to spend a laid-back day with you at Chihu Rock...

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城的冒险家协会前台附近，你邂逅了一位非常热情的冒险家…
quests.description_en: You make the acquaintance of a rather passionate adventurer at the front desk of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild...

quests.description_chs: 答应了与班尼特一起行动，但这次你们决定做些冒险以外的事，比如…在城里转转？
quests.description_en: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... running around the city?

quests.title_en: What Is This, a Day Trip?
quests.description_chs: 答应了与班尼特一起行动，但这次你们决定做些冒险以外的事，比如…去野外散散心？
quests.description_en: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... having a stroll in the great outdoors?

quests.description_chs: 冒险的话果然还是要做好万全准备，在前往忒耳摩冬遗迹之前，你和班尼特打算先准备些吃的。
quests.description_en: You should only go adventuring after making sure that you're fully prepared! You and Bennett prepare some food before you challenge the Deserted Ruins of Thermadon.

quests.description_chs: 冒险只要勇气和实力就够了，你和班尼特准备直接前往埃伊亚遗迹冒险。
quests.description_en: An adventurer requires naught but courage and strength. The two of you prepare to head directly to the Deserted Ruins of Eya.

quests.description_chs: (test)【隐藏】班尼特Coop天气恢复处理$HIDDEN
云堇为寻灵感深入险地，幸得你及时出手相助。 为了答谢你的帮助，云堇答应向你传授一些表演技巧…
quests.description_en: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to teach you some acting techniques...

quests.description_chs: (test)茶馆氛围$HIDDEN
从稻妻顺利返航的南十字船队，正举办例行的庆功宴会，与以往不同的是，这回你成了北斗邀请的特别来客…
quests.description_en: The Crux returns safely from Inazuma and is preparing to celebrate. The only difference is that today, you're the guest of honor...

quests.description_chs: 在北斗的邀请下，你参加了「南十字之盾」的船员培训，就用这种方式，稍微体验一下远离陆地的海上生活吧…
quests.description_en: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Shield of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of life out at sea, far from any dry land...

quests.description_chs: 在北斗的邀请下，你参加了「南十字之矛」的船员培训，就用这种方式，稍微领略一下船队不为人知的另一面吧…
quests.description_en: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Spear of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of the side of sailor life that few know about...

quests.description_chs: 在你的建议下，你们决定前往归离原寻找宝藏，这一路会遇到什么呢？
quests.description_en: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in the Guili Plains. What will you encounter on the way?

quests.description_chs: 在你的建议下，你们决定前往轻策庄寻找宝藏，这一路会遇到什么呢？
quests.description_en: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?

quests.description_chs: 先前不见踪影的侦探少年，原来一直在海祇岛调查着一桩奇异的案件，他声称这片岛屿缺少了重要的东西，会是什么呢？
quests.description_en: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?

quests.description_chs: 顺利找到了失踪的侦探少年，成功将他带回奉行所复命…
quests.description_en: After finding the missing young detective, you bring him back to the Police Station...

quests.description_chs: 平藏计划举办一场名为「鹿说诈骗」的反诈骗宣传活动，首先你们需要找来几位参演的演员…
quests.description_en: Heizou plans to hold an anti-fraud campaign called "Heizou Talks Fraud." First of all, you two need to look for some actors...

quests.description_chs: 在须弥城的街头见到了卡维，他似乎正在和什么人争论不休。
quests.description_en: You run into Kaveh on the streets of Sumeru City. He seems to be embroiled in an argument with a client...

quests.description_chs: 决定与卡维一起去说服刚刚的委托人。委托人似乎也有什么隐情没有说出口…
quests.description_en: You decide to help Kaveh convince the client to come to his side. However, it seems like the client's trying to hide something from you...

quests.description_chs: 口碑载道的少年侦探突然遭人投诉，这封投诉信背后究竟隐藏着怎样的故事…
quests.description_en: The well-respected young detective suddenly receives a complaint. You wonder what the story behind it is...

quests.description_chs: 随着「荣誉骑士」的声名渐响，骑士团里似乎也有一位后辈希望得到你的指点…
quests.description_en: In accordance with your growing fame as the Honorary Knight, one of your junior Knights of Favonius would like to receive your guidance...

quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔与你在蒙德城附近邂逅了一名奇怪的客人，阿洛瓦。 阿洛瓦自称是一名商人，因为魔物袭扰而丢失了货物。 为了帮助阿洛瓦找回失物，诺艾尔决定带他前往蒙德城…
quests.description_en: You and Noelle met a strange guest near Mondstadt named Alois. Alois claims to be a merchant who has lost his cargo due to a monster attack. Noelle decides to bring Alois to Mondstadt to help him find his lost goods...

quests.description_chs: (test)为了展现蒙德的好客之风，诺艾尔热情地准备起了接待工作。
向往着成为西风骑士的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼，希望你能指点她的骑士修行。 为了向你展示她的修行日常，你们来到了骑士团的训练场…
quests.description_en: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To display the fruits of her daily training to her, Noelle takes you to the Knights' training ground...

quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔虽然有着强大的力量，却总是不能在实战中好好发挥。 为了让诺艾尔获得更多实战经验，你为她安排了一些训练…
quests.description_en: Noelle has great strength but is never able to use it in real fights. You arrange some training to help her gain more practical combat experience...

quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔虽然有着强大的力量，但追求力量的道路是无止境的。 为了让诺艾尔获得更强的力量，你给出的建议是：挖矿…
quests.description_en: Noelle has great strength, but the path to greater strength is never-ending. Your suggestion to help her bring out yet more power is... mining.

quests.description_chs: 向往着成为西风骑士的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼，希望你能指点她的骑士修行。 为了让勤奋过度的诺艾尔获得足够的休息，你提议和诺艾尔一起喝杯茶放松一下…
quests.description_en: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To get the workaholic Noelle some rest, you suggest that the two of you have some tea and let loose a little...

quests.description_chs: 面对陷入恋爱困境的贝雅，诺艾尔一如既往地伸出了援手。 商议之后，你们决定用一份礼物帮贝雅传递心意…
quests.description_en: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...

quests.description_chs: 面对陷入恋爱困境的贝雅，诺艾尔一如既往地伸出了援手。 商议之后，你们决定用一份礼物帮贝雅传递心意…
quests.description_en: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...

quests.description_chs: (test)(隐藏)诺艾尔Coop贝雅线BE成就用$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
听委托人说了眼下的窘境，卡维决定采用更省经费的简约风格。
quests.description_en: After hearing about the client's budget problems, Kaveh decides to adopt a more cost-effective and simplistic style.

quests.description_chs: 听委托人说了眼下的窘境，卡维决定到富商那里拉一些赞助。
quests.description_en: After hearing about the client's budget problems, Kaveh decides to solicit some rich merchants for a potential sponsorship.

quests.description_chs: 一位你意料之外的异乡人正在奥摩斯港闲逛…
quests.description_en: An unexpected traveler, far from home, is hanging out in Port Ormos...

quests.description_chs: 并没能与商人谈拢，但多莉似乎有什么话想说…
quests.description_en: You were unable to secure a sponsorship deal, but Dori seems to have more to say...

quests.description_chs: 与卡维来到家中，看到他找出了小时候的旧物。这些物品上又有什么样的故事呢？
quests.description_en: You accompany Kaveh back to his place, where he digs out a number of mementos from his childhood. Are there any interesting stories behind these simple objects?

quests.description_chs: 卡维决定暂时不把精力花在破解密码本上。与他一起到处走走吧。
quests.description_en: Kaveh decides to put aside his mother's notebook for now. You agree to take a walk around with him.

quests.description_chs: 卡维提议去见母亲的老师，或许那位妙论派的泰斗知道些什么…
quests.description_en: Kaveh suggests that you pay a visit to his mother's former professor. Maybe Professor Zaha Hadi will have the clues you seek...

quests.description_chs: 卡维提到了一位不接委托但财富惊人的妙论派学长，试着向那位学长取取经吧。
quests.description_en: Kaveh mentioned a Kshahrewar senior of his who has somehow struck gold without taking any personal commissions. You resolve to ask him for some career tips.

quests.title_en: A Familiar Face in a Faraway Place
quests.description_chs: 你与凯亚边走边聊，开始讨论接下来去哪儿的话题…
quests.description_en: You walk and talk with Kaeya, and discuss what to do next...

quests.title_en: Feathers Adrift in a Spring Breeze
quests.description_chs: 他乡遇故知最是难得，既然不期间相逢，不如结伴四处游历。
quests.description_en: A chance meeting with a friend in a faraway land is hard to come by, so why not join up and travel together for a time?

quests.description_chs: 向来充满活力的诺艾尔，最近似乎一直待在图书馆中，为某件事情发愁…
quests.description_en: Noelle is usually brimming with energy, but recently she has been cooped up in the library, worrying about something or other...

quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔与你一起前往璃月散心…
quests.description_en: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to join you on a trip to Liyue to relieve her stress...

quests.description_chs: 在游览途中，诺艾尔几次被误认作西风骑士。风波暂歇后，你们打算继续前往港口向千岩军请教…
quests.description_en: Noelle is mistaken for a Knight of Favonius several times over the course of the trip. After things have calmed down a little, you decide to see what Noelle could learn from the Millelith down by the harbor.

quests.description_chs: 在游览途中，诺艾尔几次被误认作西风骑士。风波暂歇后，你们打算折返「三碗不过港」稍作休息…
quests.description_en: Noelle is mistaken for a Knight of Favonius several times over the course of the trip. After things have calmed down a little, you decide to stop by Third-Round Knockout and take a short break.

quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔与你一起前往冒险家协会，希望能熟悉考试的氛围…
quests.description_en: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, the two of you head to the Adventurers' Guild, hoping to get some extra exam experience.

quests.description_chs: 「完全」理解诺艾尔的来意后，兴致高涨的塞琉斯向你们发起了最高难度的考核。
quests.description_en: After fully understanding Noelle's reasons for seeking him out, an elated and excited Cyrus decides to put you both through his new exam at the highest difficulty level.

quests.description_chs: 「完全」理解诺艾尔的来意后，兴致高涨的塞琉斯向你们发起了最高难度的考核。
quests.description_en: After fully understanding Noelle's reasons for seeking him out, an elated and excited Cyrus decides to put you both through his new exam at the highest difficulty level.

quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔开始模仿起身边的骑士，来克服对未来的不安…
quests.description_en: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to emulate the knights she knows in an attempt to overcome her sense of unease.

quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔决定向琴学习，回到蒙德城，帮助居民解决问题…
quests.description_en: Noelle decides to emulate Jean by returning to Mondstadt and helping the citizens with their problems.

quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔决定向凯亚学习，前往「天使的馈赠」，收集事关蒙德安全的情报…
quests.description_en: Noelle decides to emulate Kaeya by heading to the Angel's Share and attempting to gather intel on any threats to Mondstadt's security.

quests.description_chs: 离开蒙德已经许久，是时候回去了。
quests.description_en: You've spent long enough away from Mondstadt. It is time to return.

quests.description_chs: 蒙德的风一如既往的悠闲，一道享受柔风吹拂吧。
quests.description_en: The winds of Mondstadt are leisurely as ever. Enjoy the gentle breeze as you go along.

quests.title_en: An Ordinary Day for the Knights of Favonius
quests.description_chs: 类似的事情常在骑士团上演…
quests.description_en: Similar things are always happening at the Knights of Favonius...

quests.description_chs: 酒因为故事而醇厚，你因为其中的温暖而爱上酒。
quests.description_en: Stories mellow fine wines, and we fall in love with the warmth therein.

quests.description_chs: 回到家中，回到家人身边去吧。
quests.description_en: It's time to go home, and enjoy some time with family.

quests.description_chs: 戏剧是对现实的凝练与概括，在他的眼中，此刻舞台上的故事到底折射出了何种光芒呢？
quests.description_en: Drama is both the generalized form and essence of reality. Just what kind of light does the story onstage reflect in his eyes?

quests.description_chs: 据说，「猫尾酒馆」里有一位人气颇高的调酒师。
quests.description_en: They say that there's a popular bartender at The Cat's Tail.

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城里寻找三只小猫，或许不是一件简单的事。
quests.description_en: Searching for three kitties in Mondstadt might not be the easiest thing in the world...

quests.description_chs: 迪奥娜似乎想要去达达乌帕谷寻找一种特殊的「基底饮品」。
quests.description_en: Diona would like to go to Dadaupa Gorge to secure a certain special "base drink."

quests.description_chs: 想要深入达达乌帕谷，似乎需要一些特别的技巧…
quests.description_en: Getting deep into Dadaupa Gorge might require a cunning plan...

quests.description_chs: 据迪奥娜说，丘丘人萨满的草药汤，似乎能作为制作解酒药的材料之一。
quests.description_en: According to Diona, the herbal soup made by samachurls can possibly be used to make an antidote to alcohol.

quests.description_chs: 迪奥娜似乎想要去寻找一些特殊的「调酒辅料」。
quests.description_en: Diona wants to look for some special flavoring for her cocktail.

quests.description_chs: 为了学习到专业的调酒手法，迪奥娜即将与康纳展开一场切磋。
quests.description_en: In order to learn the tricks of a professional mixologist, Diona decides to exchange pointers with Connor.

quests.description_chs: 接到托马的邀请来到社奉行，却听到有两名武士在背后议论托马…
quests.description_en: At Thoma's invitation, you come to the Yashiro Commission, only to hear two samurai talking about him behind his back...

quests.description_chs: 为了感谢你在眼狩令期间的努力，托马想要为你做些什么…
quests.description_en: Thoma would like to do something for you to thank you for your help during the Vision Hunt Decree...

quests.description_chs: 托马先一步前往木漏茶室，好像是要准备什么东西…
quests.description_en: Thoma heads to Komore Teahouse first. He seems to be preparing something...

quests.description_chs: 在城内宣传托马的家政课，吸引更多人前来参加。
quests.description_en: Help Thoma advertise his housekeeping course to attract more people to come.

quests.description_chs: 在社奉行所宣传托马的家政课，努力吸引更多人前来参加。
quests.description_en: Help Thoma advertise his housekeeping course at the Yashiro Commission to attract even more people to come.

quests.description_chs: 来到托马所见的地点，樱花树下聚集了许多流浪猫狗。
quests.description_en: There are many stray cats and dogs gathered under the sakura tree that Thoma saw.

quests.description_chs: 找到了托马所说的那只无主的忍犬，但忍犬的态度似乎有些…
quests.description_en: You find the masterless ninken that Thoma mentioned, but its attitude is a bit...

quests.title_en: Bits and Bobs for Cats and Dogs
quests.description_chs: 与托马再次会合，托马也带来了织好的毛衣。
quests.description_en: You meet up with Thoma again, and he brings the finished sweater.

quests.title_en: A Trip for Two in Ritou
quests.description_chs: 在离岛，与托马一起度过假日时光。
quests.description_en: You have a relaxing time together with Thoma in Ritou.

quests.description_chs: 「木南料亭」的木南杏奈小姐似乎正在被什么事困扰…
quests.description_en: Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something...

quests.description_chs: 在寻找能让托马获得尊重的办法时，意外得知了最近出现的危机…
quests.description_en: You receive word of the latest crisis while trying to help Thoma win respect...

quests.description_chs: （test）找球玩法白盒$HIDDEN
你收到了凝光的邀请，她似乎与你有要事相商…
quests.description_en: You receive an invitation from Ningguang, she seems to have something to discuss with you.

quests.description_chs: 根据认真严谨的日程表，首先需要做的是将凝光唤醒…
quests.description_en: According to the schedule, the first thing you need to do is wake Ningguang up...

quests.description_chs: 宴会结束之后，按照之前的日程安排，接下来凝光会和她的情报人见面。
quests.description_en: Now that the banquet is over, next up is Ningguang's meeting with her informants.

quests.description_chs: 结束用餐之后，凝光对秘书们负责的拍卖会不太放心，于是你决定和她去现场看看。究竟是什么让她看上去有些顾虑呢？
quests.description_en: After finishing her meal, Ningguang is worried about the auction that her secretaries are in charge of, and so you go to inspect the site with her. What's got her all concerned, you wonder?

quests.description_chs: 凝光想要以她发明的棋戏纪念与奥赛尔的战斗，还想要制作一枚很特殊的棋子。
quests.description_en: Ningguang would like to use the board game she created to commemorate the battle against Osial. As such, she wishes to produce a very special figurine.

quests.description_chs: 凝光想要重温创业之初的心情，为此她邀请你参与一场从零开始赚取摩拉的游戏。于是你们一同前往码头…
quests.description_en: Ningguang would like to relive the experiences she had when she was just starting out. She thus invites you to play a game of starting from the very bottom. You head to the wharf together...

quests.description_chs: 凝光想要重温创业之初的心情，为此她邀请你参与一场从零开始赚取摩拉的游戏。在你提到北国银行之后，凝光决定让你见一下现状。
quests.description_en: Ningguang would like to relive the experiences she had when she was just starting out. She thus invites you to play a game of starting from the very bottom. When you mention the Northland Bank, she decides to let you have a look at how things are now.

quests.description_chs: 凝光一直都很辛苦，你决定为她放一天假。至于休息时间要做什么，她似乎有些想法…
quests.description_en: Ningguang has been working pretty hard all day. You'd like to help her take a day off. She seems to have some idea of what she'd like to do during this down-time...

quests.description_chs: （test）找球玩法白盒$HIDDEN
（test）找球玩法白盒$HIDDEN
奉行所门口的上杉，似乎正为荒泷派的事情犯愁…
quests.description_en: The Police Station's Uesugi is fretting about the Arataki Gang...

quests.description_chs: 为了取得鸣神大社的原谅，久岐忍不得不往影向山走一趟…
quests.description_en: To obtain the forgiveness of the Grand Narukami Shrine, Shinobu has to make a trip there.

quests.description_chs: 听闻久岐忍有意制定「派中法度」后，阿守等人瞬间逃之夭夭…
quests.description_en: Having heard that Shinobu is about to implement some special Gang Bylaws, Mamoru and the others flee as quickly as they can...

quests.description_chs: 暂时消气的久岐忍，决定先去忙她的「正事」…
quests.description_en: Shinobu, her temper cooling for now, decides to go back to her real plans for the day...

quests.description_chs: 你们听从了神子的「建议」，在神社中承担起巫女的工作…
quests.description_en: According to Miko's "suggestion," you work as shrine maidens at the shrine...

quests.description_chs: 在神子「大度」的让步下，你们前往山道去清理小广告…
quests.description_en: Thanks to Yae's "generous concession," you are able to head down the mountain to clean the flyers up...

quests.description_chs: 阿晃等人虽然逃过了皮肉之苦，却还是被抓去花见坂上起了课…
quests.description_en: Akira and the others have escaped physical punishment, but they are still whisked off to Hanamizaka to attend lessons...

quests.description_chs: 阿晃在你的帮助下暂时藏身，但他真的能就此逃过一劫吗？
quests.description_en: With your aid, Akira has made his escape for now, but can he really get away with this?

quests.title_en: The Trail of Drake and Serpent
quests.description_chs: 你决定前往常夜灵庙，寻找「苏生之辔」的碎片。
quests.description_en: You decide to head to the Evernight Temple to search for the fragment of the Reins of Revival

quests.description_chs: 某日，你来到须弥城教令院…
quests.description_en: One day, you walk into the Sumeru Akademiya...

quests.description_chs: 莱依拉提到「知慧仙灵」能帮她解决论文的问题，你虽有疑惑，但还是决定跟她去看看。
quests.description_en: Layla mentioned that the Wisdom Seelie could help with her thesis. You feel a little skeptical, but still decide to check it out with her.

quests.description_chs: 权衡利弊之后，你们打算直接把「知慧仙灵」的正体找出来。
quests.description_en: After weighing the pros and cons, you decide to seek out the Wisdom Seelie's true identity.

quests.description_chs: 信息收集得差不多了，以现在掌握的情报，应该能有所进展…
quests.description_en: You should be able to make progress with the information you have gathered so far...

quests.description_chs: 既然「知慧仙灵」在信件中给出了提示，姑且看看它想要做什么吧。
quests.description_en: The Wisdom Seelie left a few hints in its letter. Perhaps you could first figure out what it's up to.

quests.description_chs: 咬牙坚持之后，你们终于有机会窥见「知慧仙灵」的真相…
quests.description_en: Layla's perseverance has finally paid off, and you uncover the truth behind the Wisdom Seelie...

quests.description_chs: 就算追寻下去或许也不会有结果，你决定将「知慧仙灵」的恶作剧抛到脑后，带莱依拉去休息。
quests.description_en: You know that it might not be fruitful even if you pursue it to the end, so you decide to forget about the Wisdom Seelie's prank and watch over Layla as she rests.

quests.description_chs: 与其把希望寄托在不着边际的传说上，不如先帮莱依拉把状态调整过来吧。
quests.description_en: Instead of placing your bet on a sketchy legend, catching up on some rest seems like the better option for Layla right now.

quests.description_chs: 论文的问题总需要面对，她或许只要有人在后面推她一把。
quests.description_en: Layla will have to face the problems with her thesis, and perhaps a little push is all that she needs.

quests.description_chs: 在解决了仪器的问题之后，莱依拉还想要为即将到来的答辩做一点准备…
quests.description_en: Having obtained the device, Layla still wishes to practice for her upcoming thesis defense...

quests.description_chs: 莱依拉表现出了完全不同的状态，现状似乎都在她的掌控之中。
quests.description_en: It feels like Layla has become a completely different person with everything under her control.

quests.description_chs: 如果暂时把所有和学业有关的东西放到一边，莱依拉的状态会不会好转呢？
quests.description_en: Will it make Layla feel better if she puts academics aside and completely relaxes for once?

quests.description_chs: 享用了野餐之后，又可以继续前进了。目的地不重要，重要的是自由的心情。
quests.description_en: After enjoying your meal, it's time to continue moving forward. But the destination isn't all that important — feeling carefree is the only thing that matters.

quests.description_chs: （test）找球玩法白盒$HIDDEN
(test)开启稻妻传送点任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
禅那园中的提纳里，正在等候一位神秘的前辈…
quests.description_en: Tighnari is at Pardis Dhyai, waiting for a certain mysterious senior...

quests.description_chs: 为了柯莱与全须弥的未来，珐露珊决定开一门识字课…
quests.description_en: For Collei's future and that of all Sumeru, Faruzan decides to start a certain class...

quests.description_chs: 为了孩子们与教令院的未来，珐露珊决定协助阿折罗造像…
quests.description_en: Faruzan decides to come to the aid of Acara Crafts for the sake of the children and the Akademiya's future...

quests.description_chs: 成功摆脱教令院的纠缠后，珐露珊决定先前往禅那园…
quests.description_en: After getting free of her academic tangles, Faruzan decides to first go to Pardis Dhyai...

quests.description_chs: 德波大饭店附近，似乎有个熟悉的身影…
quests.description_en: There seems to be a familiar figure near the Hotel Debord...

quests.description_chs: 琳妮特决定回到酒会…
quests.description_en: Lynette decides to return to the reception...

quests.title_chs: (test)废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了$UNRELEASED
quests.description_chs: (test)父任务 4$UNRELEASED
事情终于告一段落，琳妮特迎来了久违的小憩…
quests.description_en: It's curtains for this act, and Lynette gets a long-overdue break...

quests.description_chs: 琳妮特决定前往报社…
quests.description_en: Lynette decides to head to the newspaper agency...

quests.title_chs: (test)废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了$UNRELEASED
quests.description_chs: (test)父任务 7$UNRELEASED
勘破迷雾，你们终于抵近真相…
quests.description_en: The fog is lifting, and you are getting closer to the truth...

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙来到须弥，准备寻找觐见小吉祥草王的办法…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon arrive in Sumeru, and you prepare to find a way to get an audience with Lesser Lord Kusanali...

quests.description_chs: 虽说不得已开始了化城郭的疗养生活，但似乎可以向柯莱打听一些情报。
quests.description_en: You can't be said to have really settled into rehabilitation at Gandharva Ville yet, but you can still ask Collei for some information.

quests.description_chs: 因为前一天最后的「不欢而散」，你和派蒙决定去看看柯莱的情况。
quests.description_en: Yesterday did not quite end so well, so you and Paimon decide to go check on Collei.

quests.description_chs: 按照提纳里的说法，独居林中的教令院学者海芭夏，才是解答世界树相关疑问的最佳人选。
quests.description_en: According to Tighnari, the Akademiya researcher Haypasia, who lives alone in the forest, is the ideal person to direct Irminsul-related queries to.

quests.title_en: The Trail of the God of Wisdom
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙终于到达了须弥城，接下来能否顺利找到觐见草神的办法呢？
quests.description_en: You and Paimon finally arrive at Sumeru City. Well, will you be able to get an audience with the Dendro Archon?

quests.description_chs: 得知教令院的失物可能与神明有关后，你和派蒙立刻动身前往奥摩斯港…
quests.description_en: Learning that the stolen package may have something to do with the gods, you and Paimon immediately set out for Port Ormos.

quests.description_chs: 既然依照约定成功获得了多莉的信任，接下来终于可以和艾尔海森谈谈「正事」了。
quests.description_en: As agreed, you gain Dori's trust. Now, it is finally time to discuss "business" with Alhaitham.

quests.title_en: The Coming of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 花神诞日已经快到了，按照约定，你回到须弥城寻找迪娜泽黛，准备一起参加花神诞祭。
quests.description_en: The Sabzeruz Festival is about to begin. As agreed, you return to Sumeru City to find Dunyarzad and take part in the festival together.

quests.title_en: The Arrival of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 按照约定，你和迪娜泽黛等人一起参加花神诞祭…等等…好像有些熟悉…
quests.description_en: As agreed, you go to the festival with Dunyarzad and others... Wait... This feels somewhat familiar...

quests.title_en: The Continuation of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 你来参加了今天的花神诞祭，可伴随你的，却是挥之不去的既视感…
quests.description_en: You come to attend today's Sabzeruz Festival, but you are haunted by a lingering sense of déjà vu...

quests.title_en: The Samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 如今你很清楚，这早就不是你第一次参加花神诞祭了。为了拯救迪娜泽黛，必须想办法找到真相。
quests.description_en: Now you know very well that this is not the first time you have attended the Sabzeruz Festival. To save Dunyarzad, you must find a way to get to the bottom of the truth.

quests.title_en: The Causality of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 「花神诞日的轮回」仍在继续着，你真的有在向着真相迈进吗？
quests.description_en: The samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival continues. Are you really getting close to the truth?

quests.title_en: The End of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 只是破解了「花神诞日的轮回」的真相还不够，你还需要找到脱离现状的方法，但至少已经看到希望…
quests.description_en: Discovering the truth behind the samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival is not enough. You still need to find a way to break out of it. The good news is, you now see a glimmer of hope...

quests.description_chs: 最终妮露的舞蹈给大家带来了黎明。如果没有记错的话，那时你似乎也在舞台前看到了迪娜泽黛…
quests.description_en: In the end, Nilou's dance ushered in the dawn. If memory serves, you seemed to have seen Dunyarzad in front of the stage...

quests.title_en: The Empty Illusions of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description_chs: 在你的记忆里，似乎从来没有尝试过到城外去，这令人感到好奇。今天的你决定进行尝试…
quests.description_en: In your memory, you never seem to have tried to go outside the city, which is curious.\nToday you decide to try...

quests.title_chs: (test)须弥3.0主线第一天锁时间逻辑处理$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)须弥3.0主线第一天锁时间逻辑处理$HIDDEN
「花神诞日的轮回」事件已过去许久，在纳西妲回复精力之前，许多事情还无法查明。这天你如同往常一样，前往冒险家协会…
quests.description_en: It has been a long time since the Sabzeruz samsara, and many things cannot be ascertained until Nahida gets back in form. Today, you go to the Adventurers' Guild as usual...

quests.title_en: The Gaze From a Certain God
quests.description_chs: 愚人众执行官「博士」的出场令人始料未及，这也意味着须弥教令院背后酝酿的阴谋有愚人众的参与…必须抓紧行动了。
quests.description_en: The unexpected appearance of the Fatui Harbinger, The Doctor, means that the Fatui must have played a part in the nefarious plot involving the Sumeru Akademiya... You must act now.

quests.description_chs: 暂时失去了纳西妲的助力，但根据纳西妲留下的信息，你将会在沙漠遇到可以帮忙打破现状的帮手。为了破坏教令院与愚人众的阴谋，你再次踏上旅程。
quests.description_en: You have temporarily lost Nahida's help, but according to the message she left behind, you will meet someone in the desert who can help you get out of the woods. To foil the nefarious plot between the Akademiya and the Fatui, you set off on another journey.

quests.description_chs: 受阿如村居民伊萨克委托，你和赛诺一起在村子里寻找有关守村人的线索…
quests.description_en: Entrusted by Isak, a resident of Aaru Village, you and Cyno begin looking for clues about the Village Keepers...

quests.description_chs: 与迪希雅一起抓捕激进派人士后，你们将这些人押送回阿如村。证词将矛头指向神秘人及其背后的势力，与此同时，艾尔海森出现在村长家门口…
quests.description_en: After arresting the Radicals together with Dehya, you escorted them back to Aaru Village. The testimony revealed the involvement of a mysterious man and his forces. At the same time, Alhaitham has appeared in front of the village chief's house...

quests.description_chs: 根据约定，你们前往拉赫曼指定的地点准备交换人质…
quests.description_en: As agreed, you go to the place designated by Rahman to exchange hostages...

quests.description_chs: 终于到了「识藏日」的这天，一切计划安排与一切的准备，都只为了一个目标——「拯救神明」。
quests.description_en: The Akademiya's Jnagarbha Day has finally come. All your plans and preparations are for one purpose, and one purpose only — to save a god.

quests.description_chs: （test）3.1须弥主线下隐藏对话$HIDDEN
依照约定，众人在阿如村村长家集合并召开会议…
quests.description_en: As agreed, you and the others gather in the village chief's house to hold a meeting...

quests.description_chs: 随着计划推进，为重要之日所做的准备也越来越全面。然而，这并不意味着过程中没有意外…
quests.description_en: As your plan progresses, more and more preparations have been done for the important day. However, this does not mean the process is as smooth as can be...

quests.description_chs: 拯救小吉祥草王行动顺利告结，虽说之后发生了许多超乎想象的事，但再一次从卧榻上醒过来面对着朝阳，心情竟很平静…
quests.description_en: The operation to save Lesser Lord Kusanali has concluded. Despite the many surreal experiences that ensued, you feel surprisingly calm after waking up again in bed, facing the rising sun.

quests.description_chs: 海芭夏&纳西妲$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies
quests.description_chs: 尽管已经成功救下小吉祥草王纳西妲，但没有时间欢喜或是喘息。阻止新神的诞生，拯救世界树…这一刻，提瓦特的命运似乎都背负在了你们身上。
quests.description_en: Although you have saved Lesser Lord Kusanali, there is no time to celebrate or rest, for there is a nascent god to stop and Irminsul to save... Now, the fate of Teyvat is in your hands.

quests.title_en: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call
quests.description_chs: 为了得到更多有关血亲的信息，你和派蒙再次前往净善宫拜访纳西妲，途中，你们听到有人正在讨论某个话题…
quests.description_en: In order to look for more information about your sibling, you and Paimon decide to visit Nahida in the Sanctuary of Surasthana once more. Along the way, you hear people discussing something...

quests.description_chs: 散兵在世界树内部的作为引发了一连串意想不到的后果，而你是唯一见证人。为了确认变化情况，你动身前往稻妻…
quests.description_en: The Balladeer has caused a series of unexpected consequences within Irminsul, and you're the only one aware of that. In order to ascertain the situation, you head off to Inazuma...

quests.description_chs: 种种结果令人心情沉重。你决定返回净善宫，将这些事告知纳西妲…
quests.description_en: The information you gathered left you with a heavy heart. You decide to return to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and tell Nahida about everything you learned...

quests.description_chs: 人偶已然舍弃他原本的名字，如「流浪者」这一称号所示，他成了一个无名之人。
quests.description_en: The puppet has given up his original name. Just as the title "Wanderer" suggests, he has truly become a person with no name.

quests.description_chs: （test）修改3.3间章完成后任务$HIDDEN
在挪德卡莱度过了一段安宁的时光。去问问凯瑟琳最近有没有什么值得注意的事情吧。
quests.description_en: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.

quests.description_chs: 看来情况比想象中要严重不少，世界树出现异常，纳西妲也昏迷不醒…先跟随众人一同离开须弥城，前往喀万驿吧。
quests.description_en: The situation appears far worse than you previously imagined, with anomalies occurring in Irminsul and Nahida in a coma... It seems best to first leave Sumeru City with everyone and head for Caravan Ribat.

quests.description_chs: 镇灵引发的沙暴被顺利平息，回到缄默之殿跟朋友们交流一下现状吧。
quests.description_en: The Jinn-induced sandstorm has subsided. Return to the Temple of Silence and discuss the situation with your friends.

quests.description_chs: 丽莎难得地在为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Lisa seems to be busy with something... for once.

quests.description_chs: 炼金店铺顺利开业，你和派蒙忙得晕头转向…
quests.description_en: The alchemy shop has opened, but you and Paimon are dizzyingly busy...

quests.description_chs: 似乎有其他国家的商人来到了你的店铺…
quests.description_en: It seems like merchants from other nations have arrived at your shop...

quests.description_chs: 昆恩在运送水果回蒙德城时，在千风神殿附近被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救昆恩
quests.description_en: As Quinn was transporting fruit back to Mondstadt, his path was blocked near the Thousand Winds Temple, and he was ambushed by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Quinn.

quests.description_chs: 歌德先生似乎正在为某事发愁…
quests.description_en: Something seems to be troubling Goth...

quests.description_chs: 歌德先生似乎正在为某事发愁…
quests.description_en: Something seems to be troubling Goth...

quests.description_chs: 押送着货车的怀尔德酷爱喝酒，但是在一次大醉之后，他的钥匙被自己弄丢了。尝试跟随着怀尔德脚印的痕迹寻找钥匙，并交还给他。
quests.description_en: Wyatt, who escorts goods, is fond of drinking. However, after some heavy drinking, he has lost his key. Try following his footprints to find his key and bring it back to him.

quests.description_chs: 为了满足顾客的需要，猎鹿人餐馆持续提供着送餐服务。但是因为顾客众多，餐馆里的人手严重不足，莎拉小姐想要找一个人来帮忙送餐。
quests.description_en: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.

quests.description_chs: 艾伦正运送着猎物去蒙德城，但是货车却被丘丘人袭击，货物和他自己都陷入了危险的境地…
quests.description_en: Allan was transporting hunting goods to Mondstadt, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

quests.description_chs: 史莱姆突然在蒙德城的码头出现，在码头附近的阿瑟尔似乎被卷入其中…
quests.description_en: Slimes have suddenly appeared on the Mondstadt docks, and it seems Arthur has become caught up in the commotion...

quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克想要找一群丘丘人练习丘丘语口语。她自称已经有了「完善的语言基础」和「充沛的交流经验」…只是一直没有实际交流过。
quests.description_en: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.

quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克想要找一群丘丘人练习丘丘语口语。她自称已经有了「完善的语言基础」和「充沛的交流经验」…只是一直没有实际交流过。

quests.description_en: Anthony set off from Mondstadt towards Springvale to find medicine for his sister Anna, but was set upon by hilichurls along the way. Defeat the hilichurls and save Anthony.

quests.description_chs: 米拉娜正在享受难得的散步时光，但是在前往酒庄的路上被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救米拉娜。
quests.description_en: Myrana was enjoying a rare opportunity to go out for a walk, but on the way to the winery is stopped and attacked by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Myrana.

quests.description_chs: 杰克正去一处新的冒险地点探险，但是在醉汉峡却被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救杰克。
quests.description_en: Jack was on his way to a new adventure spot, but has found himself under attack by hilichurls at Drunkard Gorge. Defeat the hilichurls and save Jack.
