quests.description_chs: 西风骑士古德温正记挂着在蒙德城里的恋人，正在找人帮他送信回去问候…
quests.description_en: Godwin, a Knight of Favonius, is yearning for his lover who stayed in Mondstadt. He's looking for someone to deliver a letter to her...

quests.description_chs: 吉丽安娜小姐正在寻找一个人，替她去清扫久未打理过的七天神像…
quests.description_en: Jilliana is looking for someone to clean the Statues of The Seven, since she hasn't had time lately...

quests.description_chs: 蒂玛乌斯沉醉于炼金术的奥秘之中。他暗自期待着有没有人跟他一样，也被这古老而神秘的学问所吸引…
quests.description_en: Timaeus is deeply enraptured with alchemy. He wonders it there are others like him, that are drawn to this ancient and mysterious art...

quests.description_chs: 芬德修女想要登上瞭望塔，但似乎被什么挡住了，她正在思索通过的方法…
quests.description_en: Sister Vind wishes to get to the top of the watchtower but something has gotten in her way. She's trying to think of a way through...

quests.description_chs: 徘徊在千风神殿附近的帕琪小姐，正在烦恼着进入神殿的方法…

quests.description_en: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...

quests.description_chs: 提米正因为某件事而与你赌着气。葛瑞丝修女也许知道能与提米和解的方法…
quests.description_en: Timmie seems to have a bone to pick with you over some matter. Perhaps Sister Grace might know a way to help resolve things between you two...

quests.description_chs: 因为鲜花难以长久保存，鲜花商店「花语」的店主芙萝拉小姐正在思考着关于保存鲜花的方法…
quests.description_en: Flowers don't stay fresh for long. Flora, the owner of the Floral Whisper, has been thinking of ways to preserve them better...

quests.description_chs: 为了帮芙萝拉小姐确认「冷藏花卉」的效果，你需要再次前往雪山，取回之前埋进雪中的花卉…
quests.description_en: To help Flora ascertain the effectiveness of putting plants in cold storage, you must head to Dragonspine once again to retrieve the flowers buried in the snow...

quests.description_chs: 为了帮芙萝拉小姐确认「冷藏花卉」的效果，你需要再次前往雪山，取回之前埋进雪中的花卉…
quests.description_en: To help Flora ascertain the effectiveness of putting plants in cold storage, you must head to Dragonspine once again to retrieve the flowers buried in the snow...

quests.description_chs: 为了帮芙萝拉小姐确认「冷藏花卉」的效果，你需要再次前往雪山，取回之前埋进雪中的花卉…
quests.description_en: To help Flora ascertain the effectiveness of putting plants in cold storage, you must head to Dragonspine once again to retrieve the flowers buried in the snow...

quests.description_chs: 为了让一些过于莽撞的冒险家不至于在雪山中遇险，里瑟先生正准备在雪山里放置一些应急补给…
quests.description_en: Riese is preparing emergency supplies to protect some reckless adventurers from getting in trouble on Dragonspine...

quests.description_chs: 迪卢克带来的人正是骑士团的琴，众人一番交谈，发觉窃取天空之琴的是「愚人众」。为了拯救特瓦林，你们必须取回天空之琴。
quests.description_en: The person Diluc called in turned out to be Jean from the Knights of Favonius. After some discussions, it is discovered that it was the Fatui who stole the Holy Lyre der Himmel. You must retrieve it to rescue Dvalin.

quests.description_chs: 清泉镇的杜拉夫先生，似乎正为了一封信而犯愁…
quests.description_en: Draff of Springvale seems to be fretting over a letter...

quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克又想出了一个和丘丘人交流的新方法。她正在寻找一个人，来帮助她进行这次的实践…
quests.description_en: Ella Musk believes she's come up with another way to communicate with hilichurls. She's looking for somebody to help carry out her idea...

quests.description_chs: 在女仆长爱德琳的安排下，女仆摩可和海莉也开始了打扫，但是，她们似乎遇见了一点麻烦…
quests.description_en: At the behest of head housemaid Adelinde, maids Moco and Hillie have begun cleaning up. However, they seem to have run into a spot of trouble...

quests.title_en: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III
quests.description_chs: 根据言笑的说法，现在不管来再怎么麻烦的客人，都不成问题。但每次当他这么说的时候，似乎都有麻烦降临…
quests.description_en: According to Smiley Yanxiao, you should be fine no matter how tricky the customer. But it seems that his every such utterance tempts fate...

quests.title_en: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part IV
quests.description_chs: 这是临时厨师兼职的最后一天，不知这一天能不能平稳度过…
quests.description_en: This is your final day of employment as a temporary chef. You wonder if this day will pass by peacefully...

quests.title_en: Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear
quests.description_chs: 林尼的冤案得到解决，你对下一步行动似乎有些迷茫。面对十分珍惜与你的合作关系的娜维娅，你决定回应她的邀请去吃「散伙饭」…
quests.description_en: Lyney has been acquitted, but you are not sure about what your next step should be. You decide to take up Navia's offer for a farewell meal to celebrate your cooperation...

quests.title_en: The Truth, Lost With the Rain
quests.description_chs: 你已经彻底被卷入了关于「少女连环失踪案」的事件中，根据之前在露景泉处得到的新线索，你和娜维娅准备展开进一步的调查…
quests.description_en: You're now involved in the "serial disappearances of young women" case, whether you like it or not. From the new intelligence you gained from your encounter at the Fountain of Lucine, you and Navia prepare for the next step in your investigation...

quests.title_en: When All Return to the Waters
quests.description_chs: 调查并未得出结论，歌剧院却已将新的罪人送上审判之位。你和娜维娅只得分头行动，为真相拼尽全力…
quests.description_en: Your investigations did not bear much fruit, but a new suspect has been hauled up for trial at the opera house. You and Navia must split up and do your best to uncover the truth...

quests.description_chs: (test)水龙Q&A环节$HIDDEN
前往枫丹的时机似乎已经到了，旅者是时候踏上前往枫丹的道路…
quests.description_en: It is time to go to Fontaine, it seems. The next phase of your journey is about to begin...

quests.title_en: The City of Rains and Remembrance
quests.description_chs: 与水神匆匆会面以后，你应林尼的邀请，决定前往歌剧院参加他和琳妮特的魔术首演。
quests.description_en: After a brisk meeting with the Hydro Archon, you decide to, at Lyney's invitation, attend his and Lynette's premiere magic performance at the opera house.

quests.title_en: Lies Cast Shadows Under Gathered Lights
quests.description_chs: 魔术现场突发意外，被选中的观众也不知所踪。所有矛头都指向了林尼和琳妮特，但你仍然对此抱有疑问…
quests.description_en: A sudden accident occurs at the scene of the magic show, and the chosen audience member is also nowhere to be found. All indications point to Lyney and Lynette, but you have your doubts...

quests.description_chs: 期待已久的开放日终于到来了，毫无疑问这是个打听消息的好日子。你和派蒙按计划行事，在梅洛彼得堡内寻找线索…
quests.description_en: The open day has finally arrived. This is undoubtedly a good chance to find some information. You and Paimon plan to act, and search for clues in the Fortress of Meropide...

quests.description_chs: 约定的日子到了，你和派蒙再次前往生产区。林尼会在那里等你们。
quests.description_en: The appointed day has come. You and Paimon go to the Production Zone once more. Lyney will be waiting for you there.

quests.description_chs: 公爵莱欧斯利掌握着梅洛彼得堡的所有秘密。你们打算直接向他提问，以便掌握现状。
quests.description_en: The Duke, Wriothesley, holds all the Fortress's secrets. You plan to ask him directly and get some grasp of the current situation.

quests.description_chs: 就在一切似乎归于安定时，未知的灾难悄然逼近…
quests.description_en: Just as everything seems to have returned to normal, an unknown catastrophe arrives suddenly, like a thief in the night...

quests.description_chs: 「少女连环失踪案」的事情告一段落以后，你们决定休整一阵。但与此同时，似乎一些事件正在暗中酝酿…
quests.description_en: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, you decide to rest up for a while, but something is stirring in the dark...

quests.description_chs: 接受那维莱特的委托以后，你们使用假的罪名来到梅洛彼得堡调查，作为犯人的生活正在等着你们…
quests.description_en: At Neuvillette's behest, you are sent to Fortress of Meropide on trumped-up charges to secretly investigate. Your life behind bars is about to begin...

quests.title_en: The Proscribed, Hidden in Plain Sight
quests.description_chs: 尽管在梅洛彼得堡遇到了熟悉的面孔，但「公子」相关的线索你们依旧没什么收获，是否会有关键信息隐藏在枯燥的日常之中呢？
quests.description_en: Although you met a familiar face, you have obtained no leads on Childe so far. Did you miss something that's hidden in plain sight?

quests.title_chs: （test）上午闲逛-检测玩家是否在搜索的线索外$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
（test）下午闲逛-检测玩家是否在搜索的线索外$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 你们一直围绕着梅洛彼得堡的种种「隐秘规矩」进行调查，很多线索看似都和「公子」有关，相信你们并不会白来一趟。
quests.description_en: You've been looking into the Fortress' "hidden rules" and seem to have obtained many leads on Childe. You are certain this trip will not be in vain.

quests.description_chs: 危机暂时解除，你们打算返回梅洛彼得堡看看那里的人们情况如何。
quests.description_en: The crisis has been averted... for now. You decide to return to the Fortress of Meropide to see how everyone's doing.

quests.description_chs: 根据「仆人」给出的情报，一行人来到某处遗迹…
quests.description_en: Acting on intelligence from The Knave, your group arrives at the ruins...

quests.description_chs: 你们返回位于灰河的刺玫会据点休息，却在那里遇到了意料之外的朋友…
quests.description_en: You return to the Spina di Rosula base in Fleuve Cendre, and there, you meet an unexpected friend...

quests.description_chs: 预言必将发生，计划也已制定，剩下的…唯有审判神明。
quests.description_en: The prophecy shall inevitably come to fruition, and the plans are all in place. All that's left... is to judge a god.

quests.description_chs: 出狱的日子到了，你们依照约定前去办理出狱手续。
quests.description_en: This is the day you get out of prison, and you proceed to complete the paperwork for your release as arranged.

quests.title_en: The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur
quests.description_chs: 不论是那维莱特眼前的「芙卡洛斯」，还是你面前的「芙宁娜」，都在演出同样的一出歌剧。最后的真相则藏于这出歌剧之中…
quests.description_en: Whether it be the "Focalors" before Neuvillette, or the "Furina" before you, they are performing the same opera, and the final truth is hidden within it...

quests.description_chs: 枫丹的灾难总算告一段落。无论经历了什么，报社都不会闲下来，也就是说，在枫丹，蒸汽鸟报的撰稿速度就是人们了解真相的速度。
quests.description_en: The calamity facing Fontaine has finally come to an end. No matter what happens, the presses won't stop churning news out. In other words, the people will learn about the truth as fast as The Steambird's staffers can write it.

quests.description_chs: （test）枫丹问答$HIDDEN
（test）用来控制生鱼镇人群显影$HIDDEN
(test)隐藏任务用于发放风筝奖励$HIDDEN
(test)武器强化$HIDDEN
冒险的旅途中你从冒险家协会得知，在某个秘境里好像藏有珍贵的秘宝。
quests.description_en: From the information you gathered from the Adventurers' Guild, there seems to be an invaluable treasure hidden within one of the domains.

quests.description_chs: 如果能通过这个秘境中的试炼，或许能够获得某种特别的宝物。
quests.description_en: Whoever passes the trial in this domain will be rewarded with a special treasure.

quests.title_en: Sharpening the Axe Won't Hinder the Work
quests.description_chs: 为了迎接之后的冒险，派蒙觉得应该先做好准备。
quests.description_en: Paimon believes in order to meet the adventures that are to come, it would be best to first make some preparations.

quests.description_chs: 派蒙注意到了一个很别致的商店…
quests.description_en: Paimon has discovered a very unique store...

quests.description_chs: 愿意前来委托冒险家协会的人越来越多，凯瑟琳似乎有点忙不过来了。
quests.description_en: The Adventurers' Guild is taking on a growing number of commissions, and Katheryne is finding it hard to keep up.
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「探索派遣」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock Expeditions

quests.description_chs: 听说蒙德的炼金术研究者蒂玛乌斯正在推广这项技术。
quests.description_en: It's been heard that Mondstadt's alchemy researcher Timaeus is trying to popularize the art.

quests.description_chs: (test)PC呼出鼠标教学$HIDDEN
20501任务，第一次进入地城，发放树脂奖励$HIDDEN
安东尼向璃月港的一位「神医」求到了一副药方，用来治疗安娜的病…
quests.description_en: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

quests.description_chs: 安东尼向璃月港的一位「神医」求到了一副药方，用来治疗安娜的病…
quests.description_en: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

quests.description_chs: 安东尼向璃月港的一位「神医」求到了一副药方，用来治疗安娜的病…
quests.description_en: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

quests.description_chs: 安娜的病逐渐好了起来，她终于可以到处玩了。不过，安东尼总是找不到她…
quests.description_en: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

quests.description_chs: 安娜的病逐渐好了起来，她终于可以到处玩了。不过，安东尼总是找不到她…
quests.description_en: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

quests.description_chs: 安娜的病逐渐好了起来，她终于可以到处玩了。不过，安东尼总是找不到她…
quests.description_en: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

quests.description_chs: 鲁道夫先生想要送自己的妻子吉丽安娜小姐一份礼物，但是却不知道送什么才好，他正为此而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Rudolf wants to send a gift to his wife, Jilliana, but has no idea what to give her. He's at a loss about what to do...

quests.description_chs: 在吉丽安娜小姐的事情告一段落后，薇尔小姐再次找了过来，她说「那位先生」又有了新的委托…
quests.description_en: After taking care of Jilliana's matter, Vile came again to inform you that "That Guy" has another commission for you.

quests.description_chs: 在吉丽安娜小姐的事情告一段落后，薇尔小姐再次找了过来，她说「那位先生」又有了新的委托…
quests.description_en: After taking care of Jilliana's matter, Vile came again to inform you that "That Guy" has another commission for you.

quests.description_chs: 在雪山中，快被冻成冰块的冒险家汤米还在惦记着自己那份未完成的委托…
quests.description_en: Despite being well on the way towards freezing to death, Tommy the adventurer is concerned about one thing only: his incomplete commission...

quests.description_chs: 雪山下的营地中传来了美食的香气，厨师哈里斯却似乎正在为什么事而发愁…
quests.description_en: The aroma of food wafts toward you from a camp below Dragonspine — but Chef Harris seems anxious about something...

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城里的「愚人众」成员维克多，正想要招募人加入「愚人众」。 这似乎是探听「愚人众」情报的好机会…
quests.description_en: In Mondstadt, the Fatui member Viktor is recruiting people to join their cause. This may be a good opportunity to pry into what the Fatui is up to.

quests.description_chs: 虽然在风暴之中，冒险家协会的塞琉斯先生却正在摩拳擦掌…
quests.description_en: Even in the midst of the storm, Cyrus of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be gearing up for action...

quests.description_chs: 风暴虽然已经平息，但塞琉斯先生却有些不开心…
quests.description_en: The storm has subsided, but Cyrus seems displeased...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的危机解除了，但塞琉斯先生似乎有些…遗憾…
quests.description_en: Mondstadt's crisis has passed, but Cyrus seems... unhappy?

quests.description_chs: 至冬国的商人查耶维奇正在寻找一个可靠的人来帮助他解决一些小问题…
quests.description_en: The Snezhnayan merchant Tsarevich is looking for a dependable person to help him resolve a few problems.

quests.description_chs: 齐格芙丽雅对「翡玉什锦袋」的味道念念不忘，很想再次品尝…
quests.description_en: Siegfria can't stop thinking about the delectable Jade Parcels. Oh how she wants to taste it again...

quests.description_chs: 斯万先生万事万物都要遵照骑士团手册来行事，因为旅行者最开始不是西风骑士，所以他不会问旅行者，但是在旅行者获授荣誉骑士之后，斯万就会时不时地拿骑士团手册里的条目来问旅行者。
quests.description_en: Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn't ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.

quests.description_chs: 艾迪丝想要以「风」为主题写一本新书，她正在为此寻找灵感…
quests.description_en: Edith wants to write a new book about Anemo, but she's looking for some inspiration...

quests.description_chs: 在园林散步的老人，似乎很喜欢花草，但是她和旅行者时候，最近不知道是谁经常会把花直接给摘走，弄得她想赏花都没得赏了。$UNRELEASED
在蒙德城中开花店的芙萝拉正在发愁，她店里的花很多都被风吹走了。芙萝拉正在寻找一个人来帮助自己…
quests.description_en: Flora from the flower shop in Mondstadt is quite upset... It seems that many of her flowers have suddenly been blown away by the wind. She's looking for somebody who could help her...

quests.description_chs: 灾难过去了，葛瑞丝修女想要感谢护佑蒙德城度过这次危机的风之神…
quests.description_en: Now that Mondstadt has been spared from disaster, Sister Grace would like to offer her thanks to the Anemo Archon for its protection of the city.

quests.description_chs: 因为新种下的蒲公英又被吹走了，芙萝拉正在生闷气…$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
风暴对晨曦酒庄造成了不小的影响，埃泽先生正在想办法让酒庄的各项事务都恢复正常…
quests.description_en: The recent storms have been affecting business at Dawn Winery, so Elzer is trying his best to come up with ideas to get things back in order...

quests.title_chs: 风神与蒙德后续菜单蒲公英$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: 灾难过去了，葛瑞丝修女想要感谢护佑蒙德城度过这次危机的风之神…$HIDDEN
潜心研究的须弥学者萨义德似乎对风花节产生了兴趣…
quests.description_en: The ever-studious researcher, Sayid from Sumeru, has become intrigued by the Windblume Festival.

quests.description_chs: 薇尔小姐好像听到了一些令人在意的消息，想要请你前去调查…
quests.description_en: Vile has caught wind of some concerning news and would like you to go and investigate.

quests.description_chs: 骑士阿拉米似乎在为到处乱飞的花瓣而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Knight of Favonius Aramis is worried about the flower petals blowing all over the place...

quests.description_chs: (test)盗宝团的笔记上，似乎写着什么……$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
与艾拉·马斯克一同前去与丘丘人交流，或许是一段新友谊的开始…？
quests.description_en: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?

quests.description_chs: 在图书馆进行研究的艾拉·马斯克好像遇到了很让人困扰的事…
quests.description_en: Ella Musk is trying to study in the library, but it seems something is disrupting her...

quests.description_chs: 「猫尾酒馆」的玛格丽特小姐似乎正在筹划着什么事情…
quests.description_en: Margaret from The Cat's Tail seems to be planning something...

quests.description_chs: 在风花节中，维克多先生似乎遇见了一个小小的麻烦…
quests.description_en: Viktor seems to have run into a small issue during the Windblume Festival.

quests.description_chs: 待在龙脊雪山山脚下营地中的玉霞，似乎有些事想找人帮忙…
quests.description_en: Iris, who has set up shop at the Dragonspine base camp, seems to want some help...

quests.description_chs: 与艾拉·马斯克一同前去为被欺负的丘丘人打抱不平，或许能够借此得到新的线索？
quests.description_en: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues...

quests.description_chs: 与艾拉·马斯克一同前去与丘丘人交流，或许是一段新友谊的开始…？

quests.description_chs: 关于寻找「藏锋」这件事，岚姐似乎改变了主意…
quests.description_en: Lan seems to have changed her mind about seeking the Unseen Razor.

quests.description_chs: 古华派弟子孙宇，似乎正在思考着某事…
quests.description_en: Sun Yu, a disciple of the Guhua Clan, seems to be deep in thought about something...

quests.description_chs: 古华派弟子孙宇，正在努力锻炼着…
quests.description_en: Sun Yu, a disciple of the Guhua Clan, appears to be practicing hard...

quests.description_chs: 距离孙宇离开璃月港的日子，似乎越来越近了…
quests.description_en: The day Sun Yu will depart from Liyue Harbor is fast approaching...

quests.description_chs: 孙宇似乎正在准备离开璃月港…
quests.description_en: Sun Yu seems to be preparing to depart Liyue Harbor...

quests.title_chs: 万端珊瑚事件簿·隐秘踪迹
quests.title_en: Bantan Sango Case File: Stealthy Trail
quests.description_chs: 龙二似乎找到了一些新的线索，需要进一步的调查…
quests.description_en: Ryuuji seems to have gotten some new leads and needs to investigate further...

quests.title_chs: 万端珊瑚事件簿·稍欠灵光
quests.title_en: Bantan Sango Case File: The Truth (Just About) Comes to Light
quests.description_chs: 龙二似乎找到了更多的线索，依旧需要调查…
quests.description_en: Ryuuji seems to have gotten further leads and must investigate once more...

quests.title_chs: 万端珊瑚事件簿·它的认可
quests.description_chs: 探案似乎接近了尾声，真相应该就在前方…
quests.description_en: The case draws to a close. The truth is at hand...

quests.title_en: The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune
quests.description_chs: 又是一年海灯节，派蒙和你前去打听璃月人今年的节日安排…
quests.description_en: Lantern Rite has come around again. You and Paimon go and ask the people of Liyue about this year's festival preparations.

quests.description_chs: 受刻晴所托，见多识广的你陪着她研究起了节日送礼一事…
quests.description_en: At Keqing's request, you accompany her to look into the matter of festive gift-giving...

quests.title_en: The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes
quests.description_chs: 意料之外的烟花失窃案，让刻晴越发忙碌…
quests.description_en: The unexpected fireworks theft has caused Keqing to be even busier.

quests.description_chs: 留云借风真君似乎准备用「机关烹饪神机」制作第三道全新的菜品…
quests.description_en: Cloud Retainer is preparing to use the "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to make three all-new dishes...

quests.description_chs: 留云借风真君似乎想再用「机关烹饪神机」制作一道新菜…
quests.description_en: Cloud Retainer seems to want to use this "Supreme Cuisine Machine" to create a new dish...

quests.description_chs: 近期，「天使的馈赠」酒馆似乎在举行什么活动…
quests.description_en: Angel's Share seems to have started hosting some special event recently...

quests.description_chs: 「啧，怎么劳伦斯家的人也在这里喝酒…真是…」 「咳咳，你还是少说两句吧。好歹人家也是骑士团的人…」
quests.description_en: "Tsk, why is a Lawrence drinking here too... What bad luck..." "Ahem... Better watch your mouth. She is one of the Knights, after all..."

quests.title_en: When They Take Off Their Armor
quests.description_chs: 「请问，有人见过凯亚队长吗？」 「凯亚先生啊，你要往酒馆里去找。呵呵…新来的吧？加油哦。」
quests.description_en: "Has anyone seen Captain Kaeya?" "Kaeya? you'll find him in the tavern. Hehe... You must be new here, no? Well, good luck!"

quests.description_chs: 「刚才，我看迪卢克老爷行色匆匆地走进了酒馆。」 「哦？今天是老爷亲自调酒吗？那我可得去捧个场…来，扶我一把。」
quests.description_en: "Just now, I saw Master Diluc enter the tavern in a rush." "Oh? Is Master Diluc going to mix drinks personally today? Can't miss out on this one... Come on, help me up."

quests.description_chs: 「就连那位琴团长都去酒馆了？到底发生了什么事？」 「慌什么，那可是琴团长。再说，真要有大事就不会去酒馆了。」
quests.description_en: "What on earth happened that Acting Grand Master Jean is going to the tavern?" "Calm down, it's the Acting Grand Master we're talking about. Besides, she wouldn't be there if something bad were really going on."

quests.title_en: Surrounded by the Aroma of Tea
quests.description_chs: 「酒馆里好像有一位很不同寻常的客人…」 「能让你感兴趣的人物不多见啊。陪你凑个热闹？」 「算了算了…去了也不敢搭话的。」
quests.description_en: "There seems to be a very unusual customer in the tavern..." "Well, it isn't every day that someone piques your interest. How about we go check this person out together?" "Forget it... I wouldn't dare to utter a word in front of him even if I went."

quests.description_chs: 「跟你说，今天我遇到了位好客人。仪态优雅，谈吐得当，出手还阔绰。」 「你卖出去了什么？」 「商业机密。」
quests.description_en: "Do you know that I met a very nice client today? She moved and talked with grace — a very generous buyer, too." "What did you sell her?" "Trade secret."

quests.description_chs: 「你说，那位路过的那位白头发女人，是不是璃月那边的仙人啊。」 「我不懂，你懂吗？」 「我也不懂…」
quests.description_en: "Is the white-haired lady passing by an adeptus from Liyue?" "I can't tell. Can you?" "Me, neither..."

quests.description_chs: 「酒保体验周」接近尾声，是时候和卢卡道别了…
quests.description_en: "Bartender Academy Week" has come to an end. It is time to bid farewell to Luka.

quests.description_chs: (hide)调饮品活动关卡信息保底$HIDDEN
天气变热了，派蒙想要去晨曦酒庄买几瓶解暑的果汁…
quests.description_en: The weather is starting to get hot. Paimon wants to buy some fruit juice from Dawn Winery to cool off...

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙守候在异常的地脉淤积点旁，经历了几天的战斗，似乎可以向爱德琳小姐回报情况了…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon patrolled the area near the abnormal ley line deposit for several days. It is time now, it seems, to report back to Adelinde.

quests.description_chs: 来自枫丹廷的菲利斯·尤格，似乎正在因为什么而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Félix Yogue, a person from the Court of Fontaine, seems to be having some problems...

quests.description_chs: 来自枫丹廷的菲利斯·尤格似乎还有什么话想说…
quests.description_en: Félix Yogue, someone from the Court of Fontaine, still seems to have things he wants to say...

quests.title_chs: (test)幻影心流活动任务_控制闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 这段时间，派蒙突然有了奇妙的预感，提议再去一趟金苹果群岛，在周围仔细看看…
quests.description_en: Paimon suddenly has a mysterious feeling and suggests that you take another trip to the Golden Apple Archipelago to have a close look around...

quests.description_chs: 佳酿节上，西风骑士伯恩哈德似乎正在为什么事烦恼…
quests.description_en: Bernhard, a Knight of Favonius, appears to have encountered some trouble this Weinlesefest...

quests.description_chs: 经过一番努力，义卖活动的启动资金总算筹集完毕了，店铺即将开业…
quests.description_en: After going through a fair bit of effort, the starting capital for your charitable activities has been obtained. It's time to open for business...

quests.description_chs: 西风呼呼义卖铺似乎受到了不少关注，一些好心的店主也想加入义卖活动…
quests.description_en: Favonian Goodies has caught the eye of many, and some good-hearted shopkeepers would like to pitch in and help out...

quests.description_chs: 义卖活动即将结束，不知大家努力许久的收获如何…
quests.description_en: The charity event is coming to an end. Hope all the effort has paid off...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港北码头的新店店主曲清似乎在寻求帮助…
quests.description_en: Quqing, the owner of the new beverage shop on the northern pier of Liyue Harbor, seems to be asking for help...

quests.description_chs: 刚刚返回轻策庄不久的厨师关垂似乎在为兄弟们的解渴饮品发愁…
quests.description_en: Chef Guanchui, who has just recently returned to Qingce Village, seems to be worried about his friend's thirst-quenching drinks...

quests.title_en: A Visitor From Westward Realms: The Flavor of Freedom
quests.description_chs: 一位须弥人似乎在和莎拉讨论着什么问题…
quests.description_en: A certain person from Sumeru is currently discussing something with Sara...

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的卜劳恩似乎正在为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Plauen of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 西风骑士团的莉兹似乎正在为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Lizzie of the Knights of Favonius seems busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的法斯宾似乎正在为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Fassben of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的奥妮似乎有话想和你说…
quests.description_en: Onnea from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的弗丽德似乎有话想和你说…
quests.description_en: Frida from Mondstadt seems to have something to tell you...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的菲利斯·尤格似乎正在为某事而忙碌…
quests.description_en: Félix Yogue seems to be busy with something in Mondstadt...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德的费恩似乎正在为某事而苦恼…
quests.description_en: Fein of Mondstadt seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 经历了一段时间的冒险后，派蒙突发奇想，要用读书来调节你们的状态。于是，你们动身前往了西风骑士团的图书馆，却意外遇见了两位朋友…
quests.description_en: After a period of adventures together, Paimon had a sudden idea to take a break by reading books. Hence, the two of you set out to the Knights of Favonius's library, only to unexpectedly come across two friends...

quests.description_chs: 尽情游玩了「嘟嘟可轰轰奇遇记」后，你们和可莉从丽莎那里听说了一个好消息，还得到了惊喜的礼物…
quests.description_en: After having fun playing through Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure, you and Klee hear good news from Lisa, and even receive a surprise gift...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹留下了许多难以忘却的回忆。如今新的旅程就在眼前，先和枫丹的朋友们道别吧。
quests.description_en: You've made many unforgettable memories in Fontaine. Now, a new journey lies before you — first, time to say goodbye to your fine Fontainian friends.

quests.title_en: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
quests.description_chs: 「归火圣夜巡礼」作为纳塔最重要的比赛，即将在今天开幕。比赛之前，先和卡齐娜等人会合吧。
quests.description_en: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, the most important competition in Natlan, is about to begin. Meet up with Kachina and the gang before things start.

quests.description_chs: 随着归火圣夜巡礼落下帷幕，卡齐娜顺利胜出，并跟随着几位前辈一同参加巡夜者战争。赛后，玛拉妮提议到「流泉之众」部族看看…
quests.description_en: As the Pilgrimage draws to a close, Kachina emerges triumphant, and she joins the Night Warden Wars alongside some seasoned veterans. After the tournament, Mualani moots the idea of visiting the People of the Springs...

quests.description_chs: 在「流泉之众」认识了新的朋友，留下了一段回忆。在新的旅程开始前，好好放松一下吧。
quests.description_en: You make new friends amongst the People of the Springs and leave memories behind. It's good to take a break before embarking on a new journey.

quests.description_chs: 为了救回受困于夜神之国的卡齐娜，眼下必须先找到卡齐娜的「古名」。基尼奇说他将能够找回古名的仪式用具交给了「悬木人」部族的族长，到「悬木人」部族打听一下吧。
quests.description_en: To rescue Kachina, who has been trapped in the Night Kingdom, you must first seek out her Ancient Name. Kinich says that he has given the ritual implements needed to do so to the Chief of the Scions of the Canopy. Head there and ask around.

quests.description_chs: 顺利取得了卡齐娜的古名，将它交给玛薇卡吧。
quests.description_en: You've successfully obtained Kachina's Ancient Name. Now, hand it to Mavuika.

quests.description_chs: 在穿过龙的遗迹后，终于抵达了夜神之国。是时候寻找卡齐娜的下落了。
quests.description_en: After passing through the dragon ruins, you reach the Night Kingdom at last. Time to search for Kachina.

quests.description_chs: 千钧一发之际，玛薇卡的精神进入夜神之国，带着众人离开。她本人似乎还在「话事处」，去见一见她吧。
quests.description_en: Mavuika's spirit enters the Night Kingdom at a critical moment to extract everyone. She seems to still be at the Speaker's Chamber. Time to go visit her.

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏父任务用来发奖励$HIDDEN
几经波折，你们终于了解「队长」的计划与目的——「重构地脉」。这件事听上去风险颇高，你们决定尽快和玛薇卡商讨对策…
quests.description_en: After several twists and turns, you finally understand The Captain's plan and goal — to "reconstruct the Ley Lines." This seems to you a risky endeavor. One for which countermeasures must be discussed with Mavuika post-haste...

quests.title_en: As One We Watch the Setting Sun
quests.description_chs: 你们在秘源遗迹中见证了第五位英雄的出现，也暂时和「队长」达成了合作的约定，这件事看起来终于告一段落。然而深渊依然不断迫近，现在并不是能松口气的时候…
quests.description_en: You witness the emergence of the fifth hero within the Remnants of the Secret Source, and temporary cooperation with The Captain is established. It seems this matter has drawn to a close, and yet the Abyss presses in. It's not time to relax just yet...

quests.description_chs: 深渊魔物侵入纳塔，一场规模巨大的战争已然拉开了帷幕…
quests.description_en: Abyssal monsters invade Natlan, and the curtain rises on a massive war...

quests.description_chs: 深渊之力的真主终于出现，大地侵蚀加剧，魔物愈发狂躁，这宛如末日般的场景，令人陷入不知所措的绝望之中…
quests.description_en: The true master of the Abyssal power has emerged at last. The earth's corrosion intensifies and monsters are driven mad, the apocalyptic scene becoming a festering seedbed of impotent despair.

quests.description_chs: 六位英雄齐聚，玛薇卡唤醒了神座中的力量，为纳塔众人吹响了「狩夜者战争」的号角。是时候清算深渊了！
quests.description_en: The six heroes have gathered, and Mavuika awakens the power of the divine throne. The horn is sounded for all Natlan to hear — the Night War is underway! A reckoning has come for the Abyss!

quests.description_chs: 被击碎的深渊只是来自夜神之国的倒影，纳塔的威胁仍未完全解决。我们还需要面对很多难题：悲伤，孤独，以及死亡…
quests.description_en: The threat to Natlan remains unresolved, for the Abyssal tide you shattered was but a reflection emerging from the Night Kingdom. Still more crises await — sorrow, solitude, and death...

quests.description_chs: 纳塔的冒险仍在继续，过了一段时间之后…
quests.description_en: Your adventures in Natlan continue. After some time has passed...

quests.description_chs: 茜特菈莉如约前来，不过，她也提出了一个要求：希望你们帮她找回失踪的孙子欧洛伦。你们接下委托，与茜特菈莉一同踏上寻人之路。
quests.description_en: Citlali comes as promised, but she also makes a request: she wants you to help her find her missing grandson, Ororon. You take this commission and set out alongside her.

quests.description_chs: 骑士团的饮品小站即将开张，后勤小队的赫塔正在寻找帮手…
quests.description_en: The Knights of Favonius are about to open their drinks stand. Hertha from the Logistics Company is looking for help...

quests.title_en: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece
quests.description_chs: 运营调饮小站一段时间后，你的作品广受好评，即将成为新的经典…
quests.description_en: After running the drinks stand for a while, your creations have received widespread acclaim and are about to become new classics...

quests.description_chs: 特别的欢迎仪式期间，安柏与后辈一同准备好了全新的飞行射击挑战，正等人们前来体验…
quests.description_en: During the special welcome ceremony, Amber and her juniors have prepared a brand-new flying and shooting challenge, waiting for people to come and experience it...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
几位骑士似乎正在交流学习测绘技术…
quests.description_en: A few knights seem to be exchanging information on surveying techniques...

quests.description_chs: 几日紧张有序的测绘演练之后，分别的日子悄悄到来…
quests.description_en: After several days of intense and well-organized surveying drills, the time to part ways quietly arrives...

quests.title_en: The Flickering Light Splits in Twain
quests.description_chs: 深渊入侵，情况变得相当紧急。众人各有任务，此时此刻，你们决定先找玛薇卡谈谈先前取得的重要信息…
quests.description_en: The Abyss is invading, and the situation grows dire. Everyone has their mission, and here and now, you decide to first speak to Mavuika about the key information you've obtained...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏判断玛拉妮状态$HIDDEN
(test)用来配阿加亚隐藏对话$HIDDEN
(test)主线结束后阿米娜闲置$HIDDEN
(test)(hide)战场一阶段隐藏逻辑任务$HIDDEN
关键的时刻即将来临，今天就好好休息吧…
quests.description_en: The crucial moment is fast approaching. You should get some rest today...

quests.title_en: As the Sun Rises and Sets
quests.description_chs: 终于到了会面的时间，现在前往「话事处」吧。
quests.description_en: The time for the meeting has finally come. Head over to the Speaker's Chamber.

quests.description_chs: 接下来就是和深渊决战的时刻，纳塔所有人都会以各种方式支持你，做好准备后，就向着最终的战场出发吧。
quests.description_en: The final battle with the Abyss is at hand. You have the support of all in Natlan, and they will do so in various ways. Once you are ready, journey forth to the last battleground.

quests.description_chs: (test)废弃$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
盘踞在天空的黑色太阳被击退，纳塔也迎来了宝贵的喘息机会。为了帮助受创最重的花羽会完成重建工作，你们决定过去帮忙…
quests.description_en: After the routing of the black sun that had hung high in the sky, Natlan finally had a precious moment of respite. You decide to go help the Flower-Feather Clan, which had been hit hardest by the calamity, with their reconstruction efforts...

quests.description_chs: (test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
在伙伴的帮助下，你和玛薇卡终于有机会面对「古斯托特」。为了终结纳塔的战争，竭尽所能夺取胜利吧。
quests.description_en: With the aid of your companions, you and Mavuika finally get the chance to face off against Gosoythoth. Give your all to claim victory, and by doing so, end the war in Natlan.

quests.description_chs: 你和玛薇卡击败了「古斯托特」，你成为了纳塔万众敬仰的英雄，好好享受属于你的时刻吧。
quests.description_en: Side by side with Mavuika, you defeat Gosoythoth and emerge as a hero revered by all in Natlan. Take this moment to enjoy the glory that is rightfully yours.

quests.description_chs: 这天晚上，你在睡梦中听见一个熟悉的声音…
quests.description_en: Tonight, you hear a familiar voice in your dreams...

quests.description_chs: 应伊安珊要求，玛薇卡和你们一起帮忙测试大赛流程…
quests.description_en: At Iansan's request, you and Mavuika help test the competition process...

quests.description_chs: 纳塔最初的领袖，伟大的初代火神希巴拉克，他竟然以超乎想象的方式和形态出现在众人面前…
quests.description_en: Natlan's very first leader, the mighty first Pyro Archon Xbalanque, has appeared before all in a form and manner beyond imagination...

quests.description_chs: (test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
西风骑士赫塔似乎有话想说…
quests.description_en: The Knight of Favonius, Hertha, seems to want a word with you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「城市声望·蒙德」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock City Reputation for Mondstadt

quests.description_chs: 在野外采集矿石不是一件容易的事…也许，蒙德城的铁匠瓦格纳先生会知道一些关于采集矿石的诀窍…
quests.description_en: Mining is not an easy task... But perhaps Mondstadt's blacksmith, Wagner, might have some tips for you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「矿点检索」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock the Mining Outcrop Search function

quests.title_en: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker, Part I

quests.description_chs: 近日闲来无事，你和派蒙准备去翘英庄看看…

quests.title_en: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part I

quests.title_en: This Ain't Your Daddy's Iridescence Tour...
quests.description_chs: 收到了一封「荒泷一斗」送出的邀请函。在这封热情满满的邀请函的介绍下，你踏上了前往海祇岛的旅途…
quests.description_en: You've received an invitation from one Arataki Itto. Having been introduced by his enthusiastic letter, you set out on a trip to Watatsumi Island...

quests.title_chs: 是荒泷生命摇滚虹色大巡回
quests.title_en: ...It's the Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness!
quests.description_chs: 在众人（特别是你）的倾力付出下，演出场地终于准备就绪，是时候开始最后的庆典了…
quests.description_en: Thanks to everyone (but especially you), the performance venue is ready at last. It's time for the final celebration...

quests.title_en: The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain
quests.description_chs: 「其将于『预言之崖』降临…」
quests.description_en: "They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."

quests.title_en: They Once Walked the Starry Sky
quests.description_chs:
「其将于『预言之崖』降临…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
勇者轻足跃芳崖，巧解碍难化纷杂。伊人臂弯化甘霖，愁云散尽木生花。

书卷旁的批注：你忘了提那森林里的酒馆有多热闹。
批注下的批注：话说你们都觉得那酒好喝吗？我怎么觉得一股怪味道？
批注下批注的批注：那可能是因为有人往你杯里放了…（后面的文字被涂掉了）
quests.description_en:
"They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes leaped light of foot o'er floral cliffs, trials and tribulations besting forthwith. By their arm they brought forth rain and dew, the dark clouds fled, and flowers grew.

Comment in the margins: You forgot to mention how popular the forest tavern was.
Comment below the comment: Wait, did all of you think the wine was good? I thought it tasted kinda weird.
Comment below the comment below the comment: That might be because someone put... into your cup... (the following words are scratched out)

quests.title_en: Treasures of Taishan Fill the Ship
quests.description_chs: 绝云间似乎发生了变化，根据诗文线索的提示，需要在低处寻找异象…$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: Something bad appears to be brewing at Jueyunjian, find its source with the help of the ballad as a clue...

quests.title_en: Fly a Letter Towards the Sky
quests.description_chs: 绝云间内流传着仙人的传说。想要求得仙人真颜，需要探索一番。$HIDDEN
quests.description_en: There's an urban legend circulating in Jueyunjian. If you wish to learn the truth about the adepti, you need to explore and leave no stones unturned.

quests.description_chs: test在灵矩关发现散乱的营地，它的主人去哪了？$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
在翠玦坡附近，有九根巨大的石柱巍然耸立，似乎隐藏着什么秘密…
quests.description_en: Nine stone pillars stand stoic near Cuijue Slope. They seem to hide a certain secret...

quests.description_chs: 正在渌华池旁取材的画家梵米尔似乎遇见了一些麻烦，需要找人帮忙…
quests.description_en: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help...

quests.description_chs: 钙化池主题玩法彩蛋任务$HIDDEN
在天衡山上，你遇见了一位奇怪的人，他正在找人陪他玩捉迷藏…
quests.description_en: You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...

quests.description_chs: (test)无人的小岛上神秘声音诉说时间的规律，这里究竟隐藏着什么秘密？$UNRELEASED
曾经修炼过的长者留下的考验$HIDDEN
在天遒谷中有一块奇怪的石碑，上面似乎记录着一些与天遒谷有关的往事…
quests.description_en: There is a strange tablet in Tianqiu Valley that seems to relate some of the valley's history...

quests.description_chs: 你到达了一座海上的孤岛，上面有一座神秘的日晷，不知道其中是否隐藏着什么秘密…
quests.description_en: You reach an uninhabited island across the sea, which is home to an enigmatic sundial. Who knows what secret it holds?

quests.description_chs: 奥藏山有仙人，自然也有修炼的师兄$HIDDEN
在璃月港的海边停着一艘神秘的船，看起来十分华贵。而你却冒冒失失地直接闯了进去…
quests.description_en: A mysterious ship has dropped anchor outside Liyue Harbor. The ship appears to be quite luxurious, all the more reason to hop right on board...

quests.description_chs: 在孤云阁旁，停着一艘不知来历的庞大武装舰船，而你却冒冒失失地闯了进去…
quests.description_en: A heavily armed ship of unknown origins has stopped outside Guyun Stone Forest. You hop right on board to investigate...

quests.description_chs: 望舒客栈主题玩法$HIDDEN
因为越来越多的工作，小昭忙得抽不开身，她正在寻找一位帮手…
quests.description_en: Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can't even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance...

quests.title_en: No Restoring This Past Land of Beauty
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的治平似乎在调查近期在天遒谷发生的地震与魔物的异动…
quests.description_en: Zhiping of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be investigating the earthquakes and strange monster movements in Tianqiu Valley...

quests.title_en: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part II)
quests.description_chs: 画家梵米尔似乎找清昼有什么事…
quests.description_en: Painter Vermeer seems to be looking for Qingzhou...

quests.description_chs: (test)海灯节的诗与画之二结束隐藏逻辑$HIDDEN
当你们闻到「烤吃虎鱼」的香气时，不禁想起了一位曾经帮助过你们的人…
quests.description_en: When you smell the aroma of Grilled Tiger Fish, you are suddenly reminded of someone who once helped you...

quests.description_chs: 虽然层岩之下的事件已经暂时平息，但是志琼似乎还在进行其他的勘测工作，去问问她的情况吧…
quests.description_en: Although the incident in The Chasm has come to a close, Zhiqiong is still involved in other exploration work. Best you go check in on her...

quests.description_chs: 破坏了「磐键」后，层岩巨渊的封印就此解除，现在就出发前往层岩巨渊之下吧…
quests.description_en: Now that you have destroyed the Bedrock Keys, the seal on The Chasm has now come undone. It is time to venture into the depths below.

quests.description_chs: 瑾武似乎有什么紧急之事要委托，好像是和志琼相关的…
quests.description_en: Jinwu has an urgent task for you. It seems to involve Zhiqiong...

quests.title_en: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered
quests.description_chs: 志琼似乎要离开勘探队独自探险，独自进入层岩巨渊还是太危险了，还是尽快找到她吧…
quests.description_en: Zhiqiong seems to have left the exploration team to explore on her own. Still, it's too dangerous to go alone into The Chasm, so she must be found...

quests.description_chs: 与志琼一起，调查层岩下变异的奇特环境，拍摄有关黑泥的照片。
quests.description_en: Investigate the mysterious environs beneath the stone and take pictures related to the black mud.

quests.title_en: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
quests.description_chs: 在打探层岩巨渊下层的过程中，居然还发现了盗宝团，岂能放任他们在层岩巨渊中肆意施为…
quests.description_en: As you explore the lower levels of The Chasm, you discover Treasure Hoarders. If they think you'll let them do things as they please down here, then they've got another think coming!

quests.description_chs: 如果要进入层岩巨渊的更深处，就不得不打开在封矿之时被巨石填塞的道路，看来，这次不得不借助「开山炮」的力量了…
quests.description_en: To get to ever-deeper levels of The Chasm, you must open the path that was blocked by large stones back when the mine was sealed. Looks like you'll have to borrow the power of the Mountainator this time...

quests.description_chs: 奇怪的晶石向下掉落，砸碎地面，出现了前往更深处区域的入口，不知更深处究竟有什么，还是保持警惕继续往前吧…
quests.description_en: The strange crystal plummeted toward the ground and shattered it, revealing an entrance to even greater depths. Who knows what's down there... But either way, it would be best to proceed with caution.

quests.description_chs: 接到了需要前往层岩巨渊进行的委托，不知封锁已久的层岩巨渊会是什么情况…
quests.description_en: You have accepted a commission that requires you to pay The Chasm a visit. Who knows what the situation in the long-sealed mines might be like...

quests.description_chs: 解决出现在此处的深渊咏者之后，遗留下了类似钥匙的事物，志琼曾看过与钥匙上的花纹类似的纹路？
quests.description_en: Having taken out the Abyss Lectors lurking here, you discover that Zhiqiong has seen the symbols on the key-like object the Lectors left behind somewhere else...

quests.title_chs: (test)(隐藏)层岩巨渊驻军控制任务$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 在冒险家协会的「岚姐」处接受了探索「层岩巨渊」的委托。首先，得去找到总务司派驻层岩巨渊的专员「沐宁」才行。
quests.description_en: Lan of the Adventurers' Guild has offered you a commission to explore The Chasm, which you have accepted. First, you'll need to find the representative of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, Muning, who has been stationed there.

quests.description_chs: 接受了阿旭的委托，要将行秋借出的钱交给在「层岩巨渊」的总务司专员「沐宁」。
quests.description_en: You accept Xu's commission to deliver the Mora Xingqiu has lent out to the Ministry of Civil Affairs' specialist, Muning, at The Chasm.

quests.description_chs: 层岩巨渊有许多奇异的生态环境和地质环境，其中尤为特殊的就是生长在层岩的荧光蘑菇，帮助须弥学者海迪夫调查一下此处的蘑菇吧…
quests.description_en: The Chasm has a complex ecological and geological system. One of the most curious things here is the glowing mushrooms. Help the Sumeru scholar Khedive to investigate the mushrooms that grow in The Chasm...

quests.description_chs: 从层岩巨渊中钓出了奇怪的物件，究竟是什么呢，交由须弥学者海迪夫调查后，说要放到水边激活才可知道其真相…
quests.description_en: You fish up something strange in The Chasm. What in the world could it be? According to the Sumeru scholar Khedive, just place it by the water and you will discover its secret...

quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊看到了纹路奇怪的岩石，不如先拍下来，不知道有没有人知道这是什么…
quests.description_en: You notice some rocks with peculiar markings on them. It's better to take a few pictures. Perhaps someone might know what these are...

quests.description_chs: 隐藏任务对话海迪夫$HIDDEN
行迹奇怪的盗宝团原来是千岩军所假扮，千岩军顺势委托你们，不如一同前去盗宝团的营地剿匪…
quests.description_en: The Treasure Hoarders who were behaving oddly turned out to be Millelith in disguise. In response to the resultant situation, their leader asks for your aid in taking out the Treasure Hoarder camps...

quests.description_chs: 璃月的矿工戚定，不知道为什么神秘失踪了，层岩巨渊危险，以防万一，还是帮忙找到矿工戚定的踪迹吧。
quests.description_en: A Liyue miner named Qi Ding has somehow gone missing. Seeing as how The Chasm is a perilous place, you decide to help look for him.

quests.description_chs: 隐藏判断地脉树reminder$HIDDEN
老何是层岩巨渊的资深矿工，在上一次封矿的时候未能撤离，就此失踪。但在机缘巧合之下，似乎发现了他还活着的证据…
quests.description_en: Uncle He, a veteran miner at The Chasm, went missing when the mine was previously evacuated. But due to a series of coincidences, you unearth evidence that he may still be alive...

quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊之下，遇到了敌意并没有那么强的愚人众术士，她到底为什么会出现在此处呢？
quests.description_en: You run into a less-hostile Fatui mage in The Chasm. What is she doing here?

quests.title_en: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊之下，遇到了独自游荡的愚人众术士卡塔琳娜，她似乎是为了什么目的而在层岩巨渊徘徊，去问问她究竟是为了什么事吧。
quests.description_en: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what's going on.

quests.description_chs: 隐藏卡了琳娜失踪$HIDDEN
在层岩巨渊的巨大蘑菇旁边，居然听到了奇异的声音发出的对话，说话的…难道是巨大的蘑菇？
quests.description_en: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?

quests.title_en: A Company Vanishing Into the Deep
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊竟然发现了一队与地面失联已久的愚人众，可这队愚人众似乎已经没有什么战斗能力，甚至还向你求助…
quests.description_en: You encounter a group of Fatui who have lost contact with their troops on the ground. But they don't seem combat able at all and even ask for your help...

quests.description_chs: 一位站在层岩巨渊最高处的前盗宝团成员，竟自称古华派传人，是精神的失常还是人心的沦丧，难道其中还藏有什么隐情…
quests.description_en: A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?

quests.description_chs: 根据层岩巨渊本地流传的故事，找到六样供物在纪念石前进行供奉，说不定就能获得「千岩军的宝藏」…
quests.description_en: According to a local legend at The Chasm, one may be able to obtain the "treasure of the Millelith" by offering six items before a memorial.

quests.description_en: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

quests.description_chs: 海灯节到了，今年的璃月港又有什么新变化呢？
quests.description_en: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

quests.description_chs: 雅珂达提醒你，你将要在那艘巨舰上会见的是一位纵横远海的佣兵巨头，必须谨慎行事…
quests.description_en: Jahoda reminds you that the person you're about to meet on the giant ship is an infamous merc captain who sails the high seas. You had best act with caution...

quests.title_chs: 主宰地下世界的黑道大佬
quests.title_en: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld
quests.description_chs: 雅珂达叮嘱你，在「旗舰」下榻的那位是主宰地下世界的黑道大佬，千万不要惹到对方…
quests.description_en: Jahoda warns you that the individual staying at The Flagship is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You'd do well to stay on their good side...

quests.title_en: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth
quests.description_chs: 雅珂达告诉你，给爱诺这家伙预留的展位已经空了太久，赶紧催她过来。
quests.description_en: Jahoda informs you that the booth reserved for Aino has been sitting empty for too long. You'd better get her here lickety-split.

quests.title_en: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch
quests.description_chs: 经历不少事件后，你们决定去秋沙钱汤放松放松…
quests.description_en: After experiencing many things, you decide to go to Aisa Bathhouse to relax a bit...

quests.title_en: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
quests.description_chs: 你接到了来自西风骑士团的邀请…
quests.description_en: You receive an invitation from the Knights of Favonius...

quests.description_chs: 艾莉丝用魔法创造了重现你在蒙德旅行经历的泡泡，用于向远征归来的蒙德骑士团成员讲述这段故事。你作为亲历者，欣然接受了先行体验与检查的工作…
quests.description_en: Alice has used her magic to conjure a bubble that recreate your Mondstadt travels so the story can be shared with the knights who have returned from their expedition. As someone who has experienced it firsthand, you gladly agree to test and check it in advance...

quests.description_chs: 在绯云坡上巡逻的一成，似乎肚子已经饿得受不了了…
quests.description_en: Yicheng, who patrols Feiyun Slope, seems to have grown so hungry that his stomach can no longer bear it...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets
quests.description_chs: 你忽然收到了一封来自秘闻馆的信，奈芙尔手里似乎有一份只有你才能处理的委托…
quests.description_en: Out of the blue, you receive a letter from the Curatorium of Secrets. Nefer seems to have a commission that only you can handle...

quests.description_chs: 对于「岩之神」，慕胜似乎知道许多有关的故事…
quests.description_en: Musheng seems to know a great deal of Geo Archon lore...

quests.description_chs: 茶博士刘苏忘记了自己的故事讲到哪了，正陷入着苦恼…
quests.description_en: Tea Master Liu Su has lost his train of thought while telling his story, and it's troubling him...

quests.description_chs: 常九爷写了一本新小说，正在找人帮他快点送去飞云商会…
quests.description_en: Chang the Ninth has written a brand new novel, and he's looking for someone who is able to take it to Feiyun Commerce Guild as fast as possible...

quests.title_en: Wine, with a Taste of Freedom
quests.description_chs: 德贵的酒馆生意有点下滑，他正在为此犯愁…
quests.description_en: Business is slow in Degui's tavern lately, and he doesn't know what to do...

quests.description_chs: 张顺的手头很是拮据，他正在想赚钱的法子…
quests.description_en: Zhang Shun is not doing well financially, he's looking for ways to earn more Mora...

quests.description_chs: 石头正在大力招揽着客人，和他玩一场「游戏」…
quests.description_en: Smooth-talking Shitou bets you'll enjoy the game he has in store...

quests.description_chs: 张顺的手头很是拮据，他正在想赚钱的法子…
quests.description_en: Zhang Shun is not doing well financially, he's looking for ways to earn more Mora...

quests.description_chs: 张顺的手头很是拮据，他正在想赚钱的法子…
quests.description_en: Zhang Shun is not doing well financially, he's looking for ways to earn more Mora...

quests.description_chs:
「异世的勇者与其同伴，会为这个世界重新带来和平…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
至此，邪龙被拯救，希穆兰卡重归和平。
人们与那头名为「杜林」的可爱小龙一起，过上了幸福快乐的生活。

书卷旁愤怒的批注：你倒是给我们押韵啊！
quests.description_en:
"The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world..."

Thus would epics of later generations speak of this time:
Thus was the fell dragon saved, thus was peace restored to Simulanka.
The people then lived happily ever after with the cute little dragon named "Durin."
Annoyed comment in the margins: Hey, you're not even bothering to rhyme anymore!

quests.description_chs: 留云借风真君似乎发明了一种用于烹饪的全新机关…
quests.description_en: Cloud Retainer seems to have invented a new cooking device...

quests.description_chs: 凯瑟琳似乎在为层岩巨渊的一项委托感到烦恼…
quests.description_en: Katheryne seems to be having some trouble with a commission that concerns The Chasm...

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·摘要
quests.description_chs: 协助须弥学者进行「普尔希娜光钉」的初次启动，以清除层岩矿区中的黑泥。
quests.description_en: Assist the researcher from Sumeru in initializing the Pursina's Spike to clear the dark mud from the mining complex of The Chasm.

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·环境记录
quests.description_chs: 虽然试图将「普尔希娜光钉」搬入前线矿道之中，但是受到了不少的阻碍…
quests.description_en: While you attempted to move the Pursina's Spike into the frontline mines, you face a significant number of obstacles...

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·实验步骤
quests.description_chs: 胡塞尼终于想到了如何将「普尔希娜光钉」运送至矿道深处的办法…
quests.description_en: Hosseini has finally figured out how to get the Pursina's Spike into the depths of the mines...

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·结论
quests.description_chs: 终于将光钉运送到了最深处，之后的工作就只剩下打开光钉封闭地脉喷口了…
quests.description_en: Now that you have transported the Spike to the deepest section, all that is left to do is to activate it and close the Ley Line rupture.

quests.description_chs: 在层岩勘探队进行研究的须弥学者海迪夫，似乎在为层岩的环境感到烦恼…
quests.description_en: The Sumeru researcher Khedive, who is conducting research as part of the exploration team, seems to be troubled about the environment within The Chasm.

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·摘要
quests.description_chs: 协助须弥学者进行「普尔希娜光钉」的初次启动，以清除层岩矿区中的黑泥。
quests.description_en: Assist the researcher from Sumeru in initializing the Pursina's Spike to clear the dark mud from the mining complex of The Chasm.

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·环境记录
quests.description_chs: 虽然试图将「普尔希娜光钉」搬入前线矿道之中，但是受到了不少的阻碍…
quests.description_en: While you attempted to move the Pursina's Spike into the frontline mines, you face a significant number of obstacles...

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·实验步骤
quests.description_chs: 胡塞尼终于想到了如何将「普尔希娜光钉」运送至矿道深处的办法…
quests.description_en: Hosseini has finally figured out how to get the Pursina's Spike into the depths of the mines...

quests.title_chs: 光钉自循环运作报告·结论
quests.description_chs: 在光钉的作用下，终于逐渐封闭了地脉的喷口，前去告诉胡塞尼这个结果。
quests.description_en: The Spike is gradually sealing the Ley Line rupture up. Inform Hosseini of this result.

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，一个冒险家似乎正在为某事而奔忙…
quests.description_en: In Liyue Harbor, an adventurer is busy with a certain task...

quests.description_chs: 海灯节期间，「南十字」船队的航海士绘星似乎正在准备一场独特的训练考核…
quests.description_en: During Lantern Rite, Huixing, the navigator of the Crux fleet seems to be preparing for a unique training test...

quests.description_chs: 海灯节期间，冒险家协会的宣传员甜甜正摩拳擦掌，筹备着一场有趣的活动…
quests.description_en: During Lantern Rite, Tiantian, a recruiter for the Adventurers' Guild, is eagerly rubbing her hands together in anticipation of an interesting event...

quests.title_en: A Few Words in the Foreground
quests.description_chs: 港内北码头现有演出，有意观赏者请尽早前来，过时不候。
quests.description_en: There's a performance going on at the North Wharf. Don't hesitate to come along if you're interested.

quests.description_chs: 在你的协助下，纸映剧《虬髯公·奔乡》完美落幕，不过应公似乎还有些话想说…
quests.description_en: Thanks to you, the performance of Homeward, Bravebeard went smoothly, but it seems that Yinggong has something to say to you...

quests.description_chs: (test)海灯节期间绘星头顶mark$HIDDEN
不知为何，有一位一直站在璃月野外唉声叹气的须弥学者，虽然唉声叹气的学者已经见过不少，但独自出现在这儿到底又是为了什么…
quests.description_en: There seems to be a groaning Sumeru researcher in the suburbs of Liyue. This isn't the first time you've seen a groaning researcher, but you can't help but wonder what he's here for...

quests.description_chs: 从蒙德来的巴特洛似乎正在思考着某事…
quests.description_en: Batlo from Mondstadt appears to have something on his mind...

quests.description_chs: 从蒙德来的比勒似乎正在思考着什么…
quests.description_en: Buies from Mondstadt seems to be thinking about something...

quests.description_chs: 廷稚正在望舒客栈附近忙碌…
quests.description_en: Ting Zhi is busy near Wangshu Inn...

quests.description_chs: (test)斗虫二期-田铁嘴关卡$HIDDEN
(test)斗虫二期-畅畅关卡$HIDDEN
(test)斗虫二期-烟绯关卡$HIDDEN
经历了「荒泷甲光烈烈斗虫大修行」后，荒泷一斗似乎意识到了，鬼兜虫的力量终究是有极限的，一个大胆的新计划正在他的脑海中慢慢成形…
quests.description_en: After having gone through the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, Arataki Itto seems to have realized that the strength of Onikabuto is ultimately limited, and a bold new plan is hatched within his mind...

quests.description_chs: (test)斗虫二期-岚姐关卡$HIDDEN
海灯节期间，你和派蒙在璃月港遇见了与嘉明共同练习舞兽戏的朋友，他准备了妙趣横生的活动，正等待客人前来体验…
quests.description_en: During the Lantern Rite Festival, you and Paimon run into Gaming and another friend practicing the Wushou Dance together. He has prepared an endlessly fascinating event, and is waiting for guests to come and experience it...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港热闹的街道上，一位制作「剪纸戏」的画家吸引了你和派蒙的注意力，她准备的道具之中，有着两个熟悉的形象…
quests.description_en: On the bustling streets of Liyue Harbor, you and Paimon are drawn to a painter making paper cutouts. You spy two familiar silhouettes among the items she is preparing...

quests.description_chs: 路过遗珑埠的某条街道时，一位诚恳的说书人学徒挽留住了你们，讲述了一个与你们密切相关的故事…
quests.description_en: As you pass by a lane in Yilong Wharf, a sincere Storyteller's disciple approaches you and narrates a tale intimately related to you both...

quests.description_chs: 似乎有人对制作祝柬产生了兴趣…
quests.description_en: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

quests.description_chs: 似乎有人对制作祝柬产生了兴趣…
quests.description_en: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

quests.description_chs: 似乎有人对制作祝柬产生了兴趣…
quests.description_en: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

quests.description_chs: 月光铺就前路，指引你来到了挪德卡莱，这个冒险家与流浪客的「乐园」…
quests.description_en: Moonlight paves your way, guiding you to Nod-Krai, an "elysium" for adventurers and wanderers alike...

quests.description_chs: 这片土地的秘密，仿佛古老的歌谣一般萦绕在你心头，挥之不去…夜晚的挪德卡莱，又会为你呈现出怎样的曲调呢…
quests.description_en: The secrets of this land are like an ancient song that lingers in your heart and cannot be easily dismissed... What song shall Nod-Krai play for you this night...?

quests.description_chs: 总有不祥的迷雾于夜晚倏然升起，总有危险的阴谋于黑夜悄然酝酿…
quests.description_en: Ever do ominous mists rise at night, and ever will perilous schemes brew in the darkness...

quests.description_chs: 一场关乎同伴与挪德卡莱未来的战斗，已然揭幕…
quests.description_en: A battle for the fate of your companions and Nod-Krai has already begun...

quests.description_chs: 纳塔似乎迎来了一些意料之外的客人…
quests.description_en: Natlan seems to have welcomed some unexpected guests...

quests.description_chs: 为了修好伊涅芙的失忆，众人在纳塔各处奔波…
quests.description_en: In order to cure Ineffa's amnesia, everyone searches Natlan for answers...

quests.description_chs: 这片古老的领地，仿佛在等待你们的到来…
quests.description_en: It seems this ancient place has been waiting for your arrival...

quests.description_chs: 「狂猎」留下了许多秘密，隐藏于深渊背后的诡影蠢蠢欲动。混乱之后，不安情绪在人群中逐渐扩散，他们迫切地想要找到解决办法…
quests.description_en: The Wild Hunt has left many secrets behind, and the shadows hidden within the Abyss begin to churn. After chaos strikes, unease spreads amongst people, making them desperate for solutions...

quests.description_chs: 修复大炮并成功驱散「狂猎」之后，你们动身前往希汐岛，试图知晓更清晰的关于飞船的记忆。
quests.description_en: After repairing the giant cannon and successfully dispersing the Wild Hunt, you make for Hiisi Island to attempt to get some clarity regarding the memories of your spaceship.

quests.title_en: One There Was, Who Hunted the Moon
quests.description_chs: 在「少女」这里你不但从记忆中挖掘出了出人意料的真相，还得知了那个伪装成血亲的诡影的真实身份，他很可能就是戴因斯雷布曾提起的五大罪人之一——「猎月人」雷利尔。
quests.description_en: With The Damselette, you not only uncover surprising truths from your memories but also learn the true identity of the phantom masquerading as your sibling. He may well be one of the Five Sinners Dainsleif once mentioned — Rerir, the Rächer of Solnari.

quests.description_chs: 你和菲林斯查出了大炮发射这件事是「猎月人」在自导自演，但他的动机与目的仍然成谜，显然，留给你们的时间已经不多了…
quests.description_en: You and Flins discover that the cannon's firing is Rerir's doing, but his motives remain a mystery. Either way, you are running out of time...

quests.description_chs: 「猎月人」借用那夏镇的大炮获取了完整的身躯，「狂猎」招来的混乱还远未结束…
quests.description_en: Rerir used the cannon in Nasha Town to obtain a complete body. The chaos caused by the Wild Hunt is far from over...

quests.description_chs: 「猎月人」借助月矩力光束顺利复活，新的危机正笼罩挪德卡莱…
quests.description_en: The "Rächer of Solnari" has been revived with the aid of a kuuvahki beam. Now a new crisis looms over Nod-Krai...

quests.description_chs: 「大团长」法尔伽从安瓦蒂尼尔湖归来，帮助众人制定了作战方案。为了对抗「猎月人」，此时的挪德卡莱正空前团结…
quests.description_en: Grand Master Varka has returned from Amsvartnir and helped to devise a battle plan. To face the "Rächer of Solnari," the people of Nod-Krai must unite as never before...

quests.description_chs: 在与「木偶」桑多涅交涉后，离开了愚人众的试验设计局。到处都是游荡的狂猎，在不被发现的情况下回到秘密基地吧。
quests.description_en: After negotiating with Sandrone, the "Marionette," you leave the Fatui's Experimental Design Bureau. Everywhere you look, the Wild Hunt is prowling. Make your way back to base — and be sure not to get caught along the way!

quests.description_chs: 明月高悬，洒下温柔的月光。而你们的故事，正向着不同的方向流淌…
quests.description_en: The bright moon hangs high, casting down its gentle light. Yet, your stories begin to flow down different paths...

quests.description_chs: 长夜漫漫，「博士」的阴谋步步紧逼…
quests.description_en: Through the endless, long night, The Doctor's schemes press closer, step by relentless step...

quests.description_chs: 月亮回到了它的故乡。挪德卡莱也将在月光的照拂下，驶向全新的明天…
quests.description_en: The moon has returned to its homeland. Under its silver glow, Nod-Krai will set forth toward a bright, new tomorrow...

quests.description_chs: 返回基地后，众人就接下来的行动展开讨论。这时，一个意想不到的人加入了…
quests.description_en: Back at base, everyone is discussing what to do next. Then, an unexpected figure enters the conversation.

quests.title_en: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion
quests.description_chs: 通过特殊的仪式，你们终于了解到「猎月人」雷利尔的过去。\n接下来只需要离开这里。
quests.description_en: By means of a special ceremony, you finally learn about the "Rächer of Solnari" Rerir's past.\nNow all that's left is to leave this place.

quests.description_chs: 为了阻止猎月人对挪德卡莱造成进一步损害，你们不得不汇聚所有力量，筹备那至关重要的一战。
quests.description_en: To stop the Rächer of Solnari from causing further harm to Nod-Krai, you must gather all your strength and prepare for the most important battle.

quests.description_chs: (test)已废弃$UNRELEASED

quests.title_en: Where Our Space and Time Intersect
quests.description_chs: 陌生的世界、无法触及的同伴…要如何才能回到大家身边？
quests.description_en: In this unfamiliar world, with companions beyond reach... What path is there to take that leads back to their side?

quests.title_en: Tracing the Footsteps of the Past
quests.description_chs: 在月光的注视下，所有人都在朝着自己的终点前行…
quests.description_en: Beneath the moon's watchful light, everyone is marching to the conclusions of their own stories...

quests.description_chs: 在名为「过去」的茫茫大海中寻找她的名字…
quests.description_en: Seek her name within the boundless sea called "the past"...

quests.title_en: In the Shifting Light of the Moon
quests.description_chs: 近日的冒险告一段落，先去休整一番，关照下同伴们吧。
quests.description_en: The journey so far has reached a brief pause. Take a moment to rest and check in on your companions.

quests.description_chs: 达成共识之后，你决定返回「银月之庭」，打听一下哥伦比娅对礼物的喜好。
quests.description_en: After reaching an understanding, you decide to head back to the Silvermoon Hall to ask around about what kind of gifts Columbina likes.

quests.title_en: The Night the Moon Returns Home
quests.description_chs: 「祈月之夜」到了。在这最后的夜晚，她将留下怎样的回忆呢？
quests.description_en: The Moon-Prayer Night has come. On this final night, what memories will she leave behind?

quests.description_chs: 是时候踏上归途了…
quests.description_en: It's time to begin the journey home...

(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

须弥的情况比想象中更危急，为了应对可能发生的各种状况，人们聚集起来，群策群力。
quests.description_en: The situation in Sumeru is even more dire than first thought, and people have come together to come up with plans for various contingencies.

quests.title_en: A Tower Unto Wisdom and Folly
quests.description_chs: 眼下已非常人能应对的紧急事态，即便如此，没有人离开自己应处的位置。被封闭的智慧之国内，一场空前的战争即将打响…
quests.description_en: The current crisis is now beyond the capacity of ordinary men, and an unprecedented war is about to begin in the nation of wisdom. But even so, no one is abandoning their post.

quests.title_en: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
quests.description_chs: 「女孩做了一个很长很长的梦。她梦中，人们手握着手转圈，贤者与愚者，舞女与勇士，人偶与神像…无论种族，无论年龄，无论性别。大家的欢舞里蕴藏着有关智慧的一切。」
quests.description_en: "The girl dreamed a very, very long dream. In it, people were holding hands, dancing in a circle, be they sages or fools, dancers or warriors, puppets or statues of gods... It did not matter who they were, or how old, and in that joyous dancing circle was the sum of all wisdom."

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: Your Past Is Like a Garden
quests.description_chs: 智慧生命的一生似乎注定要是坎坷之途。好在还有温暖而柔和的阳光，照亮你我望见彼此，好在还有厚重又绵长的爱，帮助人们寻回自己。苦难后，总有鲜花环抱而来。
quests.description_en: The life of sentient beings seems destined to be a treacherous road. Yet, the warm and gentle sunshine still illuminates us who look upon one another. Yet deep and enduring love exists that can help us find ourselves again. And after the crisis passes, the flowers will be there to embrace you.

quests.description_chs: 「璃月总务司」的资源管理专员小雨似乎有话要说…
quests.description_en: Ms. Yu, a resource manager from the Ministry of Civil Affairs, has something to say to you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「城市声望·璃月」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock City Reputation for Liyue

quests.title_en: The Vishaps Lie Dormant, but the Enigma Lingers Still
quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的努力，「岩龙蜥」开始有些忌惮，各地的异常现象也明显变少了。不过，究竟是什么令它们重新现世，躁动不安，依旧是未解之谜…
quests.description_en: After a sustained effort, you seem to have scared the Geovishaps into submission and the disturbances across the land seem to have subsided. However, the reason for their re-emergence and rampage remains a mystery...

quests.description_chs: 璐璐最近有些不开心，似乎正在因为某事而烦恼着…
quests.description_en: Little Lulu has been unhappy lately. She seems to be troubled by a certain something...

quests.description_chs: 陨石雨纷纷而落，清昼诗兴大发，说什么也要去陨石坠落之处吟诗…
quests.description_en: Qingzhou has found a muse in the rain of meteorites, and simply must go to the place where they made landfall to compose a verse or two...

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的盈珠正在与须弥教令院派来的学者接洽，但接洽工作似乎遇到了一些麻烦…
quests.description_en: Yingzhu of the Adventurers' Guild has been having dealings with a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya, but things seem to be going downhill, fast...

quests.description_chs: 经过一番辛苦的收集，是时候向胡塞尼先生汇报成果了…
quests.description_en: After some painstaking gathering, it's time to report back to Hosseini.

quests.title_en: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的危机已然平息，城中的事务也大多重回正轨。 不过，在玉京台赏花的萍姥姥似乎还有件事想和旅行者商量…
quests.description_en: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「尘歌壶·洞天管理」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock managing your Serenitea Pot Realm

quests.description_chs: 「尘歌壶」中的「壶灵」阿圆似乎有话想对你说…
quests.description_en: Tubby, the teapot spirit in your Serenitea Pot, seems to have something to say to you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「尘歌壶·邀请伙伴」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock inviting Companions to your Serenitea Pot

quests.description_chs: 最近，越来越多的冒险家在野外遭遇了一种飘浮在空中的元素生物。为了防范风险和进行深入研究，稻妻城的凯瑟琳正在发布一系列的委托。
quests.description_en: Recently, more and more adventurers have encountered a floating elemental being. Inazuma City's Katheryne is releasing a series of commissions to minimize needless risks and lay the groundwork for further investigation.

quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的调查，冒险家协会已经排除了「飘浮灵」事件可能存在的风险，也收集到了很多相关情报。这些情报已经转交给专业的学者，相信他们在不久以后就会有新的研究进展吧。
quests.description_en: After a period of investigation, the Adventurers' Guild has eliminated the possible threats that the Specter incident may have caused, and they have also collected a lot of related information. This information has already been handed over to professional researchers, and it seems likely that they will soon make some further progress.

quests.description_chs: 蒙德的炼金术研究者蒂玛乌斯似乎正在为某项研究而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Timaeus, the alchemist from Mondstadt, is currently troubled by a certain research topic...

quests.description_chs: 「烟霰魔药」的阶段性试验结束了，是时候向蒂玛乌斯进行反馈了…
quests.description_en: The Smoldersleet Potion's phased trials are over. It is time to report back to Timaeus...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的凯瑟琳似乎有什么事找你…
quests.description_en: Katheryne of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be looking for you...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的码头上来了位须弥人，她似乎遇到了一些困难…
quests.description_en: A person from Sumeru has arrived at the wharfs of Liyue Harbor. She seems to be in a bit of a fix...

quests.description_chs: 某位枫丹的科研专家似乎正在层岩巨渊进行着深奥的研究…
quests.description_en: A certain researcher from Fontaine is currently performing some esoteric research in The Chasm.

quests.description_chs: 接到了一件奇怪的委托，到爆炎树附近找到委托人了解详情吧。
quests.description_en: You receive a very strange commission. Go to the area around the Pyro Regisvine to learn more from the client.

quests.title_chs: 荒泷甲光烈烈斗虫大修行！
quests.title_en: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!
quests.description_chs: 最近你们的饮食较为清淡，派蒙开始想念香辣的料理…\n因此，你们前往了万民堂，却意外遇见了两位老朋友…
quests.description_en: Your diet has been quite plain recently, and Paimon's been missing the spice of life in food...\nAs such, you head over to Wanmin Restaurant, only to meet two old friends...

quests.description_chs: 在爆炎树之后，兰吉特的下一个挑战目标是古岩龙蜥…
quests.description_en: After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit's next target is a Primo Geovishap...

quests.description_chs: 承担社会责任，促进人与自然和谐共生，「飞云商会」在行动！
quests.description_en: The Feiyun Guild is on the move, taking on social responsibilities and promoting harmonious symbiosis between humanity and nature!

quests.description_chs: 「伴爪同行」动物救助会的礼物交换活动已经结束了，振尘正在整理救助会收到的礼物…
quests.description_en: The Claw Convoy animal rescue society's gift-swapping event has ended. Zhenchen is sorting through the gifts that the society has received...

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会捎来情报，璃月的地中之盐一带似乎发生了某种异动，千岩军已将现场封锁，你与派蒙打算前往现场一探究竟…
quests.description_en: The Adventurers' Guild has reported strange activity in Liyue's Sal Terrae, and the Millelith have sealed the area off. Sensing danger, you and Paimon decide to head over to investigate...

quests.description_chs: 成功造访了地脉紊乱点通向的秘境，并在其中经历了一番战斗，是时候向刻晴和夜兰回报情况了…
quests.description_en: Having successfully ventured into the Ley Line disturbance's hidden Domain and emerged victorious from its trials, it's time to report back to Keqing and Yelan...

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你遇见了一个很爱听书的人…
quests.description_en: You run into someone who loves listening to stories in Liyue Harbor...

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你遇见了一个帮人作画的人…
quests.description_en: You bump into a painter who offers free souvenir paintings for tourists in Liyue Harbor...

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你看见了一个奇特的游艺摊位…
quests.description_en: You come across a strange stall in Liyue Harbor...

quests.description_chs: 新的房间…已经开启？
quests.description_en: A new room... has opened?

奥藏山上，仙迹缥缈…
quests.description_en: Atop Mt. Aocang, you find traces of an adeptus...

quests.title_chs: 冒险家协会的诸多事宜
quests.description_chs: 岚姐似乎正因为冒险家协会承接的一些委托而发愁…
quests.description_en: Lan seems to be fretting over some of the commissions that the Adventurers' Guild has undertaken...

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港的风波过去后，城里的一切事情似乎都在慢慢发生变化…而伊凡诺维奇先生，正在努力让自己适应这种变化…
quests.description_en: The storm in Liyue Harbor has passed, and all aspects of life within the city are slowly undergoing changes... For Ivanovich, this means working hard to adapt to said changes...

quests.title_en: Words Worth Their Weight in Mora
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港的那场风波过去后，璃月人对历史的兴趣突然浓厚了起来。「万文集舍」的生意十分红火，纪芳都有些应付不过来了…
quests.description_en: The recent crisis that beset Liyue Harbor has reinvigorated interest in history. Wanwen Bookhouse has seen a resurgence in business as a result, and its owner Jifang is on the verge of being overwhelmed...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的小女孩畅畅想找个人帮忙给一只小狗喂点吃的…
quests.description_en: Changchang from Liyue Harbor is looking for someone to get some food for a little puppy...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的嘉义似乎又陷入了麻烦之中，正想找人帮忙…
quests.description_en: Jiayi from Liyue Harbor has gotten himself tangled up in more troublesome affairs, and is looking for some help...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的那场风波虽然平息了，但那场风波也让璃月港开始了变化。诗人清昼正试图用自己的诗来捕捉这种变化…
quests.description_en: Liyue's crisis has settled down, but it has brought a wave of change to the city. The poet Qingzhou would like to capture these shifts in verse...

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里再次和那位曾经被关在笼子里的学者爱拉尼相遇了，她似乎还想研究什么东西…
quests.description_en: You meet Alrani, whom you once saved from a cage, in Liyue Harbor. She still seems to want to investigate something...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港飞云商会的阿旭正在为了一架名叫「留影机」的机器而苦恼…
quests.description_en: Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的岚姐似乎正在为了什么事而烦恼着…
quests.description_en: Lan of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 从千岩军大坤那边意外听说，之前毁掉的群玉阁似乎有重建的计划，一些小物件已经开始了筹备…
quests.description_en: You learn from a Millelith named Kun that there are plans to rebuild the previously destroyed Jade Chamber and that some small preparations to that end are already taking place...

quests.description_chs: 在群玉阁撞击了那个海里的东西后，海上还零星地飘着群玉阁的碎片，千岩军大坤正在找人来清理这些碎片…
quests.description_en: In the aftermath of the collision between the Jade Chamber and That Which Lies in the Deep, the sea remains dotted with floating fragments of the Jade Chamber. The Millelith soldier Kun is currently looking for help with the cleanup work...

quests.description_chs: 在望舒客栈的望雅小姐似乎有话想对你说…
quests.description_en: Wang'ya has something to say to you at Wangshu Inn...

quests.description_chs: 大多数璃月人都在享受海灯节，镖师黄衫却正在发愁…
quests.description_en: While most people from Liyue are enjoying the Lantern Rite, guard-for-hire Huangshan is currently in a bit of a fix...

quests.description_chs: 海灯节期间，望舒客栈里的工作让言笑有些不堪重负…
quests.description_en: Smiley Yanxiao from Wangshu Inn seems to be struggling with his workload during the Lantern Rite...

quests.description_chs: 轻策庄的小白似乎正为某事而做着准备…
quests.description_en: Ms. Bai from Qingce Village seems to be making some preparations...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的望雅似乎正在因为某事而烦恼着…
quests.description_en: Wang'ya from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 望舒客栈的菲尔戈黛特似乎正因为某事而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Something is bothering Verr Goldet, boss of the Wangshu Inn...

quests.description_chs: 在大家抬头仰望霄灯漫天的美丽景象时，千岩军宏宇却在头疼…
quests.description_en: While everyone else is lifting their eyes up to the lovely sight of Xiao Lanterns in the sky, Millelith soldier Hongyu is having a headache...

quests.description_chs: 学者索拉雅似乎正在天衡山中调查什么事…
quests.description_en: The scholar Soraya seems to be investigating something in Mt. Tianheng...

quests.description_chs: 佳节已至，轻策庄的阿芷却在为药材的问题而烦恼…
quests.description_en: The festival is in full swing, but Zhi of Qingce Village is trying to remedy a herb-related predicament...

quests.description_chs: 望舒客栈的言笑似乎正忙得不可开交…
quests.description_en: Wangshu Inn's chef, Smiley Yanxiao, seems to have a lot on his plate right now...

依照花散里的说法，要完成「神樱大祓」，就必须破解结界五处，并清除被逼出来的「污秽的化身」。除了绀田村与那间荒废神社，另外三处结界与雷樱树根分别位于：镇守之森、荒海、以及神里屋敷之外的滩涂地下。在这期间，她似乎会在绀田村井下的树根处待命。
quests.description_en: Hanachirusato says that in order to complete the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, one must break the barrier in 5 places and destroy the "defilement incarnate" that will then come forth. Besides Konda Village and the abandoned shrine, there are three other places where the barrier surrounds the Thunder Sakura roots: Chinju Forest, Araumi, and below the tidal flats outside the Kamisato Estate. She says that she will await you at the Thunder Sakura root below the well in Konda Village.

quests.description_chs: 五处结界已经破除，其中的妖物也被肃清。是时候前往绀田村井下的雷樱树根处，向花散里复命了。
quests.description_en: The five barriers have been broken and the evil within has been purged. Time to report back to Hanachirusato at the Thunder Sakura root beneath the well in Konda Village.

quests.description_chs: 在奇异的狐狸雕像前，戴着面具的神秘巫女似乎有事相求…
quests.description_en: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...

quests.description_chs: 根据花散里的说法，破除这些结界是「净化」雷樱树根所必需的。下一处结界似乎就在绀田村东北方的荒废神社中。虽然听起来是令人颇为不安的地方，但既然是花散里拜托的事情，那就去看看好了。
quests.description_en: According to Hanachirusato, these barriers must be broken to cleanse the Thunder Sakura's roots. The next barrier seems to be located in the abandoned shrine to the northeast of Konda Village. Although the place sounds quite unsettling indeed, this is Hanachirusato's request, so it is best that you see it done.

quests.description_chs: 在镇守之森，似乎有一位花散里的「老朋友」，应当能为「神樱大祓」提供帮助。但在其中，听到了奇异的呼叫声。
quests.description_en: You learn that an old friend of Hanachirusato's can be found in Chinju Forest. Perhaps they might be able to help out with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. But while in the forest, you hear a strange shout.

quests.description_en: The ancient ruins of what is now called Fort Mumei rises slowly from beneath the waves. Amidst the cries of whales and waves, you can hear a hidden, ancient grudge...

quests.description_chs: 八酝岛深为「祟神」所困，仍然留在岛上的矿工梶先生似乎正在寻找抑制其增生的方法…
quests.description_en: Yashiori Island is deep in the throes of the Tatarigami's effects. Still, a miner named Kaji remains on the island, seemingly searching for a way to inhibit the corruption's proliferation...

quests.description_chs: 前往约好的地点，向梶回报情况吧。
quests.description_en: Head to the agreed-upon location and report back to Kaji.

quests.description_chs: 游医保本正在八酝岛上彷徨，似乎急需外界的帮助…
quests.description_en: The traveling doctor Yasumoto is currently wandering Yashiori Island, urgently seeking outside help...

quests.description_chs: 已经过去了许多天，不知保本的疗法研究是否有了效果…？$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 役人广海似乎在烦恼着什么，或许正需要人去帮忙…
quests.description_en: Commission Officer Hiromi seems to be vexed about something. Perhaps he could use some help...

quests.description_chs: 海渊的孑遗花草，竟拥有预示命运的奇妙功效？
quests.description_en: Does ancient plant life from the ocean's depths really have the wondrous power to indicate one's destiny?

quests.description_chs: 逝去的好友，绝迹的海兽…是悲伤的回顾，或是新生的开始？
quests.description_en: Lost friends, extinct sea creatures... Is this a sad reminiscence, or the beginning of a new life?

quests.description_chs: 来自须弥的学者爱拉尼小姐似乎又想到了一个全新的论文主题…
quests.description_en: The researcher from Sumeru, Alrani, seems to have come up with a new idea for her thesis...

quests.description_chs: 泽维尔似乎正在为某事而烦恼…

quests.description_chs: 从稻妻冒险家协会的凯瑟琳小姐那里，你得知稻妻冒险家协会最近正在招募冒险家前往清籁岛进行探索…
quests.description_en: You learn from Inazuma's Katheryne that the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild has been gathering adventurers to explore Seirai Island recently...

quests.description_chs: 来到清籁岛后，你遇见了两位冒险家，他们似乎正在研究一种叫做「镇石」的东西。但跟随着猫的足迹，你来到了一座破败的神社，里面有一只自称「浅濑神社代宫司」，名叫「寝子」的猫。在帮助「寝子」修好了神社中的「塞钱箱」以后，它将封印「镇石」的方法告诉了你。而且，如果能将这座清籁岛上的四座「镇石」全部封印的话，说不定就能平息清籁岛上的雷暴…
quests.description_en: After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.

quests.description_chs: 这一次，是大伴先生想要尝试蒙德风格的诗歌了，不知道产生怎样的火花…
quests.description_en: This time, it is Ootomo who wants to try his hand at writing Mondstadt-style poetry. Who knows what literary sparks might fly this time?

quests.description_chs: 某位枫丹的玩具制造商似乎正在为制造的原料苦恼…
quests.description_en: A toy merchant from Fontaine seems to be struggling with the source materials of his products...

quests.title_chs: 进军玩具市场·能源储备
quests.title_en: A-Toymaking We Shall Go: Energy Storage
quests.description_chs: 伯特兰的机器似乎已经完成了对于素材的处理，接下来应该进入下一道工序的准备工作了…
quests.description_en: Bertrand's machine seems to have finished processing the materials. One process down — now for the next...

quests.title_chs: 进军玩具市场·核心动力
quests.title_en: A-Toymaking We Shall Go: Core Propulsion
quests.description_chs: 终于要进行玩具制造的最后一道工序了，只要完成这道工序的准备工作，进行制作，就能够生产出玩具吗…
quests.description_en: At last, the final step in the toymaking process has arrived. If you complete this final step, production can begin proper, but will this process really produce any toys?

quests.title_chs: 进军玩具市场·大量生产

quests.description_chs: 三道工序已被验证，但是伯特兰似乎还有别的事要拜托你…
quests.description_en: The three processes have been successfully verified, but Bertrand still seems to have something else to ask of you...

quests.title_en: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!
quests.description_chs: 「荒泷极意堂堂斗虫大试合」举办得似乎相当成功，是时候回到场地，看看荒泷一斗和「花角玉将」切磋得怎么样了…
