quests.description_en: Ruijin from Liyue Harbor is promoting a new "game"...

quests.description_chs: 每年第一个月圆之夜，就是璃月的「海灯节」。在夜里，人们会放出「霄灯」和「明霄灯」，升上夜空。「霄灯」中编入了天然浮空的「浮生石」，挂上书写心愿或绘制图画的愿签放飞，祈愿历史上曾护佑璃月的英雄魂魄寻灯归来，一聚团圆。你与派蒙来到了节日期间的璃月，准备度过为期五日的旅程…$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: Every year, on the day of the first full moon, the Lantern Rite of Liyue takes place. On that night, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and Mingxiao Lanterns into the bright night sky. Within each of the xiao lanterns, placed a natural levitation stone, and on it hung one's wishful prayer, or a painting depicting one's desire. The lanterns slowly fly away while carrying a hope that the lights emitted by the lanterns might guide the soul of once Liyue's faithful protector, to return and reunite once more. You and Paimon have arrived at this solemn moment of Liyue, preparing for your five-days-long journey...

quests.title_en: Water Beneath the Lanterns Flows Deep
quests.description_chs: 在海灯节，最重要的一项活动，就是在第五日的夜晚放飞巨型花灯「明霄灯」。今年的「明霄灯」壮景可期。用来让巨灯浮空的那块「浮生石」，是二十年来最大的一块。为此，璃月的商人们开设了「霄市」，筹集建灯所用的材料。今天你来到「霄市」时，负责操办节日事宜的慧心，似乎有事想要拜托你…$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: The most awaited moment of the Lantern Rite is the time when a giant Mingxiao Lantern released into the sky on the night of the fifth day. And the size of the Mingxiao Lantern this year is a sight that you don't want to miss, as the levitation stone used to make the giant lantern float this year is the biggest in 20 years. On this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have prepared a Xiao Market, which was built using the same materials as the lanterns. When you arrived at the Xiao Market, the event organizer Huixin asked you for a favor...

quests.title_en: In the City of Geo Live the Adepti
quests.description_chs: 在码头上，大量堆放着建灯所用的易燃材料。而在成堆的材料之间，你见到了形影鬼祟的可疑人士。可疑人士不愿被打扰，呵斥着要你离开。你与派蒙望向木、纸、油……堆积的景象，心中升起了不好的预感。于是你前往璃月总务司，向千岩军的守卫报告了情况。不知他们处理得怎么样了？事关重大，你决定再去打听一番。$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: Materials which are used to make lanterns are all easily flammable, and they're piling up at Liyue's port. Between the mountains of materials, you saw a mysterious figure, which shortly got annoyed by your presence and told you off. You and Paimon shared a look and stared at the piles of wood, paper, and oil... You have a bad feeling about this and you went to the Ministry of Civil Affairs to report the situation. Now you're wondering how they're handling the situation, and you've decided to go and see.

quests.title_en: To My Old Friend, Wind Brings My Greetings
quests.description_chs: 为忙碌至极的千岩军稍微搭了把手以后，终于有一个小队表示，可以抽出人力来加强戒备了。而怀疑此事只是杯水车薪的你，回到了现场，想要再发现一些有用的线索或踪迹。出乎意料地，在堆放易燃材料的现场，你遇到了同样在查看可疑痕迹的璃月仙人——魈。建设现场角落的暗处，被人画下了一个符号。「如果在仙与魔的世界，有什么东西失去桎梏，那就是我的责任。」「但这次的威胁来自人类的世界——你们的世界，所以这是你的责任，人类旅者。」仙人是这样对你说的。为了问明这个符号的来历，你想到了之前在蒙德结识的那位，黑白通吃、游走于灰色地带的骑士…$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: After receiving your help, Millelith is finally able to assign a little group to reinforce their defenses around the city. Unsatisfied with the lack of effort from them, you've come back to the area hoping to find more clues. To your surprise, you met Xiao, a Liyue adeptus who also has the same intention as you. You both discovered that there are some markings at the corners of the construction site. "If a shackle within the realm of deities and demons got loose, I shall take full responsibility." "But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world —— your world, and thus, you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler." said the adeptus to you. To decipher the markings and to learn its origin, you're reminded of that person that you've met in Mondstadt, a knight who prioritizes results above all else without caring about every trivial law...

quests.description_chs: 从凯亚的线人那里，你了解到那是跨境黑道组织「盗宝团」的联络符号。事情的真相似乎没有先前猜测得那么可怕。盗宝团的璃月分部，刚才接到了一封匿名信。在魈的威名威慑之下，盗宝团将那封信交给了你。信的主人要求盗宝团高层与他在璃月某处密会，有大事相商。再次地，在魈的威名威慑之下，真正的盗宝团成员同意让你假扮高层，前往信中地址，在约定的时间与匿名信主会面…$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: Through Kaeya's informant, you found out that it's a kind of communication marking used by the Treasure Thieves, a criminal organization spanning across Teyvat. It seems this whole thing is not as serious as you originally thought. The Treasure Thieves in Liyue just received an anonymous letter. Out of fear and respect for Xiao, the Treasure Thieves gave the letter to you. The sender requested that someone of high rank from the Treasure Thieves meet with them secretly in Liyue to discuss an important matter. Once again, out of fear and respect for Xiao, they agreed to let you play as a high ranking official of the Treasure Thieves and meet the mysterious sender.

quests.title_en: Mysterious Islands: Journey to the Unknown
quests.description_chs: 许久不见可莉了，去骑士团探望她吧！
quests.description_en: Long time no Klee — let's go visit her at the Knights of Favonius headquarters!

quests.title_chs: 夏日征程！千万要注意安全
quests.description_chs: 看似独立于一切地域之外的海岛，却藏有大量不为人知的机关和秘密。一行人暂时在此驻扎，开启了共同的临海夏日生活…
quests.description_en: Though these islands seem completely cut off from the rest of the world, they are somehow chock-full of hidden secrets and mysterious mechanisms. The party settles here for now and starts to get a taste of island life in the summer...

quests.title_chs: 海中魔王！静候已久之人
quests.title_en: Dodo-King of the Sea: Lying in Wait
quests.description_chs: 众人从芭芭拉口中得知，周围似乎又有了新的变化。这一次，线索会指向什么？这片海岛背后究竟藏有多少故事，又会在什么时候放出新的「惊喜」呢？
quests.description_en: The party learns from Barbara that their surroundings seem to be changing once again. Where will the trail lead this time? How many stories lay buried among these islands? And who know what the next surprise will be?

quests.title_chs: 最终谜题！秘藏至今的答案
quests.title_en: The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered
quests.description_chs: 经过共同努力，一行人找到了解除最终机关的方法。真相变得触手可及，然而，可莉却十分紧张。一直以来静静存在着的答案，究竟是…？
quests.description_en: Thanks to a joint effort, the party finds the key to solving the final riddle. The truth behind these islands is now within reach, but Klee seems to be more anxious than ever. What is the truth that has quietly sat in wait all this time?

quests.title_chs: 一筷食二轮烹三餐尽欢四海扬名五味俱全
quests.title_en: One for the Foodies, Two for the Show
quests.description_chs: 馋虫发作的派蒙拉着你去万民堂吃好吃的，刚巧遇到了正在动脑筋的香菱…
quests.description_en: Paimon, ever-gluttonous, pulls you over to Wanmin Restaurant for a good meal. There, you happen to meet Xiangling, who is deep in thought...

quests.title_chs: 六情通七仙贺八方飘香九霄得闻十分完满
quests.title_en: Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go
quests.description_chs: 大赛在即，你和派蒙去万民堂找香菱…
quests.description_en: With the finals looming, you and Paimon go to Wanmin Restaurant to look for Xiangling...

quests.description_chs: 海浪，波涛，夏天的竞技赛就在眼前，全力以赴，绝不能落败！
quests.description_en: The billowing waves of summer competition are just around the corner. Full speed ahead, mateys! Failure is not an option!

quests.description_chs: 最关键的一战即将到来，你们将回到「诀箓阴阳寮」中，会合「公子」与「式大将」，解开所有谜题…
quests.description_en: The time for the critical battle has arrived. You return to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and meet up with Childe and Shiki Taishou. Time to get to the bottom of all these mysteries...

quests.description_chs: 这场风波已然平息，你和派蒙准备造访「式大将」，查看「诀箓阴阳寮」的近况…
quests.description_en: This storm has passed. You and Paimon prepare to visit Shiki Taishou again to see how the Mystic Onmyou Chamber is doing...

quests.description_en: Paimon has an odd thought and drags you off to the Mondstadt alchemy shop...

quests.description_chs: 异想天开的派蒙拉着你一同到蒙德城炼金铺向砂糖和蒂玛乌斯提出自己大胆的设想，被告知这类问题最好请教博学的阿贝多。你们动身前往雪山，然而，在那里等着你们的却是…
quests.description_en: Paimon, struck by a bout of imagination, drags you off to the alchemy store in Mondstadt to expound her bold hypothesis to Sucrose and Timaeus, but is told that the best person to answer such questions is, in fact, the scholarly Albedo. However, the person waiting for you there is...

quests.description_chs: 被冒险家协会邀请担任冬令营教官的你们与留在雪山进行研究工作的阿贝多达成共识，分头调查，试图了解雪山上究竟发生了什么。迈向真相的路似乎有些坎坷，一路上，新的事件不断发生…
quests.description_en: Having been invited to serve as instructors at the Adventurers' Guild winter camp, you reach an agreement with Albedo, who is also conducting research in the mountains, to find out what happened here. The path towards the truth is winding and long, and you keep encountering new things...

quests.description_chs: 被冒险家协会邀请担任冬令营教官的你们与留在雪山进行研究工作的阿贝多达成共识，分头调查，试图了解雪山上究竟发生了什么。迈向真相的路似乎有些坎坷，一路上，新的事件不断发生…
quests.description_en: Having been invited to serve as instructors at the Adventurers' Guild winter camp, you reach an agreement with Albedo, who is also conducting research in the mountains, to find out what happened here. The path towards the truth is winding and long, and you keep encountering new things...

quests.description_chs: 你们带着故事回到雪山，前往营地与阿贝多会合。未知的秘密，或许就藏在这座神秘又危险的雪山之中…

quests.description_chs: 稻妻城里的小绿似乎正为什么事而烦恼…

quests.description_chs: 在璃月的竺子似乎正在为了什么事情而烦恼…

quests.title_en: O Archon, Have I Done Right?
quests.description_chs: 翔太诚心供奉的神龛突然不再给他回应，他正寻求着旅行者帮助…
quests.description_en: The shrine that Shouta has been giving sincere offerings to has stopped giving him replies. He seeks you out for help...

quests.description_chs: 朝仓追查到了海乱鬼的行踪，讨伐海乱鬼，夺回武器的时机到了…
quests.description_en: Asukara has discovered the Kairagi's whereabouts. The time has come for a rematch to reclaim his weapon...

quests.description_chs: 「八重堂」的编辑荒谷似乎有什么事想要找人帮忙…
quests.description_en: Aratani, an editor at the Yae Publishing House, seems to have something she'd like a little help with...

quests.description_chs: 勘定奉行柊家的大小姐柊千里想拜托你把一封信送给她的心上人九条镰治…
quests.description_en: Chisato, lady of the Hiiragi Clan, which leads the Kanjou Commission, requests that you help her bring a letter to her sweetheart, Kujou Kamaji...

quests.description_chs: 据璃月港的凯瑟琳小姐说，在稻妻的鸣神岛上，你们似乎还能见到她…
quests.description_en: According to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor, you will be able to find her on Narukami Island as well...

quests.description_chs: 顺吉似乎又在因为创作的事而苦恼…
quests.description_en: Junkichi seems to be struggling with his writing again...

quests.description_chs: 海祇岛的岩田似乎正在因为某事而烦恼…

quests.description_en: Learning that the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri was successfully conducted, you prepare to go pay Kokomi a visit...

quests.description_chs: 为了涤除黑暗，你们需要激活位于渊下宫边陲三角处的光界锥凿。

quests.description_chs: 阿祇推荐循序渐进地攻略三塔。现在需要稍作休整…

quests.description_chs: 阿祇推荐循序渐进地攻略三塔。现在需要稍作休整…
quests.description_en: Tsumi recommends a step-by-step approach to taking on the three towers. Time to take a short break...

quests.description_chs: 虽然解决了三角三界之塔，渊下宫的黑暗被涤荡一空。但是大日御舆处反而出现了不安的黑云…
quests.description_en: Although you solved the issue of the towers of the three realms in the three corners, and the darkness covering Enkanomiya has been cleared, a specter of unease still hangs over the Dainichi Mikoshi...

quests.description_chs: 在奇异的狐狸雕像前，戴着面具的神秘巫女似乎有事相求…
quests.description_en: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...

What the Blue Flowers Left Behind
A New Painting in Pale Scarlet

随盛夏一同到来的还有一封神秘来信。见字如晤，寄信者似乎在等什么人…
quests.description_en: As summer comes into its own, you receive a mysterious letter. "To Whomsoever Finds This Letter" — the sender seems to be waiting for someone...

quests.title_en: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description_chs: 到海岛的第一天姑且算得上平静。然而次日一早，事情就变得有些奇妙…似乎无论如何也平静不下来了。受异象指引，众人来到一处小岛，在那里，他们竟见到一座本不该出现在这里的盆景…
quests.description_en: The first day on the island was rather peaceful, yet things start to get strange the next morning... and this seems to only be the beginning. You and the others trace the strange phenomena to an island and find a bonsai that is not supposed to be there.

quests.title_en: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description_chs: 触碰盆景，众人进入一片不可思议的幻境。古老的宅邸，沉眠多年的家族往事…这里与枫原万叶有着千丝万缕的联系。
quests.description_en: After touching the bonsai, everyone enters some kind of mysterious mirage — an old mansion where the long-forgotten past of a clan resurfaces... This place is intimately linked to Kaedehara Kazuha.

quests.title_en: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description_chs: 随着进一步探索，幻境展现出了更为奇特的形貌。摇摇欲坠的景象，或许正是万叶一路走来所见。不知这种种坎坷，又能在他心中构筑出何种「景」。
quests.description_en: As you explore further, the mirage becomes ever more peculiar. Perhaps the decrepit view is a reflection of what Kazuha has been through. You wonder how those hardships he experienced will shape the view in his heart.

quests.description_chs: 根据莫娜的占卜结果，众人登上另一座小岛。静候于那处的，是造型奇特又极富个性的植物，远远看起来就像…咦，这不是乐器吗？
quests.description_en: Following the result of Mona's divination, the party heads to another island. There, you see a strangely shaped plant which looks like... some kind of musical instrument?

quests.description_chs: 烈焰之花「火炽之心」请众人为其找来唤醒嗓音的泉水。之后，「火炽之心」送众人前往音乐殿堂。幻境中的城镇，其模样像极了璃月港…
quests.description_en: After drinking the spring water you found for her and recovering her voice, the fiery flower named "Blazing Heart" sends you and the others to the hall of music. The city in the mirage is strikingly similar to Liyue Harbor...

quests.description_chs: 植物与乐器、音符与回忆、故人与家乡…点点滴滴，都是构成辛焱心中「音乐」的要素。属于她的幻境诞生在这样一座特别的岛屿上，一定有什么原因。
quests.description_en: Plants and instruments, melodies and memories, old acquaintances and her hometown... All of them constitute a crucial part of Xinyan's music. There must be some reason that her mirage has shown up on this special island.

quests.description_chs: 鉴于菲谢尔迟迟未归队，众人决定先一步在岛上探索，验证占卜结果说的下一片幻境是否存在，又属于谁。很快，大家就找到了沙滩上的夜鸦雕像，和一本它所带来的奇妙书籍——《圣国的咏唱》。通过触碰它，众人进入了书中的幻境…
quests.description_en: Fischl has not returned, so the party decides to explore the island first and confirm whether there is a mirage as the divination result indicated and to whom it belongs. Soon, everyone finds a night raven statue, along with a mysterious book that it has brought here — Hymn of the Holy Land. After touching the book, you and the others enter the mirage within...

quests.description_chs: 高耸入云的城堡、萦绕耳畔的传奇故事…这一切，应当就是菲谢尔心中的「世界」了吧。她的幻境是如此惊人，令每一位来访者赞叹。然而，绮梦并非毫无代价，美丽的花朵常诞生于荆棘丛…
quests.description_en: A lofty castle, an unforgettable tale... This must be Fischl's imaginary world. Her mirage is so amazing that every visitor is deeply impressed. However, a mesmerizing dream does not come without a price, just as beautiful flowers often bloom among thistles and thorns...

quests.description_chs: 另一位菲谢尔——她诞生自黑暗，正君临此地主宰幽夜净土的一切。恐惧与懦弱是否能吞噬心灵？两位皇女，谁又能成为最终赢家？
quests.description_en: There is another Fischl here — born from the darkness, she dominates everything in Immernachtreich. Can fear and cowardice devour souls? Which one of the two Prinzessinnen shall triumph in the end?

quests.description_chs: 不需要更多占卜，众人前往最后的岛屿寻找下个幻境。
quests.description_en: Without the need for further divination, everyone heads to the final island in search of the next mirage.

quests.description_chs: 来自莫娜心底深处的自言自语唤起了许多古老回忆。对于占星术，莫娜有着独特的见解，无论人们是否认可，她都相信「命运」。带着这份信念，她带领众人进一步探索幻境…
quests.description_en: Upon hearing the voices deep within her heart, Mona becomes lost in some old memories. She has a unique understanding of Astrology and believes in fate regardless of what others think. With this belief in her heart, she leads everyone to explore the mirage...

quests.description_chs: 无垠的星空，浩瀚庞大，涵盖了所有命运。多么不可思议，这片静静存在于幻境中的美丽星空有着极为宽广的胸怀，古老又温柔，似乎是怀抱着对命运的向往和对众人的怜悯而生。莫娜对命运的解读，也如它一般。
quests.description_en: The vast expanse of the starry sky extends endlessly into the distance, with many a fate hidden within. It is simply fascinating: The beautiful sky stands silently in the mirage, its bosom wide and vast, its very existence ancient and gentle, as if it was born to embrace all hankerings after destiny and to grace everyone with its compassion. Mona understands fate in a way similar to this starry sky.

quests.title_en: Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie
quests.description_chs: 为查明真相，众人再次前往神秘装置所在地进行调查。
quests.description_en: To find out the truth, everyone returns to the location of the mysterious machine to investigate.

quests.description_chs: 丰收季到来，蒙德的冒险家协会开始接到大量居民的求助委托，你和派蒙也收到凯瑟琳的求援赶回了蒙德…
quests.description_en: As the harvest season arrives, the Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild has received a great number of requests from the citizenry. You and Paimon have also arrived back in the city in response to Katheryne's call for aid...

quests.description_chs: 雷泽为了了解自己的人类父母，决定亲自动手制作「千风佳酿」。不过，温迪的诗歌中提到的几种酿酒材料，究竟是什么呢…
quests.description_en: Razor decides to make some Thousand-Wind Wine personally to better understand his human parents. However, which ingredients, specifically, was Venti's song referring to?

quests.description_chs: 骑士团为雷泽提供的酿酒材料，似乎已经准备得差不多了，到西风骑士团去看看吧。
quests.description_en: The Knights have provided Razor with the ingredients he needs, and preparations seem to almost be complete. Head over to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to check in on them.

quests.title_en: The Most Fantastic Tournament You've Never Heard Of?
quests.description_chs: 须弥的人们正在逐渐返回平静的日常生活，你和派蒙却在寻求委托任务的途中，发现了一块奇怪的告示牌…
quests.description_en: The people of Sumeru are gradually returning to their peaceful daily lives, but you and Paimon notice a strange sign while on your way to find new commissions...

quests.description_chs: 「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」的预赛开始了，是时候和「咚咚小圆帽」并肩作战，对阵其他的驯兽师了！
quests.description_en: The Nilotpala Cup qualifiers have started. Time to fight alongside Bongo-Head against other beast tamers!

quests.description_chs: 听闻海妮耶的激进言论后，你们似乎又多了一个夺冠的动机：不能放任那位驯兽师胡来…
quests.description_en: After learning about Haniyyah's prejudice against Fungi, you seem to have one more reason to win: You won't let her do anything reckless!

quests.description_chs: 「月莲杯」的比赛仍在继续。收集了大量线索后，事情似乎出现了某种转机…
quests.description_en: The Nilotpala Cup continues. With many clues collected, new opportunities seem to have emerged.

quests.title_chs: 最强的对手！至大的危机！
quests.title_en: The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!
quests.description_chs: 决赛的这天终于到来了。能否改变海妮耶的观念，合情合理地安置蕈兽伙伴，全都在此一举！
quests.description_en: It is the day of the grand finale. Can you change Haniyyah's mind and find a proper way to help the Fungi settle down? Everything hinges on your success!

quests.description_chs: 约定的时间已到，该和蕈兽伙伴们暂时分别了…
quests.description_en: It's about time to say goodbye to your shroom buddies...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏彩蛋$HIDDEN
听说试胆大会正在举行，要不要去社奉行看看呢…
quests.description_en: You heard that the Test of Courage is being held. Maybe you should head to the Yashiro Commission to have a look...

quests.description_chs: 在第一轮试胆大会上遇到了一些「异样」，而第二轮试胆大会也悄然开始…
quests.description_en: You encountered something peculiar in the first round, and the second is just about to begin...

quests.description_chs: 本以为一切都是小妖怪引发的误会，没想到背后似乎还有隐情…
quests.description_en: You thought it was all a misunderstanding caused by youkai, not expecting there to be a secret behind it all...

quests.title_en: A Thousand Miles for an Enigmatic Tune
quests.description_chs: 海灯节前夕，派蒙和你回到了璃月，打算在此度过一段难忘的节日时光…
quests.description_en: You return to Liyue with Paimon in anticipation of yet another unforgettable time at the Lantern Rite Festival...

quests.title_en: A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul
quests.description_chs: 早些时候，甘雨与你相约，共同寻找故事中女子的线索。现在，约定的日子已经到了…
quests.description_en: You and Ganyu had agreed to look separately for clues about the woman in Dvorak's story. Now, it's time to meet up...

quests.description_chs: 为了参加「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」，需要向工作人员贝尔福领取关键的道具「意智宝珠」。$HIDDEN
一场奇妙的比赛在奥摩斯港拉开了帷幕…
quests.description_en: A fabulous tournament is well underway at Port Ormos

quests.description_chs: 到了胡桃定好的饭局时间，你跟着派蒙一同前往新月轩赴约…
quests.description_en: It's now time to attend Hu Tao's dinner. You head to Xinyue Kiosk with Paimon in tow...

quests.description_chs: 临近「风花节庆典」，派蒙和你回到了节日氛围浓厚的蒙德，尝试接到不一样的委托…
quests.description_en: As the Windblume Festival approaches, you and Paimon return to Mondstadt, grasped in the throes of festivity, and take on a rather different commission than you are used to...

quests.description_chs: 尽管现有的线索寥寥无几，你和砂糖仍努力想要解开预言中的谜题…
quests.description_en: Even though the clues are few and vague, you and Sucrose continue to work at uncovering the mystery behind the prophecy...

quests.description_chs: 朋友们纷纷答应提供关于谜题的线索及思路，你满怀期待地等到了约定的时间，打算与砂糖进一步汇总信息…
quests.description_en: Your friends have promised to provide clues and new ideas to solve the riddle. You expectantly wait at the agreed upon time, planning to convene and go over all you have learned with Sucrose...

quests.description_chs: 派蒙不知从哪里听来了有关「学院庆典」的消息，到教令院去打听一下详情吧。
quests.description_en: Paimon heard from someone or somewhere news about the Akademiya Extravaganza. Head to the Akademiya and ask around for details.

quests.description_chs: 学院争霸赛来到了第二轮，这一次比赛地点在沙漠。到阿如村的分会场看看吧…
quests.description_en: The Interdarshan Championship has entered the second round. This round takes place in the desert. Head to the Aaru Village sub-venue to see how things are going...

quests.description_chs: 第二轮比赛落幕，心里却总有些事放不下…
quests.description_en: The second round has come to an end, but there are some matters that haven't been resolved...

quests.description_chs: 时间慢慢过去，不知道阿拉夫有没有调查清楚绑架案的真相？
quests.description_en: Time passes by. You're not sure if Aarav has completed his investigation behind the kidnapping case and uncovered the truth yet...

quests.description_chs: 伴随着才识之冠破裂，一切终于迎来结束。到主会场参加为卡维举办的颁奖仪式吧。
quests.description_en: With the breaking of the diadem, all has come to an end. Head to the main venue and join Kaveh's award ceremony.

quests.title_chs: (test)风花节活动任务一阶段隐藏对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)风花节活动任务一阶段隐藏对话$HIDDEN
「召唤王大奖赛」堂堂开幕！殊不知，在比赛背后，还藏着一个惊天大新闻…
quests.description_en: The King of Invokations Grand Prix is underway! Unbeknownst to all, however, there is an even more startling event hiding in its shadow...

quests.title_en: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
quests.description_chs: 惊天一掷！璃月赛区风云迭起！然而，幕后的谜团却愈行愈奇…
quests.description_en: With the cast of the dice, a series of duels arise in Liyue. Yet, the enigma behind the scenes grows ever more peculiar...

quests.description_chs: 世纪之战！决赛桌前雷雨翻腾，古今纷争于此作结！
quests.description_en: These duels are once in a century! Each table is a storm of activity, and old grudges will be settled on this day!

quests.description_chs: 真相大白！一段云谲波诡的旅途！没想到在卡牌之中，还有着这样的宝藏…
quests.description_en: The truth is revealed! What an unpredictable turn of events!

quests.description_chs: (test)3.7大活动隐藏任务$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: A Mysterious Missive on Paper Wings
quests.description_chs: 似乎琴团长有什么事想要寻求协助，那就去西风骑士团看看究竟是什么事吧！
quests.description_en: It appears that Master Jean needs assistance with something. Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and see what it is!

quests.description_chs: 触摸瓶子以后，真的进入到了一处秘境之中，只是里面并没有秘境主人的身影。看来，为了找到发出「神奇邀请函」的人，必须得深入这个秘境了…
quests.description_en: After touching the bottle, you really do enter a Domain, but the owner is nowhere to be seen. If you want to find the sender of the "Magic Invite," you'll need to go deep into the Domain...

quests.title_chs: 疾速观览，切记行车规范
quests.title_en: Zip Along (According to Safe Cart Operating Procedures)
quests.description_chs: 为了修复「琉形蜃境」中的巨大轮縠，就得取得掉落在了不同地区的零件。可莉说他们查探的区域出现了巨大的峡谷…
quests.description_en: To repair the great wheel in the Veluriyam Mirage, you must obtain components that have been dropped in different locations. Klee said that a giant canyon appeared in the area they were investigating...

quests.title_chs: 聚众游园，点亮夏日灯火
quests.description_chs: 修复核心轮縠的第三个零件落在了北边的密林之中，之前伊迪娅说，优菈要寻找的表亲似乎也到这个区域去了，不知有没有她要找的人的线索…
quests.description_en: The third component of the Central Hub fell in the forest to the north. Idyia mentioned that the cousin Eula was searching for has gone to this area as well. Perhaps you'll be able to find something that hints at his whereabouts...

quests.title_chs: 树屋剧场，烛影摇晃舞台
quests.description_chs: 出发前去寻找最后一个零件吧！
quests.description_en: Go look for the last missing part!

quests.title_chs: 恢复如初，银瓶裹藏的故事
quests.title_en: Back to Normal: The Story Hidden in the Bottle
quests.description_chs: 终于取回了所有零件，这下终于可以使秘境修复运转了，一切隐瞒之事，一定都将在秘境的核心中揭晓吧…
quests.description_en: After retrieving all of the components, the Mirage can finally be returned to working order. All that was hidden will be revealed at the hub...

quests.description_chs: 听说蒙德和璃月合办了一场活动，打听到消息的你们准备前去一探究竟…
quests.description_en: You hear that Mondstadt and Liyue are hosting a joint event and decide to take a look...

quests.description_chs: 行游采风、寻物赏景…在吟诗作对的欢笑间，似有淡淡的哀情显现…
quests.description_en: You take a stroll while taking in the scenery for poetic inspiration. As you share your verses with each other, there seems to be a faint sense of sorrow amidst the joyful laughter...

quests.description_en: In order to help Leyla find his spirit, Citlali plans to get more info from within the tribe, but how successful was she...?

quests.description_chs: 按照茜特菈莉的计划，今天就是将勒拉的灵性引导回身体的日子，你们能否顺利完成这件事呢…
quests.description_en: According to Citlali's plan, today's the day to guide Leyla's spirit back to his body. But will everything go off without a hitch...?

闲来无事，到「回声之子」逛逛吧。
quests.description_en: Since you've got a free moment, why not take a walk around the Children of Echoes?

quests.description_chs: 上半场表演赛，卡齐娜看起来有什么心事，去找她问问吧。
quests.description_en: In the first half of the exhibition match, Kachina seems to have something on her mind. Go and ask her about it.

quests.description_chs: 在得知了上一次荣花演武的惨淡收场，以及小绒翼龙安杜的事情后，众人决定为它做些什么。为此还需要其他伙伴们的配合…
quests.description_en: Everyone decided to do something after hearing about how badly the last Bloomflower Trials went, and what happened to the little Qucusaur Antu. However, you'll need help from your other friends...

quests.title_chs: 璃月港佳节兴，八奇现瘴疠隐
quests.title_en: Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity
quests.description_chs: 海灯节如期而至，今年的璃月港又在发生一些什么故事呢…
quests.description_en: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...

quests.title_chs: 往生堂三日无主，玉京台遣将调兵
quests.title_en: The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops
quests.description_chs: 海灯节如期而至，今年的璃月港又在发生一些什么故事呢…
quests.description_en: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...

quests.title_chs: 奇门术息灾平昏寿，护摩法净世定幽冥
quests.title_en: Qimen Arts and the Rite of Homa, the Spirits are Calmed and Life Restored
quests.description_chs: 两天过去了，你们打算去往生堂看看胡桃回来了没有…
quests.description_en: After two days have passed, you decide to visit the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor to see if Hu Tao has returned...

quests.title_en: Final Stanza: The Sanctification of Tao Dou
quests.description_chs: 在众人的努力下，边界危机终被化解。璃月港里，香菱好像有什么事情找你…
quests.description_en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the border crisis has finally been resolved. It seems that Xiangling has something she wants to talk to you about in Liyue Harbor...

quests.description_chs: (test)5.2大活动欧洛伦送礼$HIDDEN

quests.title_chs: 来自刺玫会的经营学问
quests.description_chs: 准备停当后，你和派蒙在娜维娅的引导下，开始学习如何经营「海薇玛映影欢乐城」…
quests.description_en: After all is set, you and Paimon turn your attention to learning how to run the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland under Navia's guidance...

quests.title_en: As Though Caught in a Dream
quests.description_chs: 八重神子久违地送来了一封书信…
quests.description_en: You receive a long-awaited letter from Yae Miko...

quests.description_chs: 「三川花祭」的会场附近突显异象，似有暗流涌动…
quests.description_en: Strange phenomena have suddenly appeared near the venue for the Mikawa Flower Festival. Dark undercurrents seem to be forming...

quests.description_chs: 「二重身」与「噩梦」的真相俱已水落石出。往日因果纷至沓来，今日种种亦真亦幻。
quests.description_en: The truth behind the doppelgangers and nightmares has been revealed. The actions of the past send ripples through fate, and the events of today blur the line between dreams and reality.

quests.description_chs: 我知道这好梦，如露水般短暂，然而，然而。
quests.description_en: I know that sweet dreams are as fleeting as the morning dew. And yet...

quests.description_chs: 出于好奇与关心，你决定和派蒙回枫丹廷逛逛。
quests.description_en: Out of a mixture of curiosity and concern, you and Paimon head back to the Court of Fontaine for a stroll around.

quests.title_en: A Series of Twists and Turns
quests.description_chs: 经过了一段时间，你们决定再访沫芒宫，查看龙伙伴的情况。
quests.description_en: After some time, you decide to return to the Palais Mermonia to check up on your Saurian friend.

quests.description_chs: 沫芒宫传来消息，看来是时候做出行动了。
quests.description_en: A message arrives from the Palais Mermonia. Seems like it's time to make a move.

quests.description_chs: 经过大家的努力，映影欢乐城经营得热火朝天。你终于得闲，准备和伙伴们闲聊一番…
quests.description_en: Thanks to everyone's hard work, the Film Fantasyland is now in full swing. You finally have some free time to chat with your companions...

quests.description_chs: (test)5.5纳塔大活动隐藏父任务$HIDDEN
夏日已至，在派蒙的提议下，你们前往遗珑埠品尝解暑祛火的绿茶，却意外遇见了正在忙碌的夜兰…
quests.description_en: Summer is here, and, following a suggestion from Paimon, you head to Yilong Wharf to sample some refreshing green tea. On your way, you unexpectedly run into Yelan, who appears to be right in the middle of something...

quests.title_en: An Instant of Intoxication, A Meeting by Moonlight
quests.description_chs: 彻底摧毁「黑钱领主」的摩拉除痕团体后，夜兰总算得到了闲暇的时间，邀请你在枫丹共度假期…
quests.description_en: After thoroughly dismantling the Dark Financier's money laundering operations, Yelan can finally take a well-deserved break. She invites you to Fontaine to spend a vacation together...

quests.description_chs: 行动的时间将近，是时候前往遗珑埠的港口与夜兰会合了…
quests.description_en: The time to act is almost upon you. It's time to head to Yilong Wharf and meet up with Yelan...

quests.description_chs: 追查「黑钱领主」的线索即将收束在拍卖会上，做好万全的准备后，你们要动身前往德波大饭店了…
quests.description_en: All the clues surrounding the Dark Financier point to the auction. After making your final preparations, you get ready to visit the Hotel Debord...

quests.title_en: Dun Dun Dunnn! A Major Crisis!
quests.description_chs: 正在挪德卡莱游历的你决定去那夏镇逛一逛…
quests.description_en: As you travel through Nod-Krai, you decide to take a stroll around Nasha Town...

quests.title_chs: 那些古怪又让人思索的问题
quests.description_chs: 在奥摩斯港，似乎听到了几个教令院的学者正在为什么而争吵，靠近听听究竟发生了什么事吧？
quests.description_en: You seem to have caught wind of some Akademiya researchers arguing in Port Ormos. Might as well listen in and find out what's going on, right?

quests.title_en: Boong Boong Bwoooom! A Grand Plot!
quests.description_chs: 约定的日期到了，你们动身前往那个「非法黑市」进行调查…
quests.description_en: The appointed time has arrived. You move to investigate the illegal black market...

quests.title_en: Boom Boom Boooom! A Grand Battle!
quests.description_chs: 与雅珂达约定日期到了，不知她是否带回了好消息…
quests.description_en: The time you agreed upon with Jahoda has arrived. You wonder if she brings good news...

quests.title_en: Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast!
quests.description_chs: 数日的纷扰终于告一段落，你和派蒙决定再去探望爱诺一次…
quests.description_en: The troubled days have come to an end. You and Paimon decide to pay Aino another visit...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述
重返须弥，你与派蒙遇到了一些老朋友…
quests.description_en: Returning to Sumeru, you and Paimon run into some old friends...

quests.description_chs: 到了约定的时间，是时候去沙海中探寻真相了。
quests.description_en: The appointed time has come. Seek out the truth in the sea of sand.

quests.description_chs: 可莉已经选好了心仪的玩具…
quests.description_en: Klee has picked out her favorite toy...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
为了给冒险家们提供一些助力，挪德卡莱的冒险家协会也向爱诺发出了订单…
quests.description_en: To provide assistance to Nod-Krai's adventurers, the Adventurers' Guild has also placed an order with Aino...

quests.description_chs: 月矩力试验设计局与爱诺的工坊之间似乎也存在业务往来…
quests.description_en: It seems the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has business with Aino...

quests.description_chs: 为了救回伙伴，爱诺设计了备用方案…
quests.description_en: Aino's working on a backup plan to save her friends...

quests.title_en: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage
quests.description_chs: 白雪纷飞时，你们回到了龙脊雪山脚下…
quests.description_en: As the white snow flutters down, you return to the foot of Dragonspine...

quests.title_en: Promise You Won't Waste Your Youth
quests.description_chs: 共同的爱好将你们吸引到一起…
quests.description_en: A shared hobby brings you all together...

quests.title_chs: 现在不是撒娇哭泣的时候
quests.description_chs: 「我菲耶蒂娜最喜欢做的事情之一，就是对认为我不行的人说：不行。」
quests.description_en: "Some people think I'm not enough. I have two words for those people: Think again."

quests.description_chs: 现在该为梦想而奔跑了，拼尽全力吧！
quests.description_en: Now's the time to run for your dreams, give it everything you've got!

quests.description_chs: 瑶瑶和七七在准备零食和饮料…
quests.description_en: Yaoyao and Qiqi are preparing snacks and drinks...

quests.description_chs: 海灯节到了，今年的璃月港又有什么新变化呢？
quests.description_en: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?

quests.description_chs: 从兰拉迦那里听说有兰那罗在降诸魔山附近调查可疑的「那菈」，不知道会不会和维摩庄孩子失踪的事情有关…
quests.description_en: You heard from Araja that the Aranara were investigating a suspicious Nara near Devantaka Mountain. You wonder if it has anything to do with the missing kids at Vimara Village...

quests.description_chs: 名叫拉娜的女性似乎是须弥的巡林官。应她的邀请，去「维摩庄」看看吧。
quests.description_en: The woman who goes by the name of Rana seems to be a Forest Watcher of Sumeru. Accept her invitation and travel to Vimara Village.

quests.description_chs: 为了将想到的事情整理成能让孩子们也觉得有趣的版本，和派蒙一起费了不少功夫。孩子们对故事满意，真是太好了。虽然孩子们对「神秘生物」的态度十分可疑，不过目前也无法太过深究。接下来，就随拉娜一同去清理一些死域吧。再怎么说，也是为了让维摩庄的孩子们能安全地玩耍。
quests.description_en: You and Paimon put in a good amount of hard work to sort your stories into a version that the children might find interesting. Thankfully, they like your stories. Although they don't seem to have told the truth about the mysterious creatures, this isn't the time to go into detail. Now, go with Rana to clear out some Withering Zones. You're doing this so the children of Vimara Village can play safely, after all.

quests.description_chs: 拉娜标记的死域也清理了，棘冠鳄的问题也处理了。这下应该不用担心维摩庄的孩子们了。与拉娜一同回去吧。
quests.description_en: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.

织梦之森主题任务$UNRELEASED
织梦之森主题任务$UNRELEASED

quests.title_en: Variations on the Song of the Dragon and Freedom
quests.description_chs: 第二天的测试也圆满结束，在一场快乐的宴会后，你终于迎来了第三天，也就是故事结局部分的测试…
quests.description_en: The second day's tests have come to a successful close. After a joyful banquet, the third day finally arrives. It's time to test the story's ending...

quests.description_chs: 布伦妮似乎在忙着记笔记…
quests.description_en: Prune seems to be busy taking notes...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN
根据兰帕卡提所说，看到袅袅升起的烟柱，就能找到她在外进行「烹饪修行」的哥哥们，得在无忧节开始前，把他们找回来才行…
quests.description_en: According to Arapacati, the rising pillars of smoke will lead to her brothers who are doing "cooking training." We need to find them and bring them back before the festival starts...

quests.description_chs: 幕后的罪犯终于上钩，而来自璃月总务司的夜兰和来自枫丹执律庭的夏沃蕾则罕见地展开了合作。不过，对于她们来说，需要考虑的问题不仅仅是抓捕罪犯…
quests.description_en: The criminal puppetmaster lurking in the shadows has finally taken the bait. Yelan from Liyue's Ministry of Civil Affairs and Chevreuse from Fontaine's Maison Gardiennage have embarked on a rare joint operation. However, apprehending the perpetrator isn't the only issue they have to ponder...

quests.description_chs: 在夜兰的帮助下，你们找到了阿梵波谛的藏身之处。那里有一段被黄沙掩埋的往事，以及整个案件的真相…
quests.description_en: With Yelan's help, you locate Ashvapati's hideout. There lies a past buried beneath the yellow sands, and with it, the truth behind the entire case...

quests.title_chs: 返乡吧，来自沙漠的孩子们
quests.title_en: Return Home, Children of the Desert
quests.description_chs: 事情终于告一段落，而至于如何处置阿梵波谛，大家似乎都有自己的想法…
quests.description_en: The case has finally been resolved. However, when the question of how to deal with Ashvapati arises, everyone appears to have a different opinion...

quests.title_en: If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams
quests.description_chs: 「面团大王」和它的同族按照约定来到小魔女们的秘密基地，还带来了新的线索…
quests.description_en: The Dough King and its kin have come to the little witches' secret base, and they even bring new clues with them...

quests.description_chs: 在众人的努力下，拯救幻想朋友的行动有了新进展…
quests.description_en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, you've made progress in the operation to save the imaginary friend...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
早柚又睡着了？
quests.description_en: Sayu's fallen asleep again?

quests.description_chs: 最近是千灵映影节，不如回枫丹一趟，说不定能遇到些老朋友呢？
quests.description_en: The Fontinalia Film Festival is coming up. Why not head back to Fontaine? You might just run into some old friends there.

quests.description_chs: 在见朋友之前，她似乎想先解决自己的「错谬」…
quests.description_en: Before meeting her friends, she seems intent on resolving "anomalies" within herself first...

quests.description_chs: 获得了「第二次出生」的她，会想要做些什么呢…
quests.description_en: Now that she has been "born anew," what will she choose to do next...?

quests.description_chs: 映影成功上映，而她似乎也变了不少…
quests.description_en: The film premiere is a success, and she seems to have changed much...

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title_chs: 膏腴土地下的唤雨之曲
quests.title_en: A Prayer for Rain on the Fecund Land
quests.description_chs: 四散在桓那的法留纳神机的「枝」与「叶」都已治好，按兰般度的说法，终于可以去清除啃噬法留纳神机的根系的坏虫了…
quests.description_en: The "branches and leaves" of the Varuna Contraption that were scattered in Vana were all healed. In Arapandu's words, it's time to get rid of the bad bugs gnawing on the roots of the Varuna Contraption...

quests.description_chs: 在罗因贾和阿玛兹亚的帮助下，获知了机关碎片的所在地。其中之一就藏在被水淹没的洞窟之下…
quests.description_en: You've located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a submerged cavern...

quests.description_chs: 在桓那兰那接到了兰帕卡提的委托，帮忙寻找进行料理修行的哥哥们，就按兰帕卡提所说，寻找袅袅升起的烟柱吧。
quests.description_en: You received a commission from Arapacati in Vanarana to help look for her brothers who are practicing cooking. Do as Arapacati says and look for the rising pillars of smoke.

quests.description_chs: 根据兰茶荼的说法，他的兄弟兰阿帕斯在水天丛林附近进行「烹饪修行」，在水天丛林附近寻找烟柱袅袅升起之处吧！
quests.description_en: According to Arachatora, his brother Arapas is doing "cooking training" close to Apam Woods. Look for a pillar of smoke near Apam Woods!

quests.description_chs: 根据兰茶荼的说法，他的兄弟兰非拉在降诸魔山附近进行「烹饪修行」，在降诸魔山附近寻找烟柱袅袅升起之处吧！
quests.description_en: According to Arachatora, his brother Araphala is doing "cooking training" close by Devantaka Mountain. Look for a pillar of smoke near Devantaka Mountain!

quests.title_chs: 与珍稀之鸟的短暂邂逅
quests.title_en: A Short Encounter with a Rare Bird
quests.description_chs: 在须弥的森林里碰到了调查生态的巡林员谢夫凯特，之后据说会进行「暝彩鸟」的调查，他真的能成功抓到暝彩鸟吗？
quests.description_en: You bumped into a Forest Ranger, Shefket, who's carrying out ecological research in Sumeru's forests, and he told you about his Dusk Bird research. Can he really capture a Dusk Bird?

quests.description_chs: 在林间道路上，见到了一位被蕈兽攻击的人。无论如何，不能放着遇到困难的人不管。
quests.description_en: Someone is being attacked by Fungi in the woods. You hurry to help them.

quests.description_chs: 终于再次见到了神秘的「兰那罗」。按照兰拉娜的说法，要帮助拉娜，需要前往「桓那兰那」，取得惟耶之实。而进入兰那罗的世界，需要奏响「大梦的曲调」。回维摩庄，看看阿玛兹亚爷爷有没有可以出借的乐器吧。
quests.description_en: Finally, you meet the mysterious Aranara again. According to Arana, you need to visit Vanarana and find Bija to help Rana. Moreover, you have to play the Rhythm of the Great Dream before getting to the world of Aranara. Head back to Vimara Village, and ask Amadhiah if he has any instrument that you can borrow.

quests.description_chs: 终于可以进入「遗迹巨像」中一探究竟了。如果能够启动这台「遗迹巨像」的话，一定可以轻而易举地打开通往地下遗迹的入口…
quests.description_en: You were finally able to get inside the Ruin Golem. If it can be activated, gaining access to the underground ruins should be a simple matter...

quests.description_chs: 误打误撞总算是打开了通往地下遗迹的入口。只要找到迪弗旧窟中的核心，就能弄清森林之「病」的真相…
quests.description_en: Somehow, you managed to open the entrance to the underground ruins. Once you find the core in the Dev's Cavern, the truth about the forest's "disease" will be unveiled...

quests.description_chs: 在罗因贾和阿玛兹亚的帮助下，获知了机关碎片的所在地。其中之一就藏在降诸魔山深处的洞穴中…
quests.description_en: You have located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a cavern deep within Devantaka Mountain...

quests.description_chs: (test)神秘的羊皮卷$HIDDEN
与森林中的兰那罗们经历了诸多冒险之后，离取得惟耶之实也越来越近了…？无论如何，去看看拉娜的情况吧。
quests.description_en: After all the adventures with the Aranara in the forest, we are getting closer to Bija... Right? Anyway, let's check on Rana first.

quests.description_chs: 与兰拉娜、拉娜告别后，随兰罗摩一同回到了桓那兰那。无忧节终于开始了。
quests.description_en: You returned to Vanarana with Arama after parting with Arana and Rana. It's finally time for Festival Utsava.

quests.description_chs: 为了结出惟耶之实、帮助拉娜，需要找到、帮助兰那罗们，为「无忧节」做准备。从兰罗摩手中得到的「森林书」，就用来记录与兰那罗的故事，以及冒险的线索吧。
quests.description_en: To acquire Bija and help Rana, you have to find and help Aranara, and prepare for Festival Utsava. As for the Aranyaka from Arama, it could be used to document the stories about Aranara, and clues for the adventure.

quests.description_chs: 在柯莱的小屋里，你发现了一盆花。但这盆花的状态似乎有些不太好…$HIDDEN
醒来之后，无忧节的景象已经从眼前消失，兰罗摩也不在身边。只有花环传来的细微香气提醒着这一切并不是梦。
quests.description_en: When you wake up, Festival Utsava is no more, and Arama is nowhere to be found. Only the faint fragrance from the garland tells you that this was not a dream.

quests.title_en: For the Children of the Past
quests.description_chs: 「觉王树」已经被侵蚀了。但兰罗摩似乎通过结出的果实，获得了新的知识、记忆与…说话方式。接下来，依他的说法，应当要消灭「无留陀的化身」，让新的「觉王树」长出来。如此，才能结出惟耶之实。
quests.description_en: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded. But from its fruit, Arama seems to have gained new knowledge, memories, and... manners of speech. According to Arama, you should eliminate Marana's Avatar next so that the new Ashvattha Tree may be born. Only then can the Bija be formed.

quests.title_chs: 为了一切向往生命的孩子们
quests.title_en: For All Children Who Long for Life
quests.description_chs: 接下来，只剩下最后应当消灭的敌人了。继续前进吧。要一直、一直前进下去。
quests.description_en: Now, only the final enemy awaits vanquishing. Continue forward. Never, ever, stop moving forward.

quests.description_chs: 终于得到了惟耶之实。是时候回去找拉娜了。
quests.description_en: Finally, you claimed the Bija. It's time to return to Rana.

quests.description_chs: 到了验证兰帕卡提的「哥哥们」「烹饪修行」成果的时候了。
quests.description_en: Time to witness the results of the "cooking training" of Arapacati's brothers.

quests.description_chs: 知识渊博的兰伊舍为无忧节准备了「好吃」的谜语。
quests.description_en: The resourceful Araesha has prepared "delicious" riddles for Festival Utsava.

quests.description_chs: 无忧节上，兰梨娄和兰难世似乎在争论什么…
quests.description_en: At Festival Utsava, Aralila and Aranishat seem to be fighting over something...

quests.description_chs: 兰犍多似乎想要玩「长鬓虎」与「兰那罗」的游戏。
quests.description_en: Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.

quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏对话仅做演示用$HIDDEN
解救被魔物包围的兰那罗
quests.description_en: Rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

quests.description_chs: 和考古小队一行离开了陷坑，接下来该前往哲伯莱勒所说的绿洲，做露营的准备了。
quests.description_en: You have left the pit with the archaeological team. Now it is time to head over to the oasis Jebrael mentioned and get ready to camp there.

quests.title_en: Look for and rescue the Aranara
quests.description_chs: 寻找并解救被魔物包围的兰那罗
quests.description_en: Look for and rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters

quests.description_chs: 在须弥的森林里有诸多奇怪的营地，每个营地都安装着一个奇怪的机器，愚人众似乎在利用这些机器做什么奇怪的事，还是调查一下吧……
quests.description_en: There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It's best to investigate this matter...

quests.description_chs: (test)死域观测站失落1$HIDDEN
在阿如村，有一个蒙德商人需要冒险家的帮助。
quests.description_en: In Aaru Village, there is a merchant from Mondstadt who needs help from adventurers.

quests.description_chs: 提尔扎德意外地打开了壁画之后隐藏的通路，不知道这条通路将会把我们带去哪里…
quests.description_en: Tirzad accidentally opened the hidden passage behind the mural. No one knows where it may lead...

quests.description_chs: 在绿洲留守的商人与驮兽可能遭遇危险，得赶快返回绿洲的营地确认纳赫蒂加尔的安危。
quests.description_en: The merchants and their Sumpter Beasts waiting in the oasis might be in danger. Hurry back to the camp in the oasis to secure Nachtigal's safety.

quests.description_chs: 你们在森林中遇到了一位名叫海亚姆的老人，他似乎曾与兰那罗们有着一段过往。不如回应他的求助…
quests.description_en: You meet an old man named Khayyam in the forest. He seems to share a past with Aranara. It should do no harm to respond to his request for help...

quests.description_chs: 在上次冒险结束后，兰纳真忘记了许多事情。但不管怎样，曾结识的新朋与旧友何尝那么容易忘怀呢？
quests.description_en: After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?

quests.description_chs: 帮助兰迦鲁击败了盘踞在茸蕈窟中的镀金旅团，但镀金旅团的目的，似乎与兰迦鲁忘却的一段友情有关…
quests.description_en: You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten...

quests.description_chs: 尽管失却的回忆如同流水般逝去不返，但友谊却随着时间得以新生…
quests.description_en: Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time...

quests.description_chs: 不知道兰利遮现在怎么样了…有空的话去找找他吧。
quests.description_en: You wonder how Ararycan is doing. Go find him when you have the time.

quests.description_chs: 在兰那罗居住的房子里发现了名为兰沙恭的兰那罗写的笔记，但是那个兰沙恭不仅失去了「勇气」，还打算去危险的地方，还是去看看吧…
quests.description_en: You found a journal by the Aranara named Arashakun in an Aranara house. Despite losing "courage," Arashakun still decided to venture into such a dangerous place. Go check the situation out...

quests.description_chs: 法留纳神机已经被治好，这下兰那库拉可以回去照料一直惦念着的苗圃了。喜欢与泥土和种子作伴的兰那库拉不仅会培育普通的植物，还在桓那兰那照料着一块特别的苗圃…$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: The Rhythm that Leads to the Gloomy Path
The Rhythm that Nurtures the Sprout

quests.description_chs: 桓那兰那的苗圃现在开满了甜甜花，如果法莎也能亲眼见到这一切，她也一定会很开心吧！
quests.description_en: There are so many Sweet Flowers in Vanarana's garden now. Varsha would be ecstatic to see it for herself for sure.

quests.description_chs: 为了寻找能打开「遗迹巨像」的「阿麦塔机关」，你决定跟随罗因贾前往维摩庄的「秘密基地」…
quests.description_en: To find the Amiti Device to open the Ruin Golem, you decided to follow Royinjan to a secret base in Vimara Village.

quests.title_en: The Rhythm that Reveals the Beastly Trail

quests.description_chs: (test)用来计数的任务,完成12个苗圃种植, 并且完成无忧节后可以和兰纳罗对话获取奖励$HIDDEN
根据枫丹的猎人「桑顿」所说，过度生长而又有领地意识的「凶猛动物」在居民区附近，对于居民和这些动物来说都是很危险的事。这些家伙分别是「长鬓虎罗阇」，「鳄鱼大王」和「驮兽大王」，找到他们的踪迹，并驱逐他们吧！$HIDDEN
在须弥解开石头锁，解决封印中的怪物后，受出现的兰那罗委托，解决其他被锁住的怪物…
quests.description_en: After unlocking the stone lock in Sumeru, and defeating the monsters trapped in the seal, you will be entrusted by Aranara to defeat other sealed monsters.

quests.description_chs: 与桓那兰那的兰加惟谈谈，或许对无忧节的准备有帮助。
quests.description_en: Talk to Arakavi in Vanarana, which might help the groundwork for Festival Utsava.

quests.description_chs: 在阿如村遇见了与提尔扎德同属因论派的学者卡兰塔里…他似乎也在因为论文而苦恼万分，并试图向我们寻求帮助…
quests.description_en: While in Aaru Village, you meet another Vahumana researcher named Kalantari. He has been fretting over his paper lately and is seeking help...

quests.description_chs: 在沙漠某处的巨大遗迹机关前，教令官阿弗拉图似乎在苦恼些什么…
quests.description_en: Somewhere in the desert in front of a giant ruin machine, Mahamata Afratu seems to be troubled by something...

quests.title_chs: test隐藏-兰那罗小游戏-木箱下的东西1$HIDDEN
test隐藏-兰那罗小游戏-顺序击破1$HIDDEN

森之里神像-教学$HIDDEN
在桓那兰那，派蒙找到了「说不定是藏宝图」的画像…
quests.description_en: Paimon found a painting in Vanarana that could be a treasure map...

quests.description_chs: 通过「邮箱」的图画找到了更多的宝藏后，很久以前在层岩巨渊拾获的「种子」开始发出震颤…
quests.description_en: As more treasure was found through the "mailbox," the "seed" collected long ago in The Chasm begins to vibrate...

quests.title_chs: (test)检测兰那罗回家数量开宝箱$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: （test）打4个等级的boss$HIDDEN
距离「永恒绿洲」只剩下了最后一段路途，希望不会有意外发生…
quests.description_en: This is the final part of the journey to the Eternal Oasis. With any luck, this will prove a smooth trip...

quests.description_chs: 渔师凯万似乎遇到了某些麻烦…
quests.description_en: Kayvan the angler seems to be having some trouble...

quests.description_chs: 在教令院附近，你注意到了一个焦急的人…\n
quests.description_en: You see an anxious person near the Akademiya...\n

quests.description_en: You meet a strange person outside the forest.

quests.description_chs: 年轻的索赫尔在考古笔记中记录了在沙漠中的探险经历，其中提及的一些遗迹也许隐藏着宝藏与旧时的记录。再次进入沙漠深处探索吧。
quests.description_en: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

在沫芒宫里，利弗似乎正在为某事而苦恼…
quests.description_en: Livre seems to be fretting over something within the Palais Mermonia...

quests.description_chs: 诗黛小姐似乎遇见了麻烦…
quests.description_en: Staelle seems to be in a spot of trouble...

quests.description_chs: 枫丹廷里的伊莎朵似乎遇见了什么麻烦…
quests.description_en: Isadora from the Court of Fontaine seems to have encountered some trouble...

quests.description_chs: 在「灰河」之中，你遇见了两位似乎正在做游戏的小孩…
quests.description_en: You meet two children playing at the Fleuve Cendre...

quests.title_chs: 他们的童年·时光不等人
quests.title_en: Their Childhood: Time Waits for No One
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷里，你又遇见了奥雷勒和韦吕，他们似乎又在玩着什么游戏…
quests.description_en: You meet Aurele and Verut once again in the Court of Fontaine. They seem to be playing some game again...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷里，你又遇见了奥雷勒，韦吕和洛薇，但他们这次似乎没有玩游戏…
quests.description_en: You meet Aurele, Verut, and Lovi once again in the Court of Fontaine. They don't seem to be playing a game this time...

quests.description_chs: 某位生论派学者正在为她的心理疗法实验寻找志愿者…
quests.description_en: A certain Amurta researcher is looking for volunteers for her psychotherapy experiment...

quests.description_chs: 为了讲述「花之骑士不为人知的战斗」，毗伽尔和学者萨费伊正在筹备一场特别的活动…
quests.description_en: Vihar and the researcher Safi are currently preparing for a special event that will tell the tale of "The Unknown Battles of the Knight of Flowers"...

quests.description_chs: 在拜达港，你和派蒙遇见了久违的友人与奇妙伙伴…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon run into some old friends and incredible companions at Bayda Harbor...

quests.description_chs: 前往兰巴德酒馆附近放置茶桌并使用桑多涅落座后，与阿帽共度茶会时光吧…
quests.description_en: Go to Lambad's Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy...

quests.description_chs: 前往兰巴德酒馆附近放置茶桌并使用桑多涅落座后，与阿帽共度茶会时光吧…
quests.description_en: Go to Lambad's Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy...

quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·石头能不能开花
quests.title_en: A Gifted Rose: Can Stones Bloom
quests.description_chs: 阿凡的花种依然没有发芽，试着帮助失落的他吧。
quests.description_en: Affan's flowers still haven't sprouted. Try to help the disappointed fellow.

quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·来自往日的歌谣
quests.title_en: A Gifted Rose: Ballad of Days Gone By
quests.description_chs: 采取赛芭的建议，试着「唤醒」种子吧。
quests.description_en: Follow Sabbah's advice and try to "Awaken" the seeds

quests.title_en: Behold, the Sign Comes Like A Thief...
quests.description_chs: 尤夫腾似乎有一批货物被不明人士劫走了，要尽快追回才行。
quests.description_en: Yuften's goods appear to have been stolen by some unknown party. They need to be recovered.

quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的集市内，有两位工人面对着一个造型奇特的木刻唉声叹气，也不知道是为什么…
quests.description_en: For reasons unknown, two craftsmen are sighing over a unique carving in the open market of Port Ormos...

quests.description_chs: 小朋友们喜欢新的木刻吗？丹吉尔有改过自新吗？再去奥摩斯港看看吧。
quests.description_en: Did the kids like new carving? Did Tanger repent? Go to Port Ormos and find out.

quests.description_chs: （test）学院越野一阶段隐藏环$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: Treasure of Wisdom: A New Plan
quests.description_chs: 喜爱谜语的学者德鲁苏，最近似乎又有了新想法…
quests.description_en: Drusus, a researcher who loves riddles, seems to have a new idea recently...

quests.title_chs: 图书管理员的悠长假期
quests.title_en: A Librarian's Long and Carefree Vacation
quests.description_chs: 联络员阿芬迪正在为悉般多摩学院的一项长期研究寻找合适的志愿者…
quests.description_en: Effendi, the Akademiya's Liaison Officer, is looking for suitable volunteers for a long-term research project under the Spantamad Darshan...

quests.description_chs: 在奥摩斯港，你和派蒙偶然遇见了两位老朋友，他们似乎正在筹备着某种游戏…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon meet two old friends at Port Ormos. They seem to be preparing for a game of some sort...

quests.description_chs: 「灵蕈棋阵」的测试已接近尾声，是时候去给海妮耶和贝尔福一些反馈了…
quests.description_en: Fungus Mechanicus's testing phase is coming to a close. It's time to give Haniyyah and Balfour some feedback...

quests.description_chs: 在雨林西南的防沙壁一带，你和派蒙遇见了某位奇怪的学生，她似乎对你们印象深刻…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon meet a certain strange student by the Wall of Samiel to the southwest of the rainforest. She seems to have reason to remember the two of you...

quests.description_chs: 「震沸合剂」的试验取得了不错的进展，是时候去找哈贾娜德回报情况了…
quests.description_en: The testing on the Shock-Boiled Brews is progressing smoothly. It is time to report back to Hajanad...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Proposal
quests.description_chs: 在阿如村附近，你遇到了一名神色焦急的学者…
quests.description_en: Near Aaru Village, you encounter an anxious-looking researcher...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering
quests.description_chs: 一番奔波后，你帮维纳亚克收集了零件…
quests.description_en: After running about, you manage to help Vinayak gather the components...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Introduction
quests.description_chs: 在与两位学者约定的地点附近，你远远地听见了争吵的声音…
quests.description_en: Near the meeting spot with the two researchers, you hear a quarrel in the distance...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Testing
quests.description_chs: 你们意外地遭遇了沙虫的袭击…
quests.description_en: You were unexpectedly attacked by a Wenut...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Body
quests.description_chs: 经过三天的奔波，「对沙虫用杀虫炮」终于将展示它的威力…
quests.description_en: After three days of busywork, the Wenutslayer Cannon will finally showcase its power...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Demonstration
quests.description_chs: 伴随「对沙虫用杀虫炮」的轰鸣，沙虫应声落地…
quests.description_en: With a roar from the Wenutslayer Cannon, the Wenut falls to the ground...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Conclusion
quests.description_chs: 在与两位学者约定的地点附近，你又一次远远地听见了争吵的声音…
quests.description_en: Near the meeting spot with the two scholars, you once again hear the sound of a distant quarrel...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Presentation
quests.description_chs: 根据施芮娅的推论，你们成功地找出了病灶所在…
quests.description_en: Based on Shriya's reasoning, you have successfully found where the root of the problem is...

quests.title_en: The Culling of the Worms: Ending
quests.description_chs: 在沙漠中，你又一次看到了熟悉的身影，却没有听见熟悉的争吵声…
quests.description_en: In the desert, you once again see a familiar figure in the distance, but you don't hear the familiar arguing this time...

quests.description_chs: 多莉说她这里有学院庆典独家情报，要不要找她打听一下呢？
quests.description_en: Dori says that she has the latest update on the Akademiya Extravaganza. Why not go and hear it?

quests.description_chs: 上次从多莉那得到的消息似乎暗示了一些事，要不要再找她多打听一些情报？
quests.description_en: There seems to be something else behind what Dori has told you. Why not go and ask her for more information?

quests.description_chs: 又见到了多莉，问问她还有没有别的情报吧…
quests.description_en: You meet Dori again. Ask her if she knows something else...

quests.description_chs: 突然想起聚餐时卡维提到自己会去教令院待会儿，要不要去找他聊聊呢？
quests.description_en: Kaveh mentioned that he would be going to the Akademiya for some alone time. Perhaps you should go talk to him.

quests.description_chs: 一位璃月冒险家在须弥的河边面露难色，是遇到了什么难以解决的问题了吗…
quests.description_en: A visibly troubled adventurer from Liyue stands by the riverside in Sumeru. Is some kind of problem giving them grief...

quests.title_en: The Phantom Toy Master and the Barking Fox
quests.description_chs: 在「琉形蜃境」中漫步之时，你和派蒙发现了一位困顿之中的商人，或许有效帮助她以后，你们也能得到少见的回报…
quests.description_en: While taking a stroll through Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon notice a weary merchant. Perhaps giving her a hand may earn you a rare reward...

quests.description_chs: 偶然闯入某片「危险区」后，你和派蒙发现了一位特别的工程师，他正捣鼓的装置似乎大有来头…
quests.description_en: After stumbling into a "dangerous area," you and Paimon run into a special engineer who's tinkering with a promising contraption...

quests.description_chs: 在「琉形蜃境」的某地，你与派蒙撞见了一位开朗的学者，她正忙于抒发自己的情感，并邀请你们试玩某种游戏…
quests.description_en: Somewhere in the Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher who invites you to play a game...

quests.description_chs: 在「隐众游园」的关键区，某位言行奇诡的「轻剑舞者」像是从你们的身上感应到了某种重要的事物…
quests.description_en: In the main area of the Pavilion of Hermits, a strange "Blade Dancer" seems to have sensed something important from you...

quests.description_chs: 在路边遇到了一位有点眼熟的、正在唉声叹气的学者，去问问他发生了什么事情吧。
quests.description_en: You meet a familiar-looking researcher sighing by the side of the road. Go ask him what's wrong.

quests.description_chs: 实验完毕，将长效溢神剂的实验数据汇报给贾米吧。
quests.description_en: The experiment is complete! Report the data on the long-lasting Fayz Potion to Jami.

quests.description_chs: 听柯莱说，须弥城最近有些热闹，你和派蒙毅然决定前去看看发生了什么事…
quests.description_en: Collei tells you that Sumeru's been quite lively lately. As such, you and Paimon resolve to see what's going on...

quests.description_chs: (test)父任务描述$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
你从甘雨和岚姐处得知，蒙德璃月一带的盗宝团最近正准备联合起来，意图染指一座与「深渊教团」有关的遗迹。因为担忧盗宝团可能引起的混乱，你接下了调查此事的委托…
quests.description_en: You hear from Ganyu and Lan that the Treasure Hoarders of Mondstadt and Liyue have banded together and plan to get involved in some ruins associated with the Abyss Order. Fearing the chaos that the Treasure Hoarders might cause through their involvement, you take up the commission and investigate...

quests.description_chs: 在逃离了那座诡异的遗迹后，你意外地遇见了戴因斯雷布。跟随着他，你们再次对在遗迹中出现的「深渊使徒」展开了追迹…
quests.description_en: After fleeing from those creepy ruins, you meet Dainsleif by chance. You follow him and begin your pursuit of the Abyss Herald through those ruins once more...

quests.description_chs: 为了调查「深渊教团」的「信」中所提到的计划，你们决定先前往蒙德城的西风大教堂，向教会的人请教一下…
quests.description_en: To investigate the plan that the Abyss Order's talisman speaks of, you decide to head to the Cathedral in Mondstadt to consult the members of the Church.

quests.description_chs: 根据从芭芭拉与「北风的王狼」那里得到的线索，你们继续寻找着那台「世上第一座耕地机」…
quests.description_en: You continue searching for "the first Field Tiller," following the information you've obtained from Barbara and the Great Wolf King of the North...

quests.title_en: In the Depths, an Unexpected Reunion
quests.description_chs: 凯瑟琳小姐似乎有新的委托，去看看委托的内容吧。
quests.description_en: Katheryne seems to have a new commission for you. Go check it out.

quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊内，你居然意外地与戴因斯雷布再会了。在了解情况后，你们认为这里与深渊教团恐怕有千丝万缕的联系，于是展开了调查…
quests.description_en: You have an unexpected reunion with Dainsleif within The Chasm. After getting wind of the situation, you believe that this place must be intimately linked to the Abyss Order, and thus begin investigating...

quests.description_chs: 此地的黑蛇骑士其实对你们并无恶意，只是残留的意志驱使它们保护那些丘丘人而已。在发现了这座诡异城市中的一些秘密后，黑蛇骑士哈夫丹似乎有什么东西想要给你们看…
quests.description_en: The Black Serpent Knights present here do not, in truth, mean you ill. They are simply driven by their remaining instincts to defend those hilichurls. After you discover some of the secrets of this strange city, the Black Serpent Knight Halfdan seems to have something to show you...

quests.description_chs: 根据因提瓦特花朵上留下的双子的回忆，戴因斯雷布判断出了深渊教团的计划，只是还不知道是否来得及阻止…
quests.description_en: Dainsleif figures out the Abyss Order's plan from the twin's memories left within the Inteyvat flower. Now to see if you can stop them or not...

quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的马斯鲁尔先生正在为一封收信地址模糊的信而犯愁…
quests.description_en: Masrur at Port Ormos is currently worrying himself sick over a letter with an unclear address...

quests.description_chs: 篝火旁的一夜过去，你发现派蒙并不在身边。在找寻的时候，你邂逅了一位父亲…
quests.description_en: As night passes and you awaken next to the bonfire, you realize that Paimon is missing. As you search for her, you come upon a wandering father by chance...

quests.description_chs: 拯救卡利贝尔的药并没有如预想的那样发挥效果，在重新制药的过程中，你们似乎见到了某种诡异的现象…
quests.description_en: The medicine meant to restore Caribert didn't work quite as expected. During the process of remaking the medicine, you seem to find yourself beset upon by strange phenomena...

quests.description_chs: 之前发生的事情虽然诡异，但又的确引发了奇迹，卡利贝尔真的恢复了神智。可这之中是否存在着不为人知的「代价」呢…
quests.description_en: The previous events might have been mysterious, but miraculous. Caribert's consciousness has returned, and his mind is whole again. However, might this achievement bear a price yet unknown...

quests.description_chs: 「沃陆之邦」附近，你答应伊安珊帮忙巡逻。在此期间，你找到了一样完全出乎你意料的东西…
quests.description_en: Near the Collective of Plenty, you agree to help Iansan conduct a patrol. However, you stumble upon something completely unexpected...

quests.description_chs: 面对深渊教团对纳塔的进攻，你决定再去那个遗落了钥匙的山洞附近，寻找停止争斗的契机…
quests.description_en: Facing the Abyss Order's assault on Natlan, you decide to return to the cave where the key was lost, seeking a chance to end the conflict...

quests.title_en: A Space and Time Without You
quests.description_chs: 你与名为蒂莱尔的少女之间发生了诸多奇怪的事，深渊教团与纳塔之间的争斗也尚未休止。在这样的情况下，改变战局的人正在准备登场…
quests.description_en: Many strange events have unfolded between you and the girl named Direidyth, all while the conflict between the Abyss Order and Natlan rages on. Amidst this turmoil, the one who will shift the tides of war is preparing to take the stage...

quests.description_chs: 你们来到须弥的冒险家协会，凯瑟琳小姐似乎有一份非常棘手的委托要交给你们…
quests.description_en: You arrive at the Adventurers' Guild in Sumeru. Katheryne seems to have a very tricky commission for your docket...

quests.description_chs: 至今你们依然捕捉不到那位失踪男子的踪迹，但在深渊教团的魔物出现以后，你们见到了另一个熟悉的身影…
quests.description_en: You have heretofore been unable to track down the missing man, but you encounter a familiar figure after the creatures of the Abyss Order emerge...

quests.description_chs: 如戴因所猜测的，「虚假的记忆」是深渊教团的陷阱。此时地脉再次开始扰动，大概已经有事情在发生了…
quests.description_en: As Dainsleif guessed, the "false memories" are a trap laid by the Abyss Order. The Ley Lines are disturbed again. Something is probably underway once more...

quests.title_chs: (test)判断玩家是否在镜像大世界$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)判断玩家是否在镜像大世界$HIDDEN
兰帕卡提最近好像在为什么事情发愁…
quests.description_en: Something is bothering Arapacati lately...

quests.description_chs: 该任务主要用于测试任务表编辑器导出的数据是否正常接入数值发布流程$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: This quest was made to test the Quest Editor, to see if the output data accepts the parameter and executes the release process normally.

quests.title_en: Thesis Proposal: He Shall not Pass
quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港最近似乎有个关于「唉声叹气教令院学者」的奇怪传言，到底发生了什么事呢…
quests.description_en: Strange rumors are spreading in Port Ormos about a "groaning Akademiya researcher." You wonder what happened...

quests.title_chs: 崖边怪人与危险的研究？
quests.title_en: The Cliffside Weirdo and a Risky Study?
quests.description_chs: 听说在须弥城东面的山间，一位怪人正在徘徊…
quests.description_en: You hear that a strange person is wandering in the mountain to the east of Sumeru City...

quests.description_chs: 「重熔片剂」的试验进展顺利，是时候向哈贾娜德回报情况了…
quests.description_en: The testing on the "Remelting Tablets" is progressing smoothly. It is time to report back to Hajanad...

quests.description_chs: 化城郭的阿米尔需要八份兽肉。
quests.description_en: Amir from Gandharva Ville needs eight servings of Raw Meat.

quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的帕森需要十个墩墩桃。
quests.description_en: Peseng from Port Ormos needs ten Zaytun Peaches.

quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的卡姆拉需要十五个树莓。
quests.description_en: Kamla from Port Ormos needs fifteen Berries.

quests.description_chs: 须弥城的侯赛因需要十个香辛果。
quests.description_en: Housein from Sumeru City needs ten Harra Fruits.

quests.title_chs: 妲卡玛忒的白铁块需求
quests.description_chs: 须弥城的妲卡玛忒需要五个白铁块。
quests.description_en: Dwarkanath from Sumeru City needs five White Iron Chunks.

quests.description_chs: 大巴扎的库洛什需要十支须弥蔷薇。
quests.description_en: Kourosh from the Grand Bazaar needs ten Sumeru Roses.

quests.description_chs: 须弥城的雅瓦娜尼想要五个苹果。
quests.description_en: Yavanani from Sumeru City needs five Apples.

quests.description_chs: 须弥城的阿里娜需要五朵月莲。
quests.description_en: Arina from Sumeru City needs five Nilotpala Lotuses.

quests.description_chs: 须弥城的贾汉需要五罐糖。
quests.description_en: Jahan from Sumeru City needs five jars of Sugar.

quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的阿拉耶什需要两罐果酱。
quests.description_en: Arayesh from Port Ormos needs two jars of Jam.

quests.description_chs: 无人约束的镀金旅团正在作乱…
quests.description_en: The reckless Eremites are raging...

quests.description_chs: 愚人众正在作乱…
quests.description_en: The Fatui are rampant...

quests.description_chs: 无人约束的镀金旅团正在作乱…
quests.description_en: The reckless Eremites are raging...

quests.description_chs: 蕈兽正在作乱…
quests.description_en: Fungi are raging...

quests.description_chs: 蕈兽正在作乱…
quests.description_en: Fungi are raging...

quests.description_chs: 丘丘人正在作乱…
quests.description_en: The hilichurls are causing trouble...

quests.description_chs: 遗迹龙兽正在作乱…
quests.description_en: Ruin Drakes are raging...

quests.description_chs: 无人约束的镀金旅团正在作乱…
quests.description_en: The reckless Eremites are raging...

quests.description_chs: 遗迹龙兽正在作乱…
quests.description_en: Ruin Drakes are raging...

quests.description_chs: 蕈兽正在作乱…
quests.description_en: Fungi are raging...

quests.description_chs: 「三十人团」正在招募协助人员，如有意向，请至聚砂厅联络阿芬迪。
quests.description_en: The Corps of Thirty is hiring an assistant. Interested candidates, kindly contact Effendi at the Citadel of Regzar.
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「城市声望·须弥」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock City Reputation for Sumeru

quests.description_chs: 在须弥城附近，你遇见了一个奇怪的人…
quests.description_en: You run into a strange person near Sumeru City...

quests.description_chs: 女孩芭努独自一人在野外搜寻着什么…
quests.description_en: Banu is searching for something out in the wild all by herself...

quests.description_chs: 六颗未来星已经到手，是时候去找芭努了。
quests.description_en: You've collected all six Future Stars. Time to go see Banu.

quests.description_chs: 清泉镇外，忙着驱逐野林猪的猎人埃德蒙德，正在和一个须弥学生打扮的年轻人争论着什么…
quests.description_en: Outside of Springvale, the hunter Edmund, who is busying himself with chasing Forest Boars away, is arguing with a young man who is dressed like a student from Sumeru...

quests.description_chs: 晨曦酒庄一带最近也遭受了野林猪的侵扰，努力寻找雪猪踪迹的法拉比，今天刚好来到了附近…
quests.description_en: The area around the Dawn Winery has also been invaded by Forest Boars, and Farabi, who is trying his best to look for Snowboar traces, seems to be poking around that same area today...

quests.description_chs: 为了让自己的炼金术水平得以精进，蒂玛乌斯研制出了一座新型的炼金炉。但想要启动这座新型炼金炉，他似乎还需要另外的帮手…
quests.description_en: In an effort to hone his alchemical skills, Timaeus has designed an all-new alchemical furnace. There's just one problem — he needs some help to get it working...

quests.title_en: Target: Master of the Snowy Peaks!
quests.description_chs: 法拉比传来了消息，让你们和他在龙脊雪山汇合。今天的目标，似乎正是传说中的「雪山之主」…
quests.description_en: Farabi has sent a message asking you to meet him at Dragonspine. The target for today seems to be the legendary king of Snowboars...

quests.description_chs: 佳酿节的美酒集市附近新安置了一块公告板，到底是做什么用的呢…
quests.description_en: A new notice board has been placed near the Weinlesefest market. What is it for...?

quests.description_chs: 伯恩哈德听说你们参加了寻找「丰饶之箱」的活动…
quests.description_en: Bernhard has heard that you are participating in the Fecund Hamper event...

quests.description_chs: 佳酿节期间，名为莱妮的冒险家似乎正在筹办一场特别的挑战活动…
quests.description_en: An adventurer named Leni seems to be planning a special challenge event during Weinlesefest...

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城里，一位冒险家似乎正在招募人手…
quests.description_en: In Mondstadt, an adventurer seems to be recruiting people...

quests.description_chs: 3.1石板引导任务刷NPC的Group（test）$HIDDEN
你和派蒙漫步于白狐之野，本想享受难得的平和氛围，却还是遇上了意外的争斗…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon were having a stroll across the Byakko Plain, intending to enjoy some hard-come-by peace and quiet, but you come across an unexpected conflict nonetheless...

quests.title_en: The Sight of the Divine Emissary
quests.description_chs: 演武华服的投票结果即将揭晓…
quests.description_en: The voting results for Ayaka's outfit will soon be revealed...

quests.description_chs: 不知出了什么差错，演武华服的投票结果似乎出现了问题…
quests.description_en: Some sort of mistake seems to have been made in the voting process for Ayaka's outfit...

quests.description_chs: 某位枫丹的工程师似乎正在进行着什么深奥的研究…
quests.description_en: A certain engineer from Fontaine is currently performing some rather esoteric research...

quests.description_chs: 刹诃伐罗学院的达雅似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Daya from Kshahrewar seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 梨多梵谛学院的法尔博似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Farbal from Rtawahist seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 阿弥利多学院的帕兹似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Paz from Amurta seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 悉般多摩学院的巴哈多似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Bahador from Spantamad seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 伐护末那学院的丹纳似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Daneh from Vahumana seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 伐护末那学院的丹纳似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Daneh from Vahumana seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 室罗婆耽学院的巴哈尔似乎正在因为某事而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: Bahar from Haravatat seems to be busy with something...

quests.description_chs: 将米希尔、拉沙鲁带回甘露花海后，斯露莎终于获得了灵光的认可，得到了「双角的花冠」，成为了花灵之「勇者」。但何谓勇者的职责，祖尔宛似乎有话要说…\n
quests.description_en: After bringing Mihir and Rashnu back to the Vourukasha Oasis, Sorush finally earned the approval of the Khvarena, gaining the Twin-Horned Chaplet and becoming the Bloomguard. But with regard to the responsibilities of such a position, Zurvan seems to have a few things to say...\n

quests.description_chs: 按照祖尔宛的吩咐完成了一部分训练内容，斯露莎距离成为独当一面的花灵勇者又近了一步…\n
quests.description_en: After completing some of the training assignments recommended by Zurvan, Sorush grows closer to assuming the responsibilities of a Bloomguard...\n

quests.description_chs: 斯露莎的训练仍在继续，已存续数百年的沙虫结晶尚且有销蚀的一日，比它更为耐久的颂诗真的存在吗…\n
quests.description_en: Sorush's training continues. Even a Wenut crystallized across countless eras has a date of expiry. Could there possibly be an ode or poem that could outlast even such a being?\n

quests.description_chs: 谈及米希尔及纯水精灵的话题后，斯露莎似乎有些迷惘。祖尔宛交代的训练已经来到后半…\n
quests.description_en: After speaking of Mihir and the Oceanids, Sorush seemed to be at a loss. Zurvan's training has now progressed beyond its midpoint...\n

quests.description_chs: 斯露莎也意识到，原来不知何时踏上了谋虚逐妄的错路。训练内容已所剩无多…\n
quests.description_en: Sorush has finally realized that, at some point, she walked down a path of meaninglessness and absurdity. The training is approaching its conclusion...\n

quests.description_chs: 训练已经到了尾声阶段，离真正获得祖尔宛的认可只差最后一步…\n
quests.description_en: The training is approaching its conclusion. Zurvan's approval is but a step away...\n

quests.description_chs: 听说在野外有到处招揽人进行与镜子有关的奇怪活动的学者，去看看究竟怎么回事吧…
quests.description_en: You hear that there's a scholar out in the wild who's trying to recruit people to participate in a strange mirror-related activity. Maybe you should go take a look...

quests.title_chs: 参寻战记·为了儿时梦想！
quests.description_chs: 前两次碰壁并没有让兰吉特萌生退意，他能在须弥扳回一城吗？
quests.description_en: Despite two failures, Ranjit has no intention of backing down. Will he turn things around in Sumeru?

quests.description_chs: 在柯莱的邀请下，你和派蒙来到了全新的教令院机构「稳健知行」的会场，准备参与到这一机构的完善工作中去…
quests.description_en: At Collei's invitation, you and Paimon arrive at the venue of the Akademiya's newly-established "Fieldwise Center," ready to participate in its further development...

quests.description_chs: 在众人的协力下，「稳健知行」机构已趋于完善，走上了正轨，这段时间的忙碌总算告一段落…
quests.description_en: Thanks to everyone's combined efforts, the Fieldwise Center has been fully developed and is running smoothly. At last, this period of relentless work has come to a close...

quests.description_chs: 有位朋友在冒险家协会留了言，邀请你和派蒙前往拜达港，参观她的新店铺…
quests.description_en: A friend has left a message at the Adventurers' Guild, inviting you and Paimon to visit her new shop in Bayda Harbor...

quests.title_en: Behold the Grandeur, Seize the Splendor
quests.description_chs: 一番漫长的跋涉后，你们带着蕈兽伙伴抵达了首个「风景区」，确认了伙伴们的兴趣点，开始了这次特别的游览…
quests.description_en: After a long trek, you and your Fungi companions arrive at the first scenic spot. After confirming their points of interest, you begin your special tour...

quests.title_chs: 小小灵蕈乐园，准备开张
quests.title_en: A New Day at the Lil' Fungi Playground
quests.description_chs: 经过几天的游玩，你们带着蕈兽伙伴回到了拜达港的小小灵蕈乐园…
quests.description_en: After several days of travel and fun, you return to the Lil' Fungi Playground at Bayda Harbor, accompanied by your Fungi friends...

quests.title_en: Sightseeing With Friends: A Trip to Fontaine
quests.description_chs: 在纳塔游览一番后，你们即将带着蕈兽伙伴前往下一个派蒙推荐的景点…
quests.description_en: After wrapping up your trip through Natlan, you and your Fungi friends are off to the next destination on Paimon's list...

quests.title_en: Sightseeing With Friends: Back to Sumeru
quests.description_chs: 在外赏游一段时间后，派蒙有了新的计划…
quests.description_en: After traveling for some time, Paimon has a new plan...

quests.description_chs: 除了枫丹廷正前方的著名留影点，派蒙似乎还规划好了水下游览的线路…
quests.description_en: Besides the iconic photo spot right outside the Court of Fontaine, Paimon seems to have an underwater tour planned as well...

quests.description_chs: 对于须弥的游览与留影，派蒙有着独特的见解…
quests.description_en: Paimon seems to have her own thoughts about sightseeing and photo spots in Sumeru...

quests.description_chs: (test)听说大陆上来了一位新的商人，他身上带了很多有趣的奇珍异宝。$HIDDEN
在须弥，你遇见了一群熟悉的人…
quests.description_en: You bump into a group of familiar faces in Sumeru...

quests.description_chs: 在奥摩斯港里，你注意到了两个奇怪的人…
quests.description_en: You notice two strange individuals in Port Ormos...

quests.description_chs: 在须弥城里，你发现了一个很熟悉的地方…
quests.description_en: You find a familiar place in Sumeru City...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「地区委托·须弥」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock commissions for Sumeru

quests.title_chs: 加尔恰的赞歌·适配性赠礼
quests.title_en: Garcia's Paean: A Gift of Compatibility
quests.description_chs: 加尔恰先生似乎正在为某事而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Mr. Garcia seems to be troubled by something...

quests.description_chs: 「金砂之旅」的玛亚姆似乎有什么话想和你说…
quests.description_en: Maryam from Gilded Journey appears to want a word with you...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德冒险家协会的凯瑟琳似乎有话要对你说。
quests.description_en: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.

quests.description_chs: 随着调查深入，你逐渐发觉，这些陨石背后似乎藏有某种神秘力量。为了让陷入昏迷的大家醒来，你和同伴们不断清理着各地的陨石…
quests.description_en: As your investigation proceeds, you gradually realize that there is some mysterious power hidden within these meteorites. In order to help the victims regain consciousness, you and your comrades begin to dispose of meteorites throughout the land...

quests.title_en: What the Skies Conceal, the Water Reveals
quests.description_chs: 除了昏睡危机，愚人众的出现也让你心生怀疑。幸好，占星术士莫娜的到来成为了一针强心剂。在奇妙的占星术帮助下，你们逐渐深入谜团…
quests.description_en: Apart from the spate of unconsciousness caused by the meteorites, the appearance of the Fatui has also aroused your suspicions. Fortunately, the arrival of the astrologist Mona has given your efforts a much-needed boost. With the help of her mystical scrying techniques, you begin to delve into these mysteries...

quests.description_chs: 这些从天而降的陨石，曾是属于某个人的「命星」。古老的它因何坠落？燃尽的它要去向何方？带着直面答案的勇气，你逐步走向秘密。
quests.description_en: The meteorites that have rained down were once, in fact, part of someone's constellation. Why did this ancient array of stars fall from the sky? What goal were their extinguished flames chasing? Armed with the courage to face the answers, you march onward.

quests.description_chs: (test)控制活动氛围布置$HIDDEN

quests.title_en: That Which Fell From the Sky
quests.description_chs: 因为不断有陨石从天而降，野外也变得不太安全了。葛瑞丝修女十分担心那些还在野外逗留的人…
quests.description_en: Due to the constant descent of meteorites from the sky, it has become too unsafe to go outside. Sister Grace is very worried about those people who linger out there in the wild...

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的猎鹿人餐馆里有一份特别订单正等待着派送…
quests.description_en: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

quests.description_chs: 即使是在天降陨石的情况下，一部分西风骑士依然在野外执行任务。霍夫曼先生有些担心这些西风骑士…
quests.description_en: Even though rocks are falling from the skies, some Knights of Favonius are still attending to their duties outside the city. Huffman is rather worried about these knights...

quests.description_chs: 为了处理和陨石相关的诸多事宜，霍夫曼先生正忙得不可开交…
quests.description_en: Huffman is currently so busy with matters concerning the fallen meteorites, that he barely has time for anything else...

quests.description_chs: 坠落的陨石让蒙德城内外都乱成了一团。但是在这个时候，神秘的薇尔小姐却似乎有什么事想要找人帮忙…
quests.description_en: The fallen meteorites have turned Mondstadt upside down, inside and out. But it seems that the mysterious Vile is looking for people to help her out with a little something...

quests.description_chs: 对于那些从天而降的陨石，蒙德城冒险家协会的杰克似乎又有了一些新主意…
quests.description_en: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...

quests.description_chs: 因为陨石突降，千岩军嘉义回家探亲的计划又被迫取消了，他想要找个人帮自己带一封家书回轻策庄…
quests.description_en: Due to the meteor shower, Jiayi's plans to return home to see his family have been canceled yet again. He is looking for someone to send a letter to Qingce Village...

quests.description_chs: 大量陨石降落在了蒙德的野外，引起了一片混乱。蒙德城的维克多似乎丢了某件重要的东西，正在焦躁地自言自语…
quests.description_en: Many meteorites have landed outside the city of Mondstadt, wreaking havoc everywhere. Viktor appears to have lost something important, and is talking to himself, flummoxed...

quests.description_chs: 千岩军经纶正在为如何清理周围的魔物而烦恼…
quests.description_en: The Millelith soldier Jinglun is fretting about how to defeat the monsters around Qingce Village...

quests.description_chs: 对于那些从天而降的陨石，伊凡诺维奇似乎有了些新的生意点子…
quests.description_en: Ivanovich is getting ideas about what business might be done regarding those fallen meteorites...

quests.description_en: Many unexpected things have happened on this mountain. A mysterious hidden camp, suddenly-appearing thieves, uninvited enemies... This sword seems to have brought you into the thick of all this weirdness. So long as it remains in your hands, trouble will always follow in its wake — with such troubles including those who have come to take the sword, and new monsters heretofore unseen.
