quests.description_chs: 每年第一个月圆之夜，就是璃月的「海灯节」。  在夜里，人们会放出「霄灯」和「明霄灯」，升上夜空。 「霄灯」中编入了天然浮空的「浮生石」，挂上书写心愿或绘制图画的愿签放飞，祈愿历史上曾护佑璃月的英雄魂魄寻灯归来，一聚团圆。 你与派蒙来到了节日期间的璃月，准备在海灯节游玩一番…
quests.description_en: On the day of the first full moon each year, the people of Liyue celebrate Lantern Rite. At nighttime, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and the Mingxiao Lantern into the bright night sky. Each Xiao Lantern contains a piece of Plaustrite that makes it float, and people hang wish sticks from them, which carry their hearts' desires in written or painted form. The lanterns slowly fly away, carrying the hope that the light they emit might guide the souls of Liyue's faithful protectors home, that they might return and be reunited with their people once more. You and Paimon arrive in Liyue as the festival is in full swing, preparing to enjoy yourselves...

quests.description_chs: 在海灯节，最重要的一项活动，就是放飞巨型花灯「明霄灯」。 今年的「明霄灯」壮景可期。用来让巨灯浮空的那块「浮生石」，是二十年来最大的一块。 为此，璃月的商人们开设了「霄市」，筹集建灯所用的材料。 今天你来到「霄市」时，望雅似乎有事想要和你说…
quests.description_en: The highlight of Lantern Rite is the release of the giant Mingxiao Lantern into the sky, and this year's Mingxiao Lantern is supposed to be a sight well worth the wait. The Plaustrite that will lift the lantern into the air is the largest in twenty years! For this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have set up the Xiao Market to help gather the materials needed to build the lantern. When you arrive at the Xiao Market, one of the event organizers, Wang'ya, seems to have something to say to you...

quests.description_chs: 海灯节仍在继续，而你在魈、凯亚和千岩军的帮助下，挫败了一场让人啼笑皆非的「阴谋」，也将策划了这场「阴谋」的笨贼抓获，交给了千岩军处置。 今天，你准备按照约定去望舒客栈向魈回报这件事的情况…
quests.description_en: Lantern Rite is still ongoing. With the help of Xiao, Kaeya, and the Millelith, you have foiled a "plot" that has left you not knowing whether to laugh or cry and have succeeded in bringing the foolish criminal behind it to justice and handing them over to the Millelith. Today, you prepare to go to Wangshu Inn to report the results of the matter to Xiao, as you agreed...

Although his mental state seems a bit worrying, and he constantly repeats the number "five"... he seems to have surreptitiously pointed out Nacker's current whereabouts. What is this "resurrected" researcher planning? Regardless of what it may be, the important matter at hand is capturing Nacker...

quests.description_chs: 收到了莱舒的发条工坊的特殊委托，那是枫丹廷的一家发条玩具专营店，他们遇到什么麻烦了吗？
quests.description_en: You received a special commission from Leschots Clockwork Workshop. This is a toy shop in the Court of Fontaine. Have they encountered some manner of trouble?

quests.description_chs: 再次收到了发条工坊的来信，他们的进展似乎十分不顺利…
quests.description_en: You receive another missive from the workshop. It seems that all is not proceeding as planned...

quests.description_chs: 发条工坊和钟表店间的战争，兄弟间的阋墙，会因为两位老板的会晤而消弭吗？还是会变得更加激烈呢？
quests.description_en: Will the battle between clockwork workshop and clock shop, the wall between two brothers, dissolve when the two bosses meet? Or will the conflict grow more intense?

quests.description_chs: 发条工坊店员阿尔邦负责数据收集的工作，去问问需要做什么吧…
quests.description_en: Arbon is responsible for data collection. Go see what you need to do...

quests.description_chs: 发条工坊店员阿尔贝负责数据收集的工作，去问问需要做什么吧…
quests.description_en: Alberre is responsible for data collection. Go see what you need to do...

quests.description_chs: 钟表店店员阿尔芒负责管理他们的玩具，去问问如何体验吧…
quests.description_en: Armand of Lepaute Horlogerie is in charge of taking care of their toys. Go see how you can try those gizmos out...

quests.description_chs: 心情不错的派蒙提议，要和你一起在枫丹廷逛逛，买些有趣的东西和好吃的点心，没想到，你们却撞见了一位奇怪的工程师…
quests.description_en: Since Paimon's in a good mood, she suggests you take a walk around the Court of Fontaine together. You certainly didn't expect to run into an eccentric engineer...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷利奥奈区繁华的街道上，你与派蒙居然发现了一闪而过的蕈兽影踪…
quests.description_en: On the busy streets of Quartier Lyonnais in the Court of Fontaine, Paimon and you catch a glimpse of some Fungi...

quests.description_chs: 特巡队员蒂蕾娜离开后，「小小灵蕈大幻戏」又迎来了一位特别的美露莘玩家…
quests.description_en: After Turenna's departure, the event welcomes another special Melusine player...

quests.title_en: A Clash Between the First and the Latest!
quests.description_chs: 熟悉的老朋友左右加回到了「小小灵蕈大幻戏」的现场，并提议你们与海妮耶来一场久违的对决…
quests.description_en: Souka, an old friend, returns to Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, and proposes a match between you and Haniyyah...

quests.description_chs: 「小小灵蕈大幻戏」的初次游玩到此为止了，海妮耶和左右加还会继续改进这种桌上游戏，并为将来的正式大赛做准备。这次，她们不会再远离你们的视野了…
quests.description_en: "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta"'s debut ends here. Haniyyah and Souka will keep improving the game, and make preparations for an official tournament in the future. That said, they won't be going off to some distant place this time...

quests.description_chs: 被两位警备队成员拦下了，不知道他们有什么事情…
quests.description_en: Two Gardes stop you. Just what are they doing...

quests.description_chs: 完成了弗雷瑞斯与谢妮的远程炮台实验，回去跟他们聊聊吧。
quests.description_en: Having completed Frejus and Chenee's remote cannon experiment, it's time to go back and talk to them.

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹的海露港，你与派蒙撞见了一位开朗的学者兼商人，她正忙于抒发自己的情感，并邀请你们试玩某种游戏…
quests.description_en: Somewhere in Fontaine's Romaritime Harbor, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher-merchant who invites you to play a game...

quests.title_en: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Dew-Kissed Chapter
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹，你又遇见了那位名为朝雾的画家…
quests.description_en: You once again encounter the illustrator Asagiri in Fontaine...

quests.description_chs: （test）4.7导能圆盘隐藏任务$HIDDEN
经过一段时间的捕捉，你们成功遏制了外来鱼类在枫丹水域的扩散趋势，执律庭那边也传来了好消息…
quests.description_en: After a spate of spirited fishing, you manage to halt the spread of invasive fish in Fontaine's waters. Meanwhile, you receive some good news from the Maison Gardiennage...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷的一角，特巡队员蒂蕾娜和昂吉安妮摆开了新的桌上推演兵棋，正等待着见识你的指挥才华…
quests.description_en: In a corner of the Court of Fontaine, Turenna and Enghiene, members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, have set up a new tabletop wargame. The stage is set for you to show off your tactical brilliance...

quests.description_chs: 经过一番推演，特巡队的成员们似乎有了新的战法理解…
quests.description_en: After the wargames, the members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol seem to have gained new tactical insights...

quests.title_en: Well Done! What's the Next Big Plan?
quests.description_chs: 在你的帮助下，镜头测试总算是大功告成，可喜可贺。但突然冒出来的乐平波琳，好像又在策划什么新的大生意了？
quests.description_en: With your help, the lens testing is finally complete. But now that Lepine-Pauline has suddenly shown up, it looks like she's already planning another big business venture...

quests.description_chs: 小露米埃尔似乎从《蒸汽鸟报》处得到了一些关于速览映影的新消息…
quests.description_en: Petit Lumiere seems to have read something about Flash Cuts in The Steambird...

quests.description_en: The Steambird's "Tales of Humanity" column is hiring assistants. If you're interested, please report to Euphrasie for more details!

quests.title_en: Studies in Light and Shadow: A Fontaine of Enchantment
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹郊外，一位名叫布列松的人似乎遇见了什么麻烦…
quests.description_en: In Fontaine's countryside, a man named Bresson seems to have encountered some trouble...

quests.description_chs: 枫丹的铁匠并不会自己挥动铁锤进行锻打，取而代之的是一种更加先进的方式，有空的话，不如去详细考察看看吧…
quests.description_en: Blacksmiths in Fontaine do not hammer their metals themselves, but rather use an even more advanced method. If you have time, you really should go check it out...

quests.title_en: The Peaks and Troughs of Life
quests.description_chs: 枫丹科学院的研究员玛卡德尔似乎正在为什么而发愁…
quests.description_en: Researcher Macadell of the institute seems to be troubled by something...

quests.title_chs: 早早失败的「图形对抗学」…
quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的工作，你们收集到了足够的样本，看样子，是时候和乐平波琳开展后续的讨论了…
quests.description_en: After putting in some work, you have collected enough samples. Looks like it's time to follow up with Lepine-Pauline...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷，你又遇见了乌尔曼…
quests.description_en: You run into Ulman again in the Court of Fontaine...

quests.description_chs: 乌尔曼正在为自己的生意做下一步打算…
quests.description_en: Ulman is planning the future of his business enterprise...

quests.description_chs: 小露米埃尔先生似乎对映影有着独到的见解…
quests.description_en: Mr. Petit Lumiere seems to have a unique understanding of films...

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德某地的奇妙秘境旁，你与派蒙遇见了一位老朋友，她似乎正在准备某种特别的活动…
quests.description_en: Next to a mysterious Domain in Mondstadt, you and Paimon run into an old friend. She seems to be preparing some kind of special event...

quests.title_en: The Art of the Elegant Blade Dance?
quests.description_chs: 在白露区某个不起眼的角落，你与派蒙发现了一座秘境的入口，某位兴致高昂的「剑客」向你们发出了特别的邀请…
quests.description_en: In a nondescript corner of Belleau Region, you and Paimon discover the entrance to a Domain. A Blade Dancer in high spirits extends a special invitation to you...

quests.description_chs: 在「轻剑舞者」构筑舞台上体验了一番独特的战斗后，你和派蒙打算给科斯唐坦一些反馈，却发现事态有变…
quests.description_en: After experiencing a unique battle on the Blade Dancer's stage, you and Paimon plan to give Costentin some feedback, but discover something has changed...

quests.title_en: Spread Out Less Than an Arcminute!
quests.description_chs: 「千灵映影节」期间，你与派蒙遇见了一位特别的警备队员，她似乎正在寻找试玩活动的客人…
quests.description_en: During the Fontinalia Film Festival, you and Paimon encounter a special member of the Gardes, she seems to be looking for guests to partake in an event test...

quests.description_chs: 欢快的节庆之时，也有映影行业的相关人士愁眉不展，你与派蒙就在会场附近找到了一位倒霉的乙方员工…
quests.description_en: During the joyous festival, some involved with the filmmaking industry are wearing frowns. You and Paimon encounter an unfortunate contracted employee...

quests.title_en: Special Lighting and the Stars of Tomorrow!
quests.description_chs: 在「千灵映影节」的会场，某位衣着华丽的「实验映影」导演向你们发出了真诚的邀请…
quests.description_en: On the site of the Fontinalia Film Festival, an "experimental" film director dressed quite ostentatiously extends a sincere invitation...

quests.title_en: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!
quests.description_chs: 尽管结识新伙伴的计划进展并不顺利，但兰吉特并不在意，并且已经准备开始新的挑战…
quests.description_en: Although his plan to make new buddies is not going well, Ranjit seems unconcerned. Indeed, he is already preparing for the next challenge...

quests.description_chs: 和一位老朋友再次相会在露泽咖啡厅…
quests.description_en: Reunite with an old friend at Café Lutece...

quests.description_chs: 兰吉特最终也没能和候选中的任何一个变成伙伴，不过他似乎还有些话想说…
quests.description_en: Ranjit was unable to forge a bond with any of his candidates, but he seems to still have something to say...

quests.description_chs: 偶然听见「鳄鳄~砰！」的声音后，你和派蒙发现了一位工程师，她似乎正在捣鼓着某种特别的装置…
quests.description_en: After hearing the sound of "cro-cro~~KOOM" by chance, you and Paimon discover an engineer who seems to be tinkering with a very unusual device...

quests.description_chs: 除了拍映影，还有别的事可以一起做，有空记得找我吃饭。猎鹿人、万民堂、兰巴德酒馆、德波大饭店之类的…去露泽咖啡厅喝咖啡也是好主意。
quests.description_en: Aside from filming, there are other things we can do together, like meeting for a meal. Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Lambad's Tavern, Hotel Debord, and the like... Coffee at Café Lutece might not be a bad idea either.

quests.description_chs: 枫丹南部的某地似乎出现了紧急事态，警备队员们需要支援…
quests.description_en: The Gardes are facing an emergency in the south of Fontaine. It appears they need assistance...

quests.description_chs: 一段时间的战斗后，你们成功压制了遗迹中的魔物，还为弗雷瑞斯的重炮收集到了充足的数据…
quests.description_en: After a brief battle, you manage to suppress the monsters in the ruins, collecting a large amount of data on Frejus's cannon in the process...

quests.title_en: Hot in a Flash, or Cold Just as Fast?
quests.description_chs: 据说，乐平波琳又研发出了划时代的新镜头。可为什么她的徒弟妮内特，看起来快要哭出来了？
quests.description_en: It is said that Lepine-Pauline has developed a groundbreaking new lens. But why does her apprentice Ninette look on the verge of tears?

quests.description_chs: 在露景泉附近，你与派蒙似乎隐约听到了一阵激烈的争吵声…
quests.description_en: Near the Fountain of Lucine, you and Paimon seem to hear someone arguing...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹城外，你发现了一个奇怪的占卜摊…
quests.description_en: You discover a strange fortune-telling booth outside the city of Fontaine...

quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，勇士们都很高大，又有力气，真羡慕他们。」\n「确实很多勇士天生拥有强健的肉体，不过也有那种个子小、力气也不是很大的勇士，他们一点不比我训练出的那些高个子勇士差。」
quests.description_en: "Dad, heroes are so tall and strong. I wish I could be one some day."\n"It's true that many heroes are tall and strong by nature, but there are others who — though they may be lacking in height and strength — are just as capable as any of the taller ones I've trained."

quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，你训练出的勇士们都很完美对吧？」\n「不能这么说，完美永远在下一秒，而追求完美的欲望会啃咬他们的心，他们永远也不会是完美的。他们也会厌倦，也会想放弃，和你我一样。」
quests.description_en: "Dad, the heroes you've trained are all perfect, right?"\n"It's not like that. Perfection always feels like it's just beyond reach, so the desire to achieve it gnaws at the very fiber of their being — but they'll never do it. Just like us, they'll get tired and want to give up."

quests.title_en: A Saurian Returns to the Nest
quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，如果你已经触摸过星星，那你还会愿意回到地面上吗？」\n「所有会飞的生灵都是在土地上或者巢穴中出生的，总要回到它们出生的地方去。」
quests.description_en: "Dad, if you've touched the stars, would you still want to return to the ground?"\n"Every creature that flies is born on the ground or in a nest, and they must all return whence they came."

quests.title_chs: 艾伦·史密西，菲谢尔的作者
quests.description_chs: 和魔女的课题完全没有关系，你只是去冒险家协会看看工作委托而已。结果好像有意外收获？
quests.description_en: You only stopped by the Adventurers' Guild to check for new commissions — it has nothing to do with the witch or her assignment. But it seems you stumble upon an unexpected surprise...

quests.title_en: A Dry Well Doth Not Reflect the Stars
quests.description_chs: 根据辞典的引导，你们准备把课题带给莫娜。看起来应该是再简单不过的事情了。
quests.description_en: Following the hints in the dictionary, you and Paimon decide to deliver the assignment to Mona. It should be a simple task... or so it seems.

quests.description_chs: 根据魔女所赠予的辞典的引导，你们需要前往雪山，为阿贝多带去…新的课业？
quests.description_en: Guided by the witch's dictionary, you head to Dragonspine to bring Albedo a brand-new assignment...

quests.description_chs: 在魔女的辞典里，你们发现了一条非比寻常的「口信」，要将它带给杜林…
quests.description_en: Inside the witch's dictionary, you discover an unusual message that must be delivered to Durin...

quests.description_chs: 在魔女的辞典上，你们并未看见与温迪有关的具体课题…但你们依然按照辞典上的引导，前往蒙德城周围寻找温迪…
quests.description_en: The witch's dictionary doesn't mention any specific task related to Venti, but you still follow its guidance and search for him around Mondstadt...

quests.description_chs: 根据魔女所赠予的辞典的引导，这次的「课题」似乎需要在奔狼领进行，去奔狼领看看这次的「课题」是什么样的吧…
quests.description_en: According to the witch's dictionary, this assignment takes place in Wolvendom. Go there and see what awaits you this time...

quests.description_chs: 砂糖在炼制新的炼金药剂，不过，似乎炼制的药剂始终无法达到预期…
quests.description_en: Sucrose is working on a new alchemical potion, but no matter how she tweaks the formula, it never comes out right...

quests.title_en: The Great Mage's Journey of Trials
quests.description_chs: 魔女的辞典里，也有艾莉丝为可莉留下的「课题」，如果有空的话，就去西风骑士团找可莉问问看吧？
quests.description_en: The witch's dictionary also includes an assignment that Alice left for Klee. Why not drop by the Knights of Favonius headquarters and ask Klee about it?

quests.description_chs: 西风大教堂的广场之前，骑士们正为了即将到来的授勋仪式而忙碌着…
quests.description_en: The Knights are busy preparing for an award ceremony in front of the Favonius Cathedral plaza...

quests.description_chs: 为了追寻超越凡众的力量，需要付出怎样的代价…
quests.description_en: What price must one pay in pursuit of power that surpasses mortal ken...?

quests.description_chs: 面对无可挽回的命运，洛恩最终下定的决意，会将他引向何方…
quests.description_en: What decision will Lohen make in the face of irrevocable fate? And where will that lead him...?

quests.description_chs: 落叶载着往事流过…故事中的二人，还能否将那段遥远的感情弥合…
quests.description_en: The fallen leaves float away, carrying with them stories of the past. Will the protagonists of the fairytale rekindle feelings from a distant past?

quests.description_chs: 图书馆的管理员丽莎，似乎正在对工作上的一些事情感到恼火…
quests.description_en: Librarian Lisa seems annoyed about her work...

quests.description_chs: 有不少人借了图书馆的书却忘记归还，丽莎不得不去催讨。玛乔丽和莎拉都答应尽快还书，只有唐娜借的书似乎被偷走了。你们决定以丽莎留在书本上的元素标记为线索，追回丢失的书本。
quests.description_en: Many people forget to return the library books they've borrowed, leaving Lisa no choice but to chase them and retrieve the books. Marjorie and Sara have agreed to return the books they borrowed as soon as possible, but Donna's seems to have been stolen. You decide to track the missing book down by following the trail left by an elemental marking Lisa made on it.

quests.description_chs: 在蒙德教堂前、巨大神像脚下的广场，你和派蒙发现了一位小女孩，正在与「幻想朋友」一起玩…
quests.description_en: At the feet of the Anemo Archon Statue in the plaza in front of Mondstadt Cathedral, you and Paimon discover a little girl playing with her imaginary friend...

quests.description_chs: 与温迪一同调查「幻想朋友」时，你受艾琳之托，前往南风之狮的庙宇，寻找冒险家杰克。据说他正与传奇大冒险家斯坦利结伴同行。
quests.description_en: While investigating imaginary friends with Venti, Ellin asked you to search for the adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion. It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.

quests.description_chs: 杰克想要偷偷寻找斯坦利当年冒险所用的武器，那是继承自「南风之狮」的剑与盾，令他无比向往。
quests.description_en: Jack wants to search for Stanley's old weapons in secret, as they are the sword and shield passed down from the Lion of the South, and thus fascinate Jack greatly.

quests.title_en: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land
quests.description_chs: 一段冒险经历后，杰克满意而归。但温迪却发现了斯坦利的异样，决定继续探究此事…
quests.description_en: Jack returns home satisfied after a round of adventure. But Venti finds Stanley's behavior odd, and decides to investigate further...

quests.description_chs: (test)控制温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN
在纳塔，你又遇见了凯瑟琳小姐…
quests.description_en: You meet Katheryne once again in Natlan...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「地区委托·纳塔」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock commissions for Natlan

quests.description_chs: 「买一送一大促销！买了我吃亏，不买你吃亏！」\n到底哪些人会因为这种标语上当…什么？派蒙居然已经预定了？
quests.description_en: "Buy one get one free! My loss if you buy, your loss if you don't!"\nBut what sort of gullible folk would be taken in by such slogans... Wait, Paimon pre-ordered already?

quests.description_chs: 西风骑士团的琴好像有一件特别的事想要拜托你，去骑士团总部看看吧。
quests.description_en: Master Jean has a special task for you. Head to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to find out more.

quests.description_chs: 顺利找到优菈，她愿意传授给你劳伦斯家族的礼仪。为了顺利完成琴的请求，你需要接受一系列的训练…
quests.description_en: You successfully locate Eula, who agrees to teach you the customs of the Lawrence Clan. To fulfill the task given to you by Master Jean, it seems you will need to undergo quite the rigorous training program...

quests.title_en: Through the Motions, to the Heart
quests.description_chs: 礼仪相关的训练虽不算顺利，但你总算是完成了。训练过程中，你隐约了解到优菈性格的成因。在告别优菈之后，你决定动身，带上见面礼再一次面见舒伯特。
quests.description_en: You get through the aristocratic conduct training, albeit with some hiccups along the way. During the training, you believe you may have discovered what shapes Eula's personality. You say goodbye to Eula and decide to act — first, you will procure a greeting gift, then you will meet with Schubert once more.

quests.title_chs: 「秘密组织」的成员为什么来到这里
quests.title_en: Why Did a Member of a "Secret Organization" Come Here?
quests.description_chs: 从冒险家协会接到了一份来自「不便透露详情的组织」发布的神秘委托，内容协助委托人完成巨大怪物的情报收集工作，而被列入目标名单的「巨大怪物」包括了秘源机兵·构型械、魔像督军、水形幻人以及铁甲熔火帝皇这一系列强敌，看来任务难度颇高…
quests.description_en: You've received a mysterious commission from an "organization whose details may not be disclosed" at the Adventurers' Guild. Specifically, you are to assist the client in completing data collection work on a series of giant monsters, including the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device, Legatus Golem, Hydro Tulpa, and Emperor of Fire and Iron. It seems that this might just be a toughie...

quests.description_chs: 在圣火竞技场的话事处，一位「战备联络人」正等待着你们的支援…
quests.description_en: A combat readiness liaison is awaiting your help outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame's Speaker's Chamber...

quests.description_en: While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into a marksmanship instructor who has prepared some shooting practice...

quests.description_chs: 火神玛薇卡同意了举办荣花演武，相关的比赛会场也搭建完成。现在可以去报名参加正赛了…
quests.description_en: The Pyro Archon, Mavuika, has agreed to hold the Bloomflower Trials, and the competition venue is ready. All that's left is to sign up for it...

quests.description_chs: 寻找海风草的龙龙远征队已经出发，现场似乎还有一些小龙留下来，去和附近的工作人员聊聊吧。
quests.description_en: A saurian expedition has set off in search of Ocean Zephyrs, but a few little ones seemed to have stayed behind. Why not have a chat with the staff nearby?

quests.description_chs: 在悠悠度假村，你遇见了一个正在全心全力喷涂的人…
quests.description_en: While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into someone who is super excited about spray painting...

quests.description_chs: 在悠悠度假村，你遇见了一个正在讲述故事的人…
quests.description_en: While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into someone who is telling stories...

quests.description_chs: 在悠悠度假村，你发现了一个庞大的舞台。而且，似乎有人正在舞台旁调制饮品…？
quests.description_en: You discover a huge stage at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort... along with someone mixing strange drinks beside it...

quests.description_chs: 你们即将登上雪的国度，派蒙似乎正在整理这一路上你拍摄的所有画片…
quests.description_en: You are about to travel to the nation of snow, and Paimon seems to be sorting through all the photos you have taken along the way...

quests.description_chs: 某天，你在「回声之子」遇见了两人…
quests.description_en: One day, while visiting the Children of Echoes, you meet a couple of people...

quests.description_chs: 在安饶之野，你与派蒙遇见了一位开朗的学者、商人兼可爱动物专家，她正忙于抒发自己的情感，并邀请你们试玩某种游戏…
quests.description_en: Somewhere in Atocpan, you and Paimon run into a cheerful researcher slash merchant slash expert on adorable creatures. She invites you to play a game...

quests.description_chs: 重返悠悠度假村时，你们遇见了一位老朋友，还有一群特别的「阿夏」…
quests.description_en: You return to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, where you run into an old friend together with some rather special Ashas...

quests.title_en: A Splash of Color on the Plate!
quests.description_chs: 秘境中的游离颜料收集完毕，调色家「阿夏」也非常满意…
quests.description_en: You have finished collecting the free-roaming color paints. The colorist Ashas are very pleased with the haul...

quests.description_chs: 纳塔的讯使捎来消息，邀请你与派蒙回到悠悠度假村，参加独特的「舞力派对」…
quests.description_en: A courier from Natlan brings word inviting you and Paimon back to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort to take part in a one-of-a-kind "Dance Party"...

quests.description_chs: 又一次「舞力聚会」临近尾声，大家都有很棒的收获…
quests.description_en: As another dance party draws to a close, everyone seems to have gained something wonderful...

quests.description_chs: 「天使的馈赠」的酒客们，议论起了蒙德街头巷尾的热门话题…
quests.description_en: Customers at the Angel's Share have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt's streets: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"

quests.title_en: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure
quests.description_chs: 你们从各处听说了有关「蒙德最强战力」的各种情报，但仍然无法肯定这个问题的答案。在骑士团总部，你们意外遇到了「强者候选人」——可莉，而她正面临宝物失窃的危机，亟待帮助。
quests.description_en: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.

quests.description_chs: 可莉的宝物——「炸弹」，意外而又轻松解决了窃取宝物的黑手。然而爆炸过后，可莉却匆忙逃走，疑惑的你们决定先回到骑士团，向琴汇报情况…
quests.description_en: Klee's highly explosive "treasure" proved to be a remarkably swift solution to the Abyss Mage problem. However, she fled the scene after the explosion. Confused, you decide to return to the Knights headquarters and report the matter to Jean...

quests.description_en: The astrologist Mona, who you met by chance outside Liyue Harbor, has promised that if you go with her to Mondstadt to fulfill her appointment, she will help you read the truth behind the gods and your sibling. Leaving Liyue Harbor, you head towards Mondstadt.

quests.description_chs: 旅途之中，你见识到了莫娜作为占星术士的实力，以及她的矜持。终于，你们来到了旅途的终点——蒙德城。
quests.description_en: On your journey, you witness Mona's strength as an astrologist, as well as her constraints. At last, you arrive at your destination — Mondstadt.

试图在海盗船的残骸中搜刮宝物的宝藏猎人声称自己受到了鬼魂的袭击，刻拉蒂之眼的确素来有幽灵出没的传言，但从未有过鬼魂袭击活人的记录。询问在附近钓鱼的伊尔玛里，或许能获得更多信息。
quests.description_en: Treasure hunters attempting to scavenge riches from the wreckage of a pirate ship claim to have been attacked by a ghost. While the Eye of Kratti is no stranger to rumors of haunted sightings, there has never been a documented case of ghosts assaulting the living. Perhaps questioning Ilmari, who often fishes nearby, might reveal more information.

quests.description_chs: 「流浪之环」商队在那夏镇停留时，因货物失窃的案子而闹出不小的骚动，甚至有人在这次的骚动中丧生。现在，商队已经离开了那夏镇，但若是向消息灵通的「信使」海勒姆和库莉艾卡打听，或许会得到更详细的信息。
quests.description_en: There had been a major commotion in Nasha Town due to a stolen goods case during the Peripatetic Circle caravan's stay — one that even led to death. The caravan has since left Nasha Town, but asking the well-informed messengers Hiram and Kurierka may yield more detailed information.

quests.description_chs: 「旗舰」的悬赏榜单上有一个目标在犯下许多骇人罪行后便销声匿迹，仿佛人间蒸发。而罪咎终须追索，罪责终须清偿。询问「旗舰」员工勒塞克，或许能得到更多信息。
quests.description_en: On the bounty board at The Flagship, there's a target known for vanishing without a trace after committing numerous heinous crimes. Yet justice demands retribution, and sins must be atoned for. Asking Leszek, an employee at The Flagship, may yield further information.

被北风之力封锁的秘境，曾是骑士浴血屠魔之地，亦是骑士葬剑埋骨之所。
「骑士无需铭碑，自有公理为我存留。」
「骑士无需牵绊，自有正义与我同行。」
「骑士无需凯旋，自有冽风送我还乡。」
quests.description_en:
A Domain sealed by the power of the North Wind. Once a place where knights stained the earth with demon blood, it was also where they laid their swords and bones to rest.
"A knight hath no need of graven stone, for justice itself shall be his memorial."
"A knight hath no need of bonds, for justice itself doth walk beside him."
"A knight hath no need of triumph, for a biting wind shall bear him home."

Recently, however, not only has he stopped going to Nasha Town, he's also refusing all visiting guests. The recluse appears to have undergone significant changes in both appearance and habits... There is, however, another notable detail: a traveling merchant claims that their associate, who regularly delivered goods to the hermit, has gone missing after their last visit... To uncover the truth, a direct visit may be the best approach.

quests.description_en: You encounter a group of unusual visitors from Sumeru at the People of the Springs...

quests.description_chs: 在帕哈岛的郊区地带，似乎正在上演着一场激烈的兵棋推演对抗…
quests.description_en: On the outskirts of Paha Isle, a fierce wargame simulation seems to be unfolding...

quests.description_chs: 几日激烈的「对抗」后，分别的日子悄然来临…
quests.description_en: After days of intense "sparing," the moment of parting quietly arrives...

quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱，一场独特的武艺比拼大赛进入了白热阶段…
quests.description_en: In Nod-Krai, a unique martial arts tournament has now reached its most thrilling moment...

quests.description_chs: 武艺比拼已然结束，是时候决定最后的冠军了…
quests.description_en: The martial arts challenge has come to an end. It is time to decide on the champion...

quests.title_en: Until the End of the World
quests.description_chs:
「届时我将起舞，将众生脚下的轨道还予千星…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
群杰举目眺云霄，悬车衔灯琼城绕。千星复归风始动，唯余邪龙孤影遥。

书卷旁的批注：我觉得那位穿靴子说人话的猫又小姐也值得两句这样的诗。
批注下的批注：我改天找补找补，但说真的，你们到底往我杯子里加了什么？
批注下批注的批注：我不知道，不是我放的。
批注下批注的批注：也不是我放的。
quests.description_en:
"When that time comes, I shall dance, and return the tracks beneath my people's feet back to the stars in the sky..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes gazed upon the skies of gray, and in carriages bright they went their way. The stars returned and the winds they drove — now the dragon's shadow alone still did rove.
Comment in the margins: I feel that the young nekomata lady in boots who spoke the human tongue needs a line or two!
Comment below the comment: I'll make up for that another day... But really, what did you put into my cup?
Comment below the comment below the comment: I dunno, it wasn't me.
Comment below the comment below the comment: Wasn't me either.

quests.description_chs: 在一个风清日朗的日子，你和派蒙散步到了清泉镇附近…
quests.description_en: On a clear and sunny day, you go for a walk to Springvale with Paimon.

quests.description_chs: 散步途中，你们偶然遇到了一位奇妙的少女。名叫香菱的少女来自璃月，是一位厨师，为了搜寻珍奇食材，她邀你们一道打猎。但你们私自狩猎野猪的行为似乎惹恼了猎户们的领头人杜拉夫，你们不得不去向他道歉。
quests.description_en: While out on a stroll, you bumped into a strange girl. This girl, a chef from Liyue by the name of Xiangling, is on a journey to seek out exotic ingredients. She enlists your help in a hunt, but your private hunting expedition appears to have earned the ire of Draff, the leader of the hunters. You head off to apologize to him...

quests.description_chs: 然而杜拉夫却没有责备香菱，而是请她推广清泉镇的肉产品。坚守原则的香菱拒绝为了宣传而烹饪，正打算离开时却意外地被清泉镇大厨布洛克的料理所吸引。交谈中，两人在如何处理食材的问题上产生了分歧，约定以料理决一高下。
quests.description_en: To your surprise, Draff did not intend to reprimand Xiangling, but instead wanted her to help promote Springvale's meat products instead. Sticking to her principles, Xiangling refused to cook for advertising, and would have left if she was not attracted to the smell of Brook's cooking. What began as a chat devolved into disagreement about how to prepare food, and ended in the declaration of a cook-off between the head chef of Springvale and the chef from Liyue.

quests.description_chs: 香菱认为只凭莲蓬和绝云椒椒这样的食材还不足以取胜，为了寻找特别的食材她再次踏上寻找之路。
quests.description_en: Xiangling believes that Lotus Heads and Jueyun Chilis alone will not let her prevail in the cook-off, and sets off to find more ingredients.

quests.description_chs: 听说遗迹中有巨大的急冻树，香菱产生了兴趣，急急忙忙跑进了地下遗迹。你们担心香菱冲动之下遇到危险，紧跟着也进入了遗迹。
quests.description_en: Xiangling took a keen interest in the rumor that the ruins contain a gigantic Cryo Regisvine, and ran inside to investigate. Worried about her safety, you quickly follow the impetuous chef.

quests.description_chs: 得到了珍稀的食材之后，香菱终于做好了进行料理对决的准备。两位大厨之间的胜负即将开始。
quests.description_en: After obtaining the rare ingredients, Xiangling is finally ready for the cook-off. The showdown between the two head chefs is about to begin.

quests.description_chs: （弃用）$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: (Scrapped)

quests.description_chs: （弃用）$UNRELEASED
quests.description_en: (Scrapped)

quests.title_en: A Teapot to Call Home: Part I
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的危机已然平息，城中的事务也大多重回正轨。 不过，在玉京台赏花的萍姥姥似乎还有件事想和旅行者商量…
quests.description_en: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可获得道具「尘歌壶」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock the Serenitea Pot

quests.description_chs: 璃月港内最近流传着有关「重修群玉阁」的消息，到玉京台找凝光打听一下详情吧。
quests.description_en: Liyue Harbor is all abuzz with the news of the Jade Chamber's rebuilding. Go to Yujing Terrace and ask Ningguang for the details.

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙正在灵矩关附近，准备探索附近的遗迹…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon prepare to investigate a ruin near Lingju Pass...

quests.description_chs: 在调查遗迹守卫时偶然邂逅的至冬国男孩，居然是「公子」的弟弟托克。「公子」拜托你帮他保守「身份的秘密」，并带托克先在璃月转转。
quests.description_en: The Snezhnayan boy that you met by chance while investigating the Ruin Guards turned out to be Childe's younger brother Teucer. Childe requests that you keep his "identity" a secret and that you give the boy a tour of Liyue.

quests.description_chs: 虽然过程有些狼狈，但「公子」还是在弟弟面前成功掩饰住了自己的身份。在托克回至冬国之前，「公子」答应了他最后的要求——参观璃月的「玩具研究所」。可那座「研究所」事实上是…
quests.description_en: Though the process was winding and awkward, Childe proved able to conceal his identity from his brother. Before Teucer could return to Snezhnaya, Childe agreed to his final request — to tour Liyue's Institute for Toy Research. But in truth, that Institute is...

quests.description_chs: 从白术那里得知了鸣霞浮生石的情报，去飞云商会打听一下吧。
quests.description_en: You hear about Sunset Vermillionite from Baizhu and decide to hit up Feiyun Commerce Guild for some information.

quests.description_chs: 还剩两样材料没有找到，先去工地打听一下消息吧。
quests.description_en: Only two materials left to find. Time to ask around at the worksite.

quests.description_chs: 距离群玉阁升空的时刻越来越近了。不知道群玉阁升空后，又会发生什么事呢？
quests.description_en: The time when the Jade Chamber takes to the skies again is drawing closer. Who knows what will happen when it finally does?

quests.description_chs: (test)间章隐藏任务刷群玉阁$HIDDEN
(test)间章隐藏任务临时传送$HIDDEN
在璃月闲逛的时候，意外地遇见了一位熟悉的人…
quests.description_en: As you stroll around Liyue, you bump into a familiar person...

quests.description_chs: 夜兰似乎对知易不太放心，决定到北码头找博来打听一下知易的风评。
quests.description_en: Yelan does not seem particularly reassured by Zhiyi and decides to go down to the wharf to speak to Bolai and find out how well he is rated by others.

quests.description_chs: 行至珠钿舫，你和派蒙偶然认出了一张熟悉的面孔…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon recognize a familiar face as you come aboard the Pearl Galley...

quests.description_chs: 偶遇钟离之后，你得知愚人众克列门特正在组建考古小队，除了自告奋勇加入的考古学家宛烟之外，钟离也被聘请成为顾问。虽然你信不过愚人众，但在钟离的邀请下，你还是加入了这支考古小队，而你们的第一个调查目标，则是「漩涡之魔神」奥赛尔。
quests.description_en: After your chance meeting with Zhongli, you learn that a Fatuus named Kliment is trying to organize an archaeological expedition. Zhongli is roped in as a consultant, along with an archaeologist named Wanyan who volunteers for the task. Though you distrust the Fatui, you join up at Zhongli's invitation. The first subject of this investigation is Osial, Overlord of the Vortex.

quests.title_en: A Ruin Under Lock and Key
quests.description_chs: 孤云阁一行，关于「漩涡之魔神」奥赛尔的收获寥寥，克列门特和宛烟还因为观念不同发生了激烈的争吵，这都让克列门特很不开心。他在争吵中听到宛烟提起了「盐之魔神」的故事，为了不让此行一无所获，他决定带队前往地中之盐碰碰运气。
quests.description_en: The expedition to investigate Osial in the Guyun Stone Forest came away with slim pickings. Kliment and Wanyan also clashed vociferously over their differing perspectives, which has greatly displeased the former. During the argument, he heard Wanyan mention the tale of the God of Salt, and decided to take the party there to try their luck, lest he finishes this venture empty-handed.

quests.description_chs: 借助钟离的知识，你们顺利地解开了封印，但在进入遗迹之前，钟离向宛烟与克列门特提出了一个契约：「顺次取物，每次一件」。
quests.description_en: With the aid of Zhongli's knowledge, you are able to undo the seals, but before entering the ruin, he lays a condition before Wanyan and Kliment: to alternate who gets claim to each treasure encountered, with only one object permitted per claim.

quests.description_chs: 遗迹之内，克列门特和宛烟都因为各自的原因违背了契约，作为惩罚，克列门特被剥夺了收获，赶出了遗迹，而宛烟，则是得知了令她信仰幻灭的真相——「盐之魔神」因为过于善良与软弱，招来了背叛与灭亡。作为见证者，心情复杂的你，跟随钟离回到了孤云阁。
quests.description_en: Within the ruins, Kliment and Wanyan each betray the contract in turn for personal reasons. As punishment, Kliment is cast out of the ruin and deprived of his reward. Wanyan is made to witness a truth that shatters her beliefs — the God of Salt was gentle but weak and was betrayed and slain as a result. Bearing witness to this incident and filled with conflicted feelings as a result, you follow Zhongli back to Guyun Stone Forest.

quests.description_chs: 决定宣布知易考察通过，以此来让他麻痹大意。在那之前只能等待…
quests.description_en: You decide to announce the Zhiyi has passed the selection to make him lower his guard. Now all that's left to do is wait...

quests.description_chs: 不卜庐门前，似乎正有人前来求助…
quests.description_en: Someone seems to be asking for help outside Bubu Pharmacy...

quests.description_chs: 嘉良身上所中之毒，似乎另有隐情…
quests.description_en: There seems to be something else going on with the poison in Jialiang's body...

quests.description_chs: 毒与药的界限已经模糊，生与死的边界也在动摇…问世间何处能求万全之方？
quests.description_en: The boundary between medicine and poison seems to have blurred, as has the line between life and death... Where can one find a truly perfect remedy, or does it exist at all?

quests.title_en: The Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds
quests.description_chs: 原本在「群玉阁」工作的几位秘书现身在了玉京台，她们似乎正在为一些事情而焦头烂额…
quests.description_en: The three secretaries who originally worked at the Jade Chamber have appeared at Yujing Terrace. It looks like something has them tearing their hair out...

quests.title_en: A Secretary in a Sea of Humanity
quests.description_chs: 内心徘徊于人类与仙人的夹缝间，甘雨陷入了精神上的困境。在回归绝云间的计划受挫后，你陪同甘雨回到了璃月港，试图解除甘雨自认为被排挤的误会…
quests.description_en: Caught between the world of humans and adepti, Ganyu has descended into a funk. After she hits a snag in her plan to return to Jueyun Karst, you follow Ganyu back to Liyue Harbor, intending to resolve her misunderstanding that she has been dismissed from her post...

quests.description_chs: 受到身为「天枢星」的天叔委托，甘雨很自然地进入了工作状态，顺利帮助了后辈慧心解决了工作上的困扰。为了表示感谢，慧心邀请你们来到新月轩参加饭局…
quests.description_en: Accepting the commission of the Tianshu, Uncle Tian, Ganyu very naturally slips into her work mode, coming to the aid of her junior colleague Huixin with ease in the latter's time of need. To express her thanks, Huixin invites you all to Xinyue Kiosk to have a meal...

quests.description_chs: 派蒙突然有点怀念留云借风真君讲述的种种趣闻，到奥藏山去见见这位相识已久的仙人吧。
quests.description_en: Paimon has a sudden yearning for the quirky stories told by Cloud Retainer. Go to Mt. Aocang to see this adeptus, with whom you are quite familiar.

quests.description_chs: 在万民堂吃饭的时候，偶然遇到了远黛与漱玉。年迈健忘的远黛已经不记得曾经的事情，但或许可以从她当过侠客这一点入手调查…
quests.description_en: While eating at Wanmin Restaurant, you encounter Yuandai and Shuyu. Yuandai, forgetful in her old age, cannot remember her past, but perhaps her having once been a chivalrous heroine is a good place to start...

quests.description_chs: 没想到最后的线索竟然指向奥藏山。远黛曾经在奥藏山生活过吗？为什么留云借风真君没有提起这件事呢？总之先回到奥藏山，看看远黛能不能想起什么吧。
quests.description_en: Unexpectedly, the final clue leads back to Mt. Aocang. Did Yuandai once live there? Why didn't Cloud Retainer mention this? Either way, time to head back there and see if Yuandai recalls anything.

quests.title_chs: (test)留云个人线隐藏任务发家具$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)留云个人线隐藏任务发家具$HIDDEN
某日，为了补充冒险物资，你来到了蒙德城蒂玛乌斯的炼金铺。在这里，你见到了一位意料之外的人…
quests.description_en: You arrive at Timaeus' alchemy store in Mondstadt one day to stock up on adventuring supplies. But here, you encounter someone altogether unexpected...

quests.title_en: The Genius Researcher and the Seed of Another World
quests.description_chs: 在寻找阿贝多的途中，你偶遇了一位有些奇怪的修女罗莎莉亚。她自称知道阿贝多的行踪，愿意为你带路。
quests.description_en: While searching for Albedo, you encounter an odd-looking sister named Rosaria. She claims to know where Albedo is and expresses her willingness to show you the way.

quests.description_chs: 在找到了阿贝多之后，罗莎莉亚便独自离去。你在和阿贝多的交谈中，得知了他的研究课题：使用炼金术让来自异世界的种子发芽并盛开。为了更全面地理解异世界生命，阿贝多提出希望观察同为异世界来客的你，并进行一些实验测定。
quests.description_en: After finding Albedo, Rosaria leaves on her own. You chat with Albedo and discover the objective of his research: to use alchemy to cause a seed from another world to sprout and flourish. To better understand otherworldly lifeforms, Albedo states his desire to observe you and to perform some experiments in the process.

quests.description_chs: 元素力流动实验之后，阿贝多希望你展现一些来自于异世界的特殊能力，然而最后并没有收获。不过，阿贝多对你的兴趣，似乎丝毫没有减弱…
quests.description_en: After the elemental flow tests, Albedo asks you to display any special, otherworldly abilities you may have, though nothing comes of this. Still, Albedo's interest in you has not waned in the least...

quests.description_chs: 实验开始之后，阿贝多首先为你检测了元素力流动的情况，结果是无论外部流动还是内部流动都很顺畅，没有发现什么异常。虽然结果听上去很普通，但据阿贝多所说，这似乎是值得高兴的结果。
quests.description_en: After the experiment begins, Albedo first checks your elemental flow. The result is that both your internal and external elemental flows run smoothly and that there is nothing unusual about them. These results seem very normal indeed, but according to Albedo, this is something to be happy about.

quests.description_chs: 随着实验的进行，阿贝多获得了越来越多关于你的研究数据，他脑中的炼金术猜想也在一步步成型。终于，在进行了看似普通的身体机能实验之后，实验即将来到尾声…
quests.description_en: As the experiments proceed, Albedo obtains more and more data related to you, and the alchemy he envisages begins to take shape. Finally, after a simple test of your physical capabilities, the experiments draw to a close...

quests.description_chs: 须弥正在举办花神诞祭，闻讯前来的你，碰见了一群熟悉的面孔…
quests.description_en: Sumeru is holding the Sabzeruz Festival! Upon hearing the news, you arrive to see some familiar faces...

quests.description_chs: 有人在节日期间蠢蠢欲动，可不能让他们破坏了这份惊喜…
quests.description_en: Some would seek to cause trouble during the festival. They cannot be allowed to ruin this surprise...

quests.description_chs: 当回想起一个又一个生日的时候，这会是她最难忘的那个吗？
quests.description_en: When she thinks back on all her birthdays, will this be the most unforgettable?

quests.description_chs: 你们在望舒客栈附近发现了一些沾染「邪气」的丘丘人，而一位自称「掇星攫辰天君」的仙人正在附近为「信众」们展示驱魔之术…
quests.description_en: You discover some hilichurls near Wangshu Inn that are giving off dark energy, just as an adeptus who calls himself Starsnatcher is performing some exorcist arts nearby...

quests.description_chs: 作为让「掇星攫辰天君」帮忙实现愿望的代价，你们准备前往「万文集舍」购买料理相关的书籍。而在那里遇到的是…
quests.description_en: As payment to attain Starsnatcher's help, you prepare to go to Wanwen Bookhouse to purchase books about cooking. Upon arriving at the bookstore, you find...

quests.description_chs: 「掇星攫辰天君」的驱魔能力竟是源于「百无禁忌箓」的效果。在他这次意外失手以后，你们向着「邪气」丘丘人离开的方向追去…
quests.description_en: Starsnatcher's ability to purge evil stems from the Sigil of Permission. After an unforeseen mishap, you give chase to a group of hilichurls with an evil aura...

quests.description_chs: 为了回收「百无禁忌箓」并警示「假仙人」不要再作恶，你们准备在魈的指导下施展真正的「仙法」，让「假仙人」在睡梦中得到些教训。
quests.description_en: Under Xiao's guidance, you prepare to use adepti arts to recover the Sigil of Permission and warn the false adeptus of his evil ways. You will confront the false adeptus in a dream and teach him a lesson...

quests.description_chs: (test)结尾处理魈$HIDDEN
冒险行至无妄坡，派蒙好像觉得有什么不对劲…
quests.description_en: Your adventure takes you to Wuwang Hill, where Paimon senses that something is amiss...

quests.description_chs: 为了帮助胡桃而前往冒险家协会，却没想到她想要做的是往生堂的「业务拓展」。在谈及生死的话题上胡桃毫不避讳，虽然她自有一套道理，但你总觉得不太能接受。当你道出疑虑之后，胡桃却惊讶地解释道，「业务拓展」早已结束，现在要寻找一位名叫狼哥的人。
quests.description_en: When you agreed to help Hu Tao and followed her to the Adventurers' Guild, you hadn't counted on becoming part of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's "business development" efforts. No topic is too sensitive for Hu Tao — certainly not matters of life and death — and even though some of her points make sense, you find them somewhat difficult to stomach. Then, when you voice your doubts about her approach, she tells you that she has long since moved on from business development to her next objective: finding someone called "Big G."

quests.description_chs: 从老孟那里，你得知狼哥是他的童年好友，因意外身亡，而现今灵异事件频发，老孟认为是狼哥化作了厉鬼，心中颇为惋惜与担忧。和老孟同样相信凶鬼恶灵传说的，还有一位前来拜访往生堂驱咒的洛成。而胡桃知道让他们如此不安的东西其实只是心理作用，于是将计就计，设下了假的驱咒仪式。没想到仪式之后，狼哥的魂灵竟然主动出现了。
quests.description_en: Meng tells you that Big G is his childhood friend, who died by misadventure. Filled with regret and worry, Meng believes that due to a supernatural turn of events, Big G has become an evil spirit. Luocheng, another superstitious person who believes in ghost stories just like Meng, visits the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor seeking an exorcism. However, Hu Tao knows that the source of their worries is imaginary, so she comes up with an equally make-believe solution and organizes a fake exorcism. Surprisingly, the spirit of Big G appears before your eyes after the ritual.

quests.description_chs: 原来狼哥的魂灵是被驱咒仪式吸引而来，在了解到狼哥并非恶鬼，只是关心老孟以及其他童年好友的生活现状之后，胡桃决定满足他的心愿，并为他举办一个欢送仪式。为了解开狼哥的心结，你从他的童年好友那里获得了信物，还获得了他们对狼哥的祝福。现在一切就绪，只待启程与送别。
quests.description_en: It turns out that Big G's spirit was attracted by the exorcism. Upon learning that Big G has not become a malevolent spirit and simply wanted to check on Meng and other childhood friends, Hu Tao decides to fulfill his wish and organize a farewell ceremony for him. To give him peace of mind, you collect keepsakes and well-wishes that Big G's childhood friends prepared for him. The only thing left now is to send him off.

quests.description_chs: 在「霜月之坊」里，你遇见了正在思索某事的菈乌玛…
quests.description_en: You encounter Lauma, who is deep in thought, at the Frostmoon Enclave...

quests.description_chs: 你们探索的脚步在小岛上响起，四处静谧无人，唯一的灯塔在黑暗中沉默…
quests.description_en: Your explorative footsteps echo on the island. There is no one around, and the sole lighthouse remains silent in the darkness...

quests.description_chs: 蛋卷工坊中，爱诺正为一个出了问题的机器人大感烦恼…
quests.description_en: In the Krumkake Craftshop, Aino is currently having trouble with a malfunctioning robot...

quests.description_chs: 来自枫丹的研究员茜涅特设计了一种机器人，但是各种突发故障让她不得不向爱诺求助…
quests.description_en: Fontainian researcher Ginette has designed a certain type of robot, but has asked Aino for help due to running into various malfunctions...

quests.description_chs: 在已成型的「大书库」里，你遇见了正在思索某事的菈乌玛…
quests.description_en: You encounter Lauma, who is deep in thought at the completed Grand Library...

quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的凯瑟琳那里有新委托，你和派蒙决定前去看看。
quests.description_en: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild in Liyue Harbor has a new commission for you. You and Paimon decide to find out what it's all about.

quests.description_chs: 抵达案发矿区，你们展开了调查。接二连三的线索表明，这起失踪事件并不简单…隐藏在事件背后的神秘人物，与失踪矿工之间究竟有何联系？消失的矿工去了哪里？你十分在意。
quests.description_en: You arrive at the mine, the scene of the incident, and begin your investigation. A series of clues makes clear that there is nothing ordinary about this disappearance. What is the connection between the mysterious person behind this incident and the missing miners? Where did the missing miners disappear to? You have to know the truth.

quests.title_en: Shifting Earth and Lost Threads Come to Light
quests.description_chs: 从矿区找到的线索来看，工人们似乎沿着道路向北去了。你们一路追踪，不断缩减与他们的距离…
quests.description_en: The evidence at the mining site suggests that the miners followed the road north. You follow the trail, gradually closing in on them.

quests.title_en: Amidst Chaos, the Rock Is Unmoved
quests.description_chs: 最终，你们来到南天门一带。年代久远的奇树静静伫立在此，见证着岁月与山河。为了救回工人、解开谜团，你们一步步走向埋藏着答案的古老之地…
quests.description_en: Finally, you reach Nantianmen. A curious ancient tree has quietly stood here throughout the ages, bearing witness to all that has come to pass. To rescue the miners and solve this puzzle once and for all, you proceed to the ancient site that holds all the answers...

quests.description_chs: 太阳总会刺穿阴霾洒下希望…
quests.description_en: The sun will always pierce the darkness and shine hope down...

quests.description_chs: 茜涅特对上次找回的机器人进行了调试，而她的研究也出现了一种新的可能…
quests.description_en: Ginette tweaks the recovered robots, and a new possibility blooms for her research...

quests.description_chs: 多亏了你孜孜不倦的收集材料，蛋卷工坊的操作台已经大变模样…
quests.description_en: Thanks to your tireless efforts in collecting materials, the Krumkake Craftshop's workbench has a spanking new groove...

quests.description_chs: 茜涅特的创意似乎行得通，但还差最后一步…
quests.description_en: Ginette's idea seems to work, but she's just one step away...

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙都希望看到茜涅特完成她的研究，但这项研究牵连到的人和事似乎远比你们想象中的更复杂…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon both hope to see Ginette's research bear fruit. However, the actors in this play turn out to be much more than they seem...

quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱的冒险家协会，你们再次看见了某一位熟悉的身影…
quests.description_en: You once again encounter a familiar face at the Adventurers' Guild in Nod-Krai...
quests.unlockDescription_chs: 完成此任务可解锁功能「地区委托·挪德卡莱」
quests.unlockDescription_en: Complete this quest to unlock commissions for Nod-Krai

quests.description_chs: 负责发放餐食的莉莉希似乎遇见了一些麻烦…
quests.description_en: Lyylikki, who is in charge of food distribution, seems to be in some trouble...

quests.description_chs: 驻守在望崖营壁的执灯人似乎遇到了什么麻烦…
quests.description_en: The Lightkeepers stationed at Cliffwatch Camp seem to have run into some trouble...

quests.description_chs: 营地整备完成后，叶洛亚也可以休息一会了吧…
quests.description_en: Once the camp is set up, Illuga should be able to rest for a while...

quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱散步时，误入了一片神秘的区域…
quests.description_en: While taking a walk through Nod-Krai, you stumble into a mysterious place...

quests.description_chs: 魔女的小屋完成后，里面会不时地响起欢声笑语…
quests.description_en: After completing the mage's lodge, the sounds of laughter and cheer can be heard coming from within...

quests.description_chs: 西风骑士团的远征军们，似乎在期待着什么…
quests.description_en: The Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force seems to be anticipating something...

quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的「舞术交流」，纳塔和须弥的朋友们都颇有收获…
quests.description_en: The dance exchange has been incredibly fruitful for both the Natlan and Sumeru dancers...

quests.description_chs: 这座据点仍在茁壮成长，如人们希望的那样，如风带来的种子那样…
quests.description_en: Just as people hoped, this post is still thriving, like seeds on the wind...

quests.description_chs: 在「银月之庭」，与哥伦比娅共度一段时光…
quests.description_en: Spend some time with Columbina in the Silvermoon Hall...

在挪德卡莱，你们遇见了一位名为「青霆」的信使，她正忙着部署自己的独特军团…
quests.description_en: In Nod-Krai, you encounter a messenger named Blue Bolt, who seems to be testing a certain mechanical defense unit...

quests.description_chs: 发现了似曾相识的巨塔…
quests.description_en: You discover a strangely familiar tower...

quests.description_en: A special training ground has been set up in the southern section of Lumidouce Harbor in Fontaine...

quests.description_chs: 「弹道推理」的演习临近结束，夏沃蕾和恰斯卡似乎达成了某种共识…
quests.description_en: As the Ballistic Deduction drill nears its end, Chevreuse and Chasca seem to have reached some sort of consensus...

quests.description_chs: 收到了一封来自烟谜主的求救信，署名是欧洛伦，发生什么事了呢…
quests.description_en: You receive a letter from the Masters of the Night-Wind asking for your help, signed by Ororon. Just what could have happened...

quests.title_en: To Gaze Upon the Dreaming Pale Crown
quests.description_chs: 根据「灰眸」的指引，他其中一块力量的碎皮似乎就在至冬宫之后，那巨大的「沙皇白桦」生长之处…
quests.description_en: According to the directions from the Eye of Graeae, one of the fragments of his power is located behind Zapolyarny Palace, where the Tsar's White Birch grows...

quests.title_en: The Stone Beasts, Like Ghouls Seated
quests.description_chs: 想办法在白沙皇昔日的行宫也是今日的陵寝之中，寻找到「灰眸」力量的一部分吧…
quests.description_en: Find a way to track down the fragment of the Eye of Graeae's power inside the mausoleum that was once the Belyi Tsar's itinerant court...

quests.description_chs: 乘坐升降梯后，礼堂已经近在眼前…
quests.description_en: You've taken the elevator up. Now, the assembly hall is right in front of you...

quests.description_chs: 掉入了神秘的下水道，需要想办法尽快回到地面上…
quests.description_en: You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible...

quests.description_chs: 风雪中亮着一盏孤灯…
quests.description_en: A lone lamp shines in the snowstorm...

quests.description_chs: 要完整回收「灰眸」的力量，得先回收分散在各处的力量碎片…
quests.description_en: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

quests.description_chs: (test)钟楼$UNRELEASED
「仪式」还没有最终完成，必须在那之前阻止帕芙琳娜…
quests.description_en: The ritual is not yet complete. Better stop Pavlina before that happens...

回到地面后，前往娜斯佳口中的「镇门口」寻找娜斯佳吧。
quests.description_en: You've made it out of the sewer. Now, go look for Nastya at the "town entrance" she told you about earlier.

quests.title_en: To Rest in a Forgotten Field
quests.description_chs: 跟随娜斯佳一同回「家」…
quests.description_en: Follow Nastya "home"...

quests.description_chs: 战胜了扎拉后，快去寻找娜斯佳吧…
quests.description_en: You have defeated Zala. Go look for Nastya now...

quests.description_chs: (test)火鸟镇软前置$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
娜斯佳口中的「家」，是远处那座高大的礼堂…
quests.description_en: The "home" Nastya keeps speaking of is right inside that assembly hall looming in the distance...

quests.title_chs: 普洛克路斯忒斯的寝床
quests.description_chs: 赫斯珀利德斯之馆的所谓婚礼并非想象中那般美好，帕芙琳娜要将伊科尔作为牺牲献祭以实现愿望，所幸仪式被阿克西妮娅打断，帕芙琳娜也被拽入影域之中，与阿克西妮娅周旋…
quests.description_en: The so-called wedding at the House of Hesperides turns out to be less delightful than expected. Pavlina tries to sacrifice Ikor for her wish, though she is fortunately thwarted by Aksinya in the end. Pavlina is also thrown into the Shadow Realm, where she will continue to face off with Aksinya...

quests.title_chs: 伟大的心锁于纤细之链
quests.title_en: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
quests.description_chs: 在冻土的暴风雪中间，居然看到了一个巨大的身影…它究竟是为什么被冰雪塑造的锁链捆缚在了这冰原之上呢？
quests.description_en: Deep amidst the permafrost's howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye... Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?

quests.title_en: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants
quests.description_chs: 曾一度被锁链捆缚于冰原之上的巨人这次出现在了海边…他到底先要去往什么地方？
quests.description_en: The giant once bound by chains upon the tundra has appeared by the sea... Where is he headed first?

quests.description_chs: 要完整回收「灰眸」的力量，得先回收分散在各处的力量碎片…
quests.description_en: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

quests.description_chs: 冰雪的巨人似乎想要用胸口的火焰点亮影域中浮现的灯塔。看来，得融化灯塔上的冰雪，他才可能做到这一点…
quests.description_en: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you'll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first...

quests.title_en: Burn the Storehouses and the Stables
quests.description_chs: 走在路上，见到了至冬帮派的成员在欺负至冬的市民，虽然出手帮忙解决了纠纷，但是在这场小小的纠纷背后似乎还隐藏着更复杂的情况。
quests.description_en: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.

quests.description_chs: 「伊兹梅洛」确实在其头目「小阁下」的带领下，企图找到能够打开影域的办法。为了知道更多的情报，我们得从据点救出失联的潜伏人员葛列娃…
quests.description_en: The Izmaylovs are indeed trying to find a way to open the Shadow Realm under the leadership of its boss, the Little Sire. To gather more information, we must rescue Gureva from their base, an undercover operative who has lost contact...

quests.description_chs: (test)你在洞穴里遇见了个神秘人……$UNRELEASED
在路过海屑镇南边的伐木场时，居然遇到了欺负当地伐木场工人的兽怪…好像又是帮派成员惹的事？看来是我们应该出手的时候了！
quests.description_en: While passing a lumberyard south of Morepesok, you unexpectedly ran into some Volkodlaks harassing the local workers... Looks like it's trouble stirred up by gang members again? Seems like it's time for you to step in.

quests.description_en: A strange block of ice floats upon the water. A mysterious voice comes to you over a pipe system, claiming that there is a wooden cabin hanging upside down beneath the ice. Clear the brash ice nearby, and you might cause the cabin to show its true form...

quests.title_en: The Sunken Ship Sailed Past, Ringing No Bells
quests.description_chs: 一座冰上的木屋停在水面。这似曾相识的木屋里，或许正有一位老熟人驻足。他又遇到麻烦了吗？过去确认一下情况吧…
quests.description_en: A wooden cabin has come to a stop above the water. This rather familiar house may currently play host to a certain old acquaintance. Is he in trouble again? Head over to ascertain the situation...

quests.description_chs: 冰上的木屋似乎马上就要沉向海底。这段时间究竟发生了什么？那位不愿上岸的屋主是否还在木屋中？靠近木屋看看吧。
quests.description_en: The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.

quests.description_en: When you've got some leisure time, how about taking a stroll through Mondstadt's streets and seeing if there's anything to do?

quests.description_chs: 身为温迪重要的助手，你将和他一起回收蒙德人的情诗作业。然而，即便是节日期间，蒙德人也有着各式各样的烦恼。
quests.description_en: As Venti's all-important assistant, you are to go out with him to collect the love poetry written by the people of Mondstadt. However, the citizenry has various troubles of their own, even during such a festive time as this.

quests.title_chs: 争锋！全境冒险家的较量！
quests.description_chs: 前往至冬冒险家协会总部的路上，你与派蒙被两名「S级」冒险家截住了去路…
quests.description_en: While heading to the Snezhnaya Adventurers' Guild headquarters, you and Paimon are stopped in your tracks by two "S-Rank" adventurers...

quests.title_en: The Way of Mutual Aid and Advancement?
quests.description_chs: 总算来到了至冬，你和派蒙打算抽空去海屑镇看看…
quests.description_en: Having finally made it to Snezhnaya, you and Paimon decide to stop by Morepesok when you have the chance...

quests.description_chs: 与「强化互助会」的小朋友们经历了一段时间的轻松合作后，探索计划基本完成了，琪琪科娃似乎也有了新收获…
quests.description_en: After a period of relaxed cooperation with the children of the "Mutual Aid Advancement Network," the exploration plan has essentially been completed, and Chichikova seems to have gained some new insights...

quests.title_chs: 派蒙的「帝利耶悉」解题法
quests.description_chs: 首届「冒险家竞技大赛」决出了胜者——你和派蒙，除了来自至冬总部的奖励，你们还将面对一系列特殊的问题…
quests.description_en: The first Adventurers' Tournament has concluded, with you and Paimon emerging as the winners. In addition to rewards from the Snezhnaya Headquarters, you'll also be faced with a series of special questions...

派蒙想在「万文集舍」找找看有没有《提瓦特游览指南》的璃月篇。
quests.description_en: Paimon wants to know whether the Wanwen Bookhouse has the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide in stock.

quests.description_chs: 为了找书来到轻策庄拜访常九爷，却正好撞见强买强卖一事。同行的行秋忿忿不平，想要调查主导这桩生意的茂才公的底细。
quests.description_en: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.

quests.description_chs: 原来茂才公想要完成和愚人众的订单，需要大量石珀。行秋写下了一封信，希望「飞云商会」能出手帮忙。
quests.description_en: It turns out Gentry Maocai needs a great deal of Cor Lapis to satisfy an order from the Fatui. Xingqiu has written a letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, hoping that they can help.

quests.description_chs: 按照信中的计策，「飞云商会」成功收购了璃月港能买到的所有石珀。只要能买下常九爷手上的石珀，茂才公就陷入了无料可用的绝境。
quests.description_en: As per Xingqiu's plan, the Feiyun Commerce Guild bought up all the Cor Lapis in Liyue Harbor. All that remains is to purchase Chang the Ninth's batch and Gentry Maocai will have nowhere left to turn.

quests.description_chs: 神里绫华似乎有话要说，到木漏茶室前找她聊聊吧。
quests.description_en: Kamisato Ayaka seems to have something to discuss with you. Meet up for a chat with her at Komore Teahouse.

quests.description_chs: 受神里绫华委托，你和派蒙陪她一起准备与「椿」见面所需的礼物。
quests.description_en: At Ayaka's request, you and Paimon accompany her to prepare gifts necessary to meet "Tsubaki."

quests.description_chs: 衣物制作期间，神里绫华提出带你和派蒙去「木南料亭」用餐。
quests.description_en: While the clothes are being made, Ayaka suggests that you and Paimon come with her to Kiminami Restaurant to dine.

quests.description_chs: 备齐礼物之后，你们一同前往「椿」的住处。
quests.description_en: Having prepared the gifts, you travel together to the place where "Tsubaki" lives.

quests.description_chs: 得知一切都是源自母亲小小的愿望之后，神里绫华鼓起勇气邀请你和她一起前往甘金岛，参加她向往已久的祭典。
quests.description_en: Now knowing that all this came from her mother's childhood wish, Kamisato Ayaka invites you to go with her to Amakane Island to take part in a festivity that she has been looking forward to for a long time now.

quests.description_chs: 稻妻的凯瑟琳希望你去调查一个紧急的事件…
quests.description_en: Inazuma's Katheryne would like you to help conduct an emergency investigation...

quests.description_chs: 抵达稻妻已经有一段时间，你和派蒙的探索还在继续。某一天，你们来到了海边…
quests.description_en: You've been in Inazuma for a while now, but your investigations continue. One day, you and Paimon arrive at the seaside...

quests.description_chs: 和宵宫回到「长野原烟花店」，却在偶然中见到了藏身于店内的偷渡者朔次郎，为了让他不被天领奉行众抓获，只好在准备烟花会的同时，为他寻找逃离稻妻的方法。
quests.description_en: You return with Yoimiya to Naganohara Fireworks, but discover a stowaway hiding inside the shop named Sakujirou. To prevent his capture at the hands of the Tenryou Commission, you must find a way for him to leave Inazuma while preparing for a fireworks show.

quests.description_chs: 虽然和宵宫一起为朔次郎准备好了出逃的船，但未能了却心愿的他依然犹豫不决。此时宵宫突然想起，在「长野原烟花店」的顾客中，有一对老夫妻可能可以帮上朔次郎的忙。
quests.description_en: Though you and Yoimiya managed to secure Sakujirou's passage out by sea, he wavers, unable to reconcile himself to his wish. It is at this moment that Yoimiya recalls an old couple among Naganohara Fireworks' clients who might be able to help him out.

quests.description_chs: 没想到这对老夫妻的孩子，现为天领奉行众的今谷佳祐，竟然是朔次郎的旧识。由于两人曾经发生了激烈的争吵，宵宫也无法利用这层关系解决朔次郎的困局。 与此同时，天领奉行众也追查到了「长野原烟花店」，宵宫担心朔次郎会永远错过了却心愿的机会…
quests.description_en: Unexpectedly, this old couple's child is the Tenryou Commission's Imatani Keisuke, an old acquaintance of Sakujirou's. However, the two of them once had a sharp disagreement, and so Yoimiya is unable to use this prior relationship to help Sakujirou out of his bind. As the Tenryou Commission closes in on Naganohara Fireworks, Yoimiya fears that Sakujirou will forever forfeit his chance to fulfill his wish...

quests.description_chs: 冒险告一段落，你与派蒙打算再去千手百眼神像看看…
quests.description_en: Your adventure has come to an end for now. You and Paimon decide to pay the Statue of the Omnipresent God a visit...

quests.description_chs: 将军由于某些原因无法行动，你却意外地将居于「一心净土」中的影请了出来。为了帮她换个心情，就带她在城里随意转转吧。
quests.description_en: The Shogun seems to be indisposed for some reason, but you, quite unexpectedly, manage to invite Ei to come forth from her Plane of Euthymia. You decide to take her on a trip around town for a change of pace.

quests.description_chs: 在你的引领下，影见识到了许多新奇事物，显得很享受的样子。为了纪念这段难得的休闲时光，你提议为她留影。
quests.description_en: With you as her tour guide, Ei witnesses a great many new things and even seems to be enjoying herself. You decide to remember this leisurely time by taking a picture.

quests.description_chs: 一平说九条镰治去见鹰司家的家主，至今没有归来，影决定亲自出面解决天领奉行内部的问题。于是，你和影一同前往位于野外的鹰司家的隐秘驻地…
quests.description_en: Ippei says that Kujou Kamaji has gone to see the head of the Takatsukasa Clan. Ei decides to go there personally to settle the issue of the Tenryou Commission's internal affairs. Thus, you and Ei head out into the wilds, toward the secret base of the Takatsukasa Clan...

quests.title_chs: (test)隐藏任务用于播放八重神子最后的闲置对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏任务用于播放八重神子最后的闲置对话$HIDDEN
战争结束后，你收到了心海的来信，海祇岛正在准备庆功晚会，心海希望你也能来一起参加。 然而，当你抵达海祇岛的时候，却发现这里似乎有些不太对劲…
quests.description_en: The war is over, and you have received a letter from Kokomi, saying that Watatsumi Island is going to hold a Victory Feast, and that she would like you to attend. However, when you arrive on Watatsumi Island, you find that not all is right with the world here...

quests.description_chs: 海祇岛与天领奉行的和谈将近，岛上却出现了「天领奉行与愚人众仍有勾结」的传言。为了调查真相，心海决定进攻愚人众临时营地…
quests.description_en: Peace talks between Watatsumi Island and the Tenryou Commission are due to commence, but a rumor that the Tenryou Commission remains in cahoots with the Fatui is still circulating around the island. To uncover the truth, Kokomi decides to assault the Fatui's temporary encampment...

quests.description_chs: 与心海约定第二天在珊瑚宫附近见面，早点动身出发吧。
quests.description_en: You have agreed to meet Kokomi near Sangonomiya Shrine. Time to move out.

quests.description_chs: 与心海一起前往篝火晚会现场，听心海发表庆功演说。
quests.description_en: Go to the site of the Victory Feast with Kokomi and listen to her speech.

quests.description_chs: 与心海一同赶往和谈现场。海祇岛与幕府的未来，到底会往什么方向发展呢？
quests.description_en: You hurry towards the site where the peace talks are to begin. What will the future of Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate look like?

quests.description_chs: 根据珊瑚提供的线索，你出发前往八酝岛…
quests.description_en: You set off to Yashiori Island using the clues Sango provided...

quests.description_chs: 被大辅发现蹊跷后，荒泷一斗不得不和你讲明了缘由：他所做的一切都是为了袒护青鬼。为了见证真相，你再次与荒泷一斗一同出发。
quests.description_en: After Daisuke points out the inconsistencies in his story, Arataki Itto is forced to reveal to you that he is currently acting to protect the blue oni. To ascertain the truth, you agree to set out with Itto once again.

quests.description_chs: (test)鬼婆婆闲置对话任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
本想去八重堂看看，没想到来了花见坂之后，却发现这里比平时更加热闹…
quests.description_en: You planned to visit the Yae Publishing House, but after arriving in Hanamizaka, you find that it is more lively than usual here...

quests.description_chs: 原来洋平与信悟是用了《真实探灵笔记》中记载的方法进行了降灵。八重神子提出到八重堂前商议对策…
quests.description_en: It turns out that Youhei and Shingo had summoned a spirit with the method recorded in "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Yae Miko suggests going to the Yae Publishing House to discuss how to respond...

quests.description_chs: 轻小说大获成功，顺利削弱了《真实探灵笔记》的影响，也是时候把幕后凶手抓出来了。
quests.description_en: The light novel is a great hit. It has successfully outshone "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Now, it is time to catch the spirit behind it.

quests.description_chs: 我们能为那些妖怪们做些什么呢？平心而论，大概只有一场盛大的欢送会吧。
quests.description_en: What can we do for these youkai? If you were to answer honestly, it could only be a grand farewell party.

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙路过「小仓屋」，意外遇到了两位熟人…
quests.description_en: As you and Paimon pass by Ogura Textiles & Kimonos, you bump into two rather familiar people...

quests.title_en: The Truth Is Also a Lie
quests.description_chs: 在送上祝福的过程中，神里绫人渐渐察觉到这场婚姻背后隐藏着不为人知的阴谋。根据他的推理，你们正在迅速靠近真相…
quests.description_en: As you go off to send your well-wishes, Ayato gradually realizes that there is some plot at play behind this wedding. According to his reasoning, you are rapidly approaching the truth...

quests.description_chs: 神里绫人称应做之事已经完成，接下来就静待勘定奉行内部的反应。事情真的会如他预料那样发展吗…
quests.description_en: Ayato claims that your job is done and that all that remains is to wait for the Kanjou Commission's internal reaction. Will things really proceed as he thinks they will?

quests.title_en: Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow
quests.description_chs: 在冒险的途中，你和派蒙来到白狐之野附近…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon travel near Byakko Plain on your journey...

quests.title_en: Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled
quests.description_chs: 为了防止袭击者造成更多伤害，你和枫原万叶决定去调查他的身份。
quests.description_en: To prevent the attacker from causing more harm, you and Kazuha decide to investigate his identity.

quests.title_en: Ere the End, a Glance Back
quests.description_chs: 原来失踪事件的罪魁祸首就是控制了天目优也的妖刀。为了拯救天目优也，也为了证明妖刀的想法荒谬可笑，枫原万叶最终亲自拿起了妖刀。
quests.description_en: As it turns out, the one behind the missing person case is a cursed blade that has possessed Amenoma Yuuya's body. To save the latter and to prove the absurdity of the blade's fixation, Kazuha eventually takes up the cursed blade himself.

quests.description_chs: 稻妻的冒险家协会，似乎有一项关于神樱树的委托…
quests.description_en: The Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma seems to have a commission concerning the Sacred Sakura...

quests.description_chs: 神樱树破损的根系中逸散出了许多人的回忆，雷电影借此机会向你讲述了她所珍视的友人，以及她想要保护的稻妻的诸多故事。
quests.description_en: Many people's memories have escaped from the damaged roots of the Sacred Sakura. Raiden Ei takes the opportunity to tell you many stories about her cherished friends and the Inazuma she wants to protect.

quests.description_chs: 在雷电真残存的意识空间之内，影和人偶将军开始了看不到尽头的战斗。为了稻妻，也是为了影，你想要像过去那样帮助影，让她能顺利通过此番艰苦的考验。
quests.description_en: In Raiden Makoto's remnant realm of consciousness, Ei and the Shogun Puppet engage in an endless fight. For Inazuma, and also for Ei herself, you wish to lend a hand — as you once did — to help her get through this sore test.

quests.title_en: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
quests.description_chs: 因为派蒙的心血来潮而重返稻妻的你偶遇了某种不知名的小妖怪，你被它吸引着，踏入了一场月下的邂逅…
quests.description_en: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙使用瑞希赠送的邀请函找到了那家名为秋沙钱汤的店，但在享受服务之前，你们发觉这家店的经营情况似乎很不乐观…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon follow the address on Mizuki's invitation and find your way to the Aisa Bathhouse. However, before you take the chance to enjoy a pleasant soak, it strikes you that business at the bathhouse isn't going so well...

quests.description_chs: 秋沙钱汤面临的经营危机似乎即将过去，但一场变故又突然来临。你和瑞希都意识到，你们并没有解决危机的根源…
quests.description_en: The financial troubles at the Aisa Bathhouse appear to be almost over when a sudden turn of events turns everything on its head. You and Mizuki soon realize that the root cause of the crisis still persists...

quests.description_chs: 在荒无人烟的孤岛上，你和瑞希找到了江村中弥的藏身地。有关近期这些噩梦事件的真相，似乎就潜藏其中…
quests.description_en: On a lonely and desolate island, you and Mizuki discover the hiding place of Emura Chuuya. It seems that the truth behind the recent nightmares may well be lurking inside...

quests.description_chs: 魇带来的危机终于被彻底解决，你也从瑞希那里收到了新的邀请函，派蒙终于可以享受她心心念念的全套服务了…
quests.description_en: The nightmare crisis has finally been resolved and you have received a new invitation letter from Mizuki. Finally time for Paimon to enjoy the all-inclusive spa day she's been so looking forward to...

quests.description_chs: 根据雅洛维娅的说法，影域可能是最不安定的一种「灾害」。因此，必须让潜藏其中的危险因素尽快得到妥善的处理…
quests.description_en: According to Yarovaya, the Shadow Realm may be the most unstable type of "disaster." The dangers lurking within must therefore be dealt with as swiftly as possible...

quests.description_chs: 初到佩特莉可镇便遇上了一连串怪事，你决定前往镇上一探究竟…
quests.description_en: You encounter a series of strange occurrences after arriving in Petrichor for the first time. You decide to get to the bottom of it all...

quests.description_chs: 在一切结束之后，回去佩特莉可镇看看吧…
quests.description_en: Now that everything is over, it is time to go back to Petrichor to check up on the situation...

quests.description_en: You haven't gone to see Katheryne in a while. Why don't you go have a look?

quests.description_chs: 有了机械螃蟹充当「导游」，是时候前往污染区深处了。
quests.description_en: With the mechanical crab as your guide, it is time to head to the contaminated region.

quests.description_chs: 机械螃蟹停在了某个地方，里面似乎就是污染区的源头。
quests.description_en: The mechanical crab has stopped at a certain point. The source of the contamination seems to be within.

quests.description_chs: 离开实验室后，首先要将污染解除的消息告知凯瑟琳…
quests.description_en: Now that you've left the lab, you should inform Katheryne that the contamination issue has been resolved.

quests.title_en: The Warm Rhythm of the Streets
quests.description_chs: 为了筹备冒险物资，你和派蒙来到了大巴扎…
quests.description_en: To prepare supplies for your adventure, you and Paimon come to the Grand Bazaar...

quests.description_chs: 在你的鼓励下，妮露决定就剧场拆除一事和教令院学者进行辩论。为此，她需要收集很多论据。
quests.description_en: With your encouragement, Nilou decided to debate with the Akademiya scholar about the demolition of the theatre. Thus, she needs to collect a lot of information.

quests.title_en: The Reason We Are Gathered Here
quests.description_chs: 一切准备完毕，接下来就看妮露在辩论中的表现了。
quests.description_en: Everything is ready and now it's up to Nilou's performance in the debate.

quests.description_chs: 你们决定到教令院看看…
quests.description_en: You decide to take a look around the Akademiya...

quests.description_chs: 打跑了不停威逼利诱的佣兵团，是时候动身去沙漠了。
quests.description_en: You repelled the chasing mercenaries and now it is time to leave for the desert.

quests.description_chs: 似乎连风纪官都卷入了罐装知识走私案中，赛诺决定让你携带密信返回教令院，进入秘密资料室打探消息。
quests.description_en: It seems that even a matra is involved in the Canned Knowledge smuggling. Cyno decided to let you take the secret letter back to the Akademiya and enter the Restricted Repository to procure information.

quests.description_chs: 某天，你和派蒙在须弥城里，听到了很多人在讨论梦境的话题…
quests.description_en: One day, you and Paimon notice that many people in Sumeru City are talking about dreams...

quests.description_chs: 你们意识到可能有许多人都和埃勒曼一样，正在经历不同寻常的梦境。为了避免这场梦产生更多危害，你们必须尽快返回「品梦一刻」采取措施。
quests.description_en: You realize that many people may be experiencing unusual dreams just like Ilman. To prevent the dreams from causing more harm, you must return to "A Moment of Dreams" to take measures.

quests.description_chs: 人为创造的梦境并没有消除苦难，只是制造了甜蜜的骗局。它在失控中轰然崩塌，众人终于怀抱着复杂的心情回到了现实…
quests.description_en: The artificial dream failed to erase suffering but instead created a sweet illusion. It has gone out of control and eventually collapsed. Everyone has now returned to reality with mixed feelings...

quests.description_chs: (test)火堆熄灭控制任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
某日，你和派蒙在城门口偶遇了一位熟悉的朋友…
quests.description_en: One day, you and Paimon run into an old friend at Sumeru's city gates...

quests.description_chs: 听说艾尔海森当上了代理贤者，以他的性格真的没问题吗？去教令院打听一下吧。
quests.description_en: You've heard that Alhaitham has become the Acting Grand Sage. Considering his personality, will the other scholars accept him? Time to pay the Akademiya a visit.

quests.description_chs: 伊利亚斯记得自己有两件不得不做的事，其中一件是去调研筹备处领取薪水。
quests.description_en: Ilyas remembered two things that he had to do, one of which is to collect his pay at the Research Preparation Center.

quests.description_chs: 在化城郭，伊利亚斯恢复了过去的记忆。他说自己想起来了西拉杰的藏身之所，跟他一起去看看吧。
quests.description_en: While stopping by Gandharva Ville, Ilyas managed to recover his memories. It's now time to follow him to Siraj's hideout.

quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙行至大巴扎…
quests.description_en: One day, you and Paimon stop by the Grand Bazaar...

quests.description_chs: 在调查中，你们意外发现了迪娜泽黛父亲的名字。商量之后，迪希雅认为要把整件事告诉迪娜泽黛…
quests.description_en: During your investigation, you accidentally stumbled upon Dunyarzad's father's name. After discussing the matter with Dehya, she decides that Dunyarzad should be informed of all that has transpired...

quests.description_chs: 原来迪希雅的父亲早已亡故，团员们一直都想为他复仇。在审判降临之前，迪希雅选择成为他们的助力。
quests.description_en: The truth is revealed. Dehya's father has long passed. Still, his comrades in arms seek to avenge him. Before judgment falls, Dehya decides to lend them her aid.

quests.title_en: What Shape Does the Self Hold
quests.description_chs: 在调查中得知，阿佩普很可能已经病入膏肓。为了知晓拯救它的办法，你们必须去一趟层岩巨渊，寻找一只特殊的元素生物。
quests.description_en: From your investigation, it seems that Apep might be terminally ill. To learn how to save it, you must make a trip to The Chasm and find a special elemental life-form.

quests.title_en: Another Home There May Yet Be
quests.description_chs: 元素生命的「家人」久久没有离去。为了有朝一日它们还能重聚，也需要妥善处理眼前的分别…
quests.description_en: The elemental life-forms' "family" linger around for a long time. In order for them to be reunited one day, you have to first properly deal with the parting in the present moment...

quests.title_en: The Seeker of a Meteor Shower
quests.description_chs: 稻妻城的少女正在筹备一次浪漫的旅行…
quests.description_en: Back in Inazuma, Yoimiya is preparing for a romantic journey...

quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙告诉宵宫流星雨会回应愿望而出现，宵宫想要为此做一些准备。
quests.description_en: You and Paimon tell Yoimiya that meteor showers respond to people's wishes. In response, Yoimiya wants to spend some time getting herself ready for the occasion...

quests.title_en: A Flower that Blooms Across the Sky
quests.description_chs: 艾文不愿忘记自己的兰那罗朋友，你们决定帮她把曾经美好的回忆都找回来，这件事也得到了应召而来的兰那罗的帮助。
quests.description_en: Avin doesn't want to forget her Aranara friend, so you resolve to help her recover the wonderful memories of her past. The Aranara you summoned is also happy to lend a hand...

quests.description_chs: （test）补充爱尔海森个人线全局变量$HIDDEN
你和派蒙回到须弥探望当地的朋友们。
quests.description_en: You and Paimon return to Sumeru to visit some local friends.

quests.description_chs: 许久不见，你和派蒙受邀与赛诺、提纳里及柯莱一同露营。
quests.description_en: It's been some time since your last meeting. You and Paimon are invited to go camping with Cyno, Tighnari, and Collei.

quests.description_chs: 居勒什的异样情况引起众人警觉，赛诺更是独自前去追他。作为好朋友，你、派蒙和提纳里绝不会对他的困难坐视不理。
quests.description_en: Cyrus's strange situation puts everyone on alert, and Cyno went after him alone. As his friends, you, Paimon, and Tighnari could never turn a blind eye to his predicament.

quests.description_chs: 赛索斯带你们进入古老的缄默之殿，在那里，你们得知了居勒什孤身进入沙漠的原因，以及赛诺身上这份力量的来由。接下来，就该面对缄默之殿的要求了。
quests.description_en: Sethos leads you into the ancient Temple of Silence. There, you learn why Cyrus went into the desert alone, and the origin of Cyno's power. Next, it's time to face the requirements of the Temple of Silence.

quests.title_en: The Dead Past is the Living Present
quests.description_chs: 事情告一段落，你们一行人将告别古老之地，返回教令院…
quests.description_en: After the sands have settled, you and the others bid farewell to the ancient grounds and return to the Akademiya...

quests.description_chs: (test)4.6赛诺2隐藏父任务$HIDDEN
在金苹果群岛中的「双双岛」中，你发现了一枚奇怪的海螺。而海螺里的那些声音，似乎还在暗示着什么…
quests.description_en: You discover a strange conch shell on Twinning Isle in the Golden Apple Archipelago. The sounds that come from within seem to hint at something...

quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上，你们遇见了一个奇怪的仙灵…
quests.description_en: You meet a strange Seelie on Minacious Isle...

quests.description_chs: 不知道究竟是因为什么原因，这座岛似乎始终处于一种奇怪的天气中…
quests.description_en: No one knows why, but this island seems to be forever affected by strange weather conditions...

quests.description_chs: 在一座无名岛屿上，你们发现了一截奇怪的断船，但是，这艘船究竟是从哪里来的呢…
quests.description_en: You discover a strange wrecked ship on a nameless island. But the question is, where did this ship come from?

quests.title_en: The Other Side of Isle and Sea
quests.description_chs: 在金苹果群岛中，你发现了一幅奇怪的壁画…
quests.description_en: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...

quests.title_en: A Trip Through Fog and Wind
quests.description_chs: 在金苹果群岛中，你发现了一幅奇怪的壁画…
quests.description_en: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...

quests.description_chs: 派蒙对阿贝多的情况很好奇…
quests.description_en: Paimon is very curious about Albedo...

quests.description_chs: 带来快乐的神秘礼物正在某处静候…
quests.description_en: A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered...
