quests.title_en: Thus Was the Work Done in Vain
quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上偶然发现了受困于岛上陷阱的冒险家留下的笔记，但已经是很久以前发生的不可更改的事。不过，既然此刻群岛在幻境的影响之下…会不会有，仅在幻境之中的稍稍帮助他的办法？
quests.description_en: By chance, you discover notes left by an adventurer who was left stranded by Minacious Isle's traps. However, all that seems to have happened well in the now-unchangeable past. Might there be some way to help him, even if only in a Mirage?

quests.description_chs: 似乎有海盗在金苹果群岛的海域上藏起了宝藏，并且将线索一分为四，找到所有的线索，寻得宝藏吧！
quests.description_en: It seems that pirates have hidden treasure in the Golden Apple Archipelago and divided the clues up into four parts. Recover all the clues and find that treasure!

quests.description_chs: 自称大海盗船的浪船「大肉丸」似乎有什么事想要进行商谈…
quests.description_en: Miitoboru, a waverider who claims to be a mighty pirate ship, seems to have something to discuss with you...

quests.description_chs: 在破破岛上，有一位一直叨念着丢失照片的愚人众藏镜仕女，看样子似乎无法正常沟通…找到让她恢复理智的办法，说不定能得知她在此行动的目的。
quests.description_en: You meet a Fatui Mirror Maiden on Broken Isle who keeps going on about losing a photo. It seems that you won't be able to communicate with her normally... But if you find some way to bring her back to her senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why she is here.

quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上，有一位一直叨念着什么徽记的愚人众雷锤前锋军，看样子似乎无法正常沟通…找到让他恢复理智的办法，说不定能得知他在此行动的目的。
quests.description_en: You meet a Fatui Electrohammer Vanguard on Minacious Isle who keeps going on about an insignia. It seems that you won't be able to get through to him... But if you find some way to bring him back to his senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why he is here.

quests.description_chs: 之前唤醒的愚人众小队成员都回到了中央岛屿的营地里，真不知道名为雅科夫的岩使游击兵最后恢复理智了没有…
quests.description_en: The Fatui team members you've brought back to their senses have all returned to the camp on the central island. You wonder if the Geochanter Bracer named Yakov has regained his wits or not...

quests.description_chs: 布丁岛上似乎有妖狸在寻求帮助…
quests.description_en: A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...

quests.title_chs: 极夜幻想剧·王女执剑记！
quests.title_en: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!
quests.description_chs: 伟大皇女的忠诚子民，在此为所有来客献上特别的演出，一个关于爱与勇气的故事…
quests.description_en: The great Prinzessin's loyal subjects are pleased to perform for you, our guests, a performance most special: a tale of love and valor...

quests.description_chs: 「大肉丸」似乎有什么事想要拜托我们，具体的详情，就去问问他吧…
quests.description_en: Miitoboru seems to have some request. Time to ask him about the details...

quests.description_chs: 前往破破岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…
quests.description_en: Go near to the reef of Broken Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

quests.description_chs: 前往双双岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…
quests.description_en: Go near to the reef of Twinning Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

quests.description_chs: 前往危危岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…
quests.description_en: Go near to the reef of Minacious Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

quests.description_chs: 前往布丁岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…
quests.description_en: Go near to the reef of Pudding Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.

quests.description_chs: 遵循着派蒙的建议——「藏着摩拉的宝箱，一个都不能错过！」，你与派蒙打算再次造访伊迪娅，确认你们是否错过了「琉形蜃境」中某些有趣的地点。正巧，伊迪娅也筹备了一个独特的游乐项目…
quests.description_en: Following Paimon's sage advice: "Chests of hidden Mora — gotta find 'em all!," you and Paimon decide to visit Idyia again, just to make sure you didn't miss any points of interest within Veluriyam Mirage. This turns out to be perfect timing, as Idyia has prepared something unique...

quests.description_chs: 在水域中潜行并且找到宝藏$UNRELEASED
在「琉形蜃境」的一角，你和派蒙发现了一座奇特的告示喇叭，循着旁白的指引，似乎就能参与一项别具乐趣的游乐项目…
quests.description_en: In a corner of the Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon discover a strange announcement speaker, and following the instructions, it seems you can participate in a very unique attraction...

quests.title_en: The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken
quests.description_chs: 「古老的传说重现天日，丰饶无比的宝藏有了新的线索，一队侠义的海盗擦亮了武器，升起了船帆…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「黑水晶号与吞金海怪」的演出地…
quests.description_en: "An ancient legend resurfaces, and new clues to a priceless treasure are found. A band of chivalrous pirates hones their weapons and hoists the sails..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken...

quests.description_chs: 「为了拯救不幸罹难的伙伴，落单的水形幻灵即将闯入幽魂盘踞的古堡，寻找破除『魔咒』的希望…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「瞳孔里的固形魔咒」的演出地…
quests.description_en: "To save their fallen friends, the now-alone Hydro Eidolon must break into the haunted fortress, and find a way to lift the curse..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of "Petrifying Gaze"...

quests.description_chs: 「飘浮在天空之中的小镇遭遇了空前的危机，创造奇迹的建筑师要及时挽救这座正在坠落的高城…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「天空高城救守记」的演出地…
quests.description_en: "A town floating in the sky encounters an unprecedented crisis, and a miracle-working architect must act quickly to prevent the soaring city from crashing to the ground..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of Skycastle Saviors...

quests.description_chs: 循着一台「呼呼飞车」的航迹，你与派蒙意外发现了洞窟中的巨大空间，一幅神秘的壁画伫立在醒目的位置，似乎述说着某人在「琉形蜃境」中的故事…
quests.description_en: Following the tracks of a Choo-Choo Cart line, you and Paimon run into an enormous space in the cave with a mysterious mural in a very conspicuous spot, which seems to be illustrating someone's story in the "Veluriyam Mirage"...

quests.description_chs: 杰洛尼想要随时能够看到星空，不如用留影机为他拍摄一张星空的画片吧。虽然只是瓶中折射，不是真正的星空，但也是足以让人想念的美景。
quests.description_en: Jeroney wishes to be able to see the starry sky whenever he wants, so why not take a photo of it for him? Even if it's only the reflection inside the bottle and not the real thing, it will be beautiful enough.

quests.description_chs: 不知何时出现在了提瓦特大陆上的神奇秘境，为了探寻其中的奥秘，需要钻入石壁，乘坐轨道车，并且进入帐篷升起彩灯。不过，这到底都是为了什么呢…
quests.description_en: Long ago, this mysterious domain appeared in Teyvat. To probe its arcane secrets, one must enter stone walls, ride carts, and raise the lamp in the tent. But, what is it all for?

quests.title_en: Towards the Lighthouse, or Far Away
quests.description_chs: 在叠架村外倒塌的灯塔里，似乎有人正在为某事而烦恼…
quests.description_en: Something seems to be troubling someone in the collapsed lighthouse outside Brickstacks...

quests.description_chs: 绮良良说有些想要独自调查的东西。有点好奇，和她一起去看看吧…
quests.description_en: Kirara says there are a few things she must investigate alone. As you're not a cat, curiosity won't kill you, so why not go with her...

quests.title_en: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion
quests.description_chs: 雨歌塘里，似乎正在举办一场盛大的比赛…
quests.description_en: There seems to be a grand contest taking place at Rainsong Pond...

quests.description_chs: 在森林里，有一位正准备亲自去解决某个问题的公主…
quests.description_en: In the forest, a princess is preparing to go solve a certain problem herself...

quests.title_en: The Answer of the Lotus Leaves and Forest
quests.description_chs: 纸蛙的冠军福罗贝尔，与铃风王国的公主西梅似乎遇见了一个…略微有些怪异的问题。
quests.description_en: The champion paper frog Faurobert and Princess Cimest of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells seem to be in a... slightly odd predicament.

quests.title_chs: (test)折纸系列WQ完成后的闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 在星轨王城里，你遇见了一个严肃的守卫…
quests.description_en: You encounter a serious guard in Constellation Metropole...

quests.description_chs: 在星轨王城中，有一位对帽子格外有兴趣的人…
quests.description_en: There is someone in Constellation Metropole who is most enamored with hats...

quests.description_chs: 在赐福森林里，有一位纸蛙似乎制造了一件有趣的事物。
quests.description_en: In the Forest of Blessings dwells a paper frog who has made something interesting.

quests.description_chs: 在赐福森林里，有一位情绪格外亢奋的飞鼠…
quests.description_en: In the Forest of Blessings lives a particularly passionate flying squirrel...

quests.description_chs: 一切结束之后，该想想怎么处理伟大发条了。一直拿着也不是办法…
quests.description_en: After everything has come to an end, it's time to spare a thought for how to deal with the great clockwork key. It's not like you can just hold onto it...

quests.description_chs: (test)摄影呀哈哈$HIDDEN
不知怎么来到了一个神奇的地方，开始冒险吧！
quests.description_en: You've somehow ended up in a strange land. Time to explore!

quests.description_chs: 你决定前往蛇心之地，寻找「苏生之辔」的碎片。
quests.description_en: You decide to head to Serpent's Heart to search for the fragment of the Reins of Revival

quests.description_chs: 你决定前往狭间之街，寻找「苏生之辔」的碎片。
quests.description_en: You decide to head to The Narrows of Ouroboros to search for the fragment of the Reins of Revival

海灯节过去了，你们决定去探望一下兹白…
quests.description_en: After the Lantern Rite, you decide to pay Zibai a visit...

quests.description_chs: 兹白为你准备了一件小礼物，会是什么呢？
quests.description_en: Zibai has prepared a small gift for you. What could it be?

在萍溪的建议下，你们决定去寻找「吉事宝树」…
quests.description_en: Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to look for the Auspicious Treasure Tree...

quests.description_chs: 在萍溪的建议下，你们决定去查看一下「告事板」…
quests.description_en: Following Pingxi's suggestion, you decide to check out the Bulletin Board...

quests.description_chs: 枫丹廷的街道似乎比平时更热闹，四处转转吧。
quests.description_en: The bustling streets of the Court of Fontaine seem more lively than usual. Why not take a walk around?

quests.description_chs: 与林尼约定在德波大饭店门口碰面，在约好的时间去见他吧。
quests.description_en: Lyney and you agreed to meet outside Hotel Debord. Go meet him at the appointed time.

quests.description_chs: 怪盗貂被抓捕归案，林尼的魔术秀可以顺利举办了。希望一切顺利…
quests.description_en: With the Phantom Weasel arrested, Lyney's show can finally take place. Fingers crossed that everything goes smoothly...

quests.description_chs: 今天的报纸上会写什么呢？到蒸汽鸟报社附近看看吧。
quests.description_en: What's made headlines today? Go to The Steambird and check it out!

quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙来到梅洛彼得堡的监舍区域附近…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon arrive at the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide...

quests.description_chs: 聊天中，你们知晓了名为「檐帽会」的组织，正在为迷茫或孤独的罪人提供帮助。莱欧斯利提议一同去看看这些人平时的生活。
quests.description_en: Through your conversation, you learn of an organization known as the "Beret Society" that provides support for prisoners who feel helpless and lonely. Wriothesley suggests that you come with him and take a look at their daily lives.

quests.description_chs: 阿维丝提供的证据指出，「檐帽会」的会长杜吉耶为了控制手下的成员，使用了非常残忍的手段。对此恶行，无论是谁都无法坐视不管。
quests.description_en: Evidence from Avice suggests that the Beret Society's leader, Dougier, has been using extremely cruel methods to control its members. No one could sit there and watch such evil deeds unfold.

quests.description_chs: 派蒙对那维莱特很好奇，去找他聊聊天吧。
quests.description_en: Paimon is curious about Neuvillette. Go talk to him.

quests.description_chs: 那维莱特想到了一个新的调查办法，就是利用他的力量对露景泉进行感知，查找其中可疑的记忆与情感。如果能顺利就好了…
quests.description_en: Neuvillette comes up with another way to investigate — using his powers to search for memories and emotions within the Fountain of Lucine. You hope everything goes as planned...

quests.description_chs: 从娜维娅带来的嫌犯口中问出了主谋的名字，但这个人此刻正在梅洛彼得堡，看来需要亲自跑一趟那里…
quests.description_en: You learn of the culprit's name from the criminals Navia gathered. However, that person is currently at the Fortress of Meropide. It looks like you'll have to make a trip down there...

quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙来到冒险家协会查看委托…
quests.description_en: One day, you and Paimon arrive at the Adventurers' Guild to check out the commissions there...

quests.description_chs: 与剧团成员交谈了解到，还有两位关键成员没有回到剧团中，首先是负责创作后续剧本的波洛，他正在白淞镇。
quests.description_en: Having met with the troupe, you learn two critical members have yet to return. First is Pauleau, who is responsible for completing the script. He is in Poisson.

quests.title_en: This Life, Just Like a Light Trickle of Song
quests.description_chs: 剧团成员在剧本的走向上存在分歧，众人认为需要听取最后一位成员维尔芒的意见。于是你们从白淞镇动身…
quests.description_en: The members of the troupe do not see eye to eye on the ending of the script, and everyone believes they should hear what the last member, Vilmant, has to say on it. So, you set off from Poisson...

quests.description_chs: (test)4.2水神线隐藏父任务$HIDDEN
某日，你们在枫丹廷被熟悉的声音叫住…
quests.description_en: One day, you are stopped by a familiar voice while in the Court of Fontaine...

quests.description_chs: 在水边科尔特讲述了刺玫会曾经的故事，休息之后，该继续向枫丹廷出发了。
quests.description_en: Colter tells you stories of the Spina di Rosula's past. After a rest, it is time to head off to the Court of Fontaine.

quests.description_chs: 在灰河度过了充实而快乐的一夜，现在应该出发，将取到的衣服送给阿黛尔了。
quests.description_en: You have a pleasant time and a fine night in the Fleuve Cendre. It is time to go and give the clothes you picked up to Adele.

quests.title_chs: (test)娜维娅个人线隐藏父任务孤儿$HIDDEN

quests.description_chs: 枫丹似乎正在举行一场时尚盛典，你和派蒙决定前去一探究竟…
quests.description_en: A fashion festival is being held in Fontaine. You and Paimon decide to check it out for yourselves...

quests.description_chs: 若是裙摆沾上了污渍，那它还能否登上舞台…
quests.description_en: If the hem of a skirt is stained, can it still take the stage?

quests.description_chs: 该舍弃什么，又该坚持什么？这是设计师在裁剪与编织中要给出的答案…
quests.description_en: What should one forsake, and where should one persist? The answer that the designer gives amidst cutting and knitting is...

quests.description_chs: 天气不错，抽空去白淞镇逛逛吧。
quests.description_en: It's a fine day. Yes, a fine day for a stroll around Poisson!

quests.description_chs: 与林尼他们商定了作战计划，去附近的海边见见「仆人」，想办法引开她的注意…
quests.description_en: After discussing the plan with Lyney and the others, you go to the seaside to meet The Knave in an attempt to distract her...

quests.description_chs: 听克雷薇讲述了一些壁炉之家的「秘闻」，孩子们之间的矛盾也逐渐浮出水面…
quests.description_en: After hearing some "secrets" of the House of the Hearth from Clervie, the conflicts between the children have begun to surface...

quests.description_chs: 「仆人」对林尼他们的动向一清二楚，同时提出了一个交易。这似乎是搞清真相的好机会…
quests.description_en: The Knave is well aware of the plans Lyney and the others have hatched. She proposes a deal that seems to be a good chance to get to the bottom of all this...

quests.description_chs: 枫丹廷似乎正在举办一场促销活动，非常热闹。
quests.description_en: The Court of Fontaine seems to be holding quite a lively promotion event.

quests.description_chs: 希格雯作为护士长的忙碌一日终于结束，但新的麻烦似乎已经到来…
quests.description_en: After Sigewinne finally finishes a busy day as head nurse, it seems as though a new problem has already arrived...

quests.description_chs: 在拉瓦特母亲住处意外发现的线索，成为了让调查能够继续下去的关键情报。
quests.description_en: A new clue discovered in Rawat's mother's residence seems to be a critical piece of evidence allowing the investigation to proceed.

quests.description_chs: 由一款美妆产品引发的重重谜案终于被彻底告破，希格雯协助逐影庭完成了最后的收尾工作，而她也准备好向你讲述一段往事…
quests.description_en: The many-layered mysterious case caused by cosmetics has now been fully solved, and after Sigewinne finishes helping the Marechaussee Phantom wind up the case, she prepares to tell you a story about the past...

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷的街道上，好像有两位熟悉的友人需要帮助…
quests.description_en: On the streets of the Court of Fontaine, a pair of familiar faces seem to need your help...

quests.description_chs: 「很久很久以前…」
quests.description_en: "A long, long time ago..."

quests.description_chs: 今天的故事，似乎有些不同寻常…
quests.description_en: There seems to be something unusual about today's story...

quests.description_chs: 「至此，直面长夜之危…」
quests.description_en: "Now, as we face the perils of the long night..."

quests.title_chs: (test)克洛琳德线镜像大世界入口控制$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)克洛琳德线镜像大世界入口控制$HIDDEN
奥摩斯港最近热闹非凡，似乎正在筹办什么大事…
quests.description_en: Port Ormos has been exceptionally lively lately. It looks like preparations for something big are underway...

quests.description_chs: 「奥古斯都」背后牵涉的纠葛，似乎远比你们预想的多…
quests.description_en: The disputes behind "Auguste" seem to be far more complex than you expected...

quests.description_chs: 「基里亚」的真身终于暴露…他的复仇之路也将迎来尽头。
quests.description_en: The true identity of "Kirya" has finally been exposed... His path of vengeance reaching its end.

quests.title_chs: (test)希格雯个人线隐藏父任务控制group卸载$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)希格雯个人线隐藏父任务控制group卸载$HIDDEN
娜维娅似乎在德波大饭店门口观察着什么…
quests.description_en: Navia seems to be keeping an eye on something in front of Hotel Debord...

quests.description_chs: 爱可菲如约而至，一场炽烈的料理对决即将展开…
quests.description_en: As Escoffier promised, a fiery culinary showdown is about to begin...

quests.description_chs: 风波背后，藏着冰冷的真相…
quests.description_en: Behind the turmoil, a cold truth awaits...

在悬木人部族外的山崖下偶遇了两位小朋友，他们看起来需要帮助…
quests.description_en: You encounter two kids beneath the cliffs outside the Scions of the Canopy tribe. They seem to require some help...

quests.description_chs: 来到了悬木人部族，你们再次遇见了之前帮助过的小女孩胡妮…
quests.description_en: Having arrived at the Scions of the Canopy, you meet the young girl you helped before, Huni...

quests.description_chs: 你们正打算前往特立尼达长老的住处，一位意外人士却抢先找到了你们…
quests.description_en: An unexpected encounter finds you just as you are planning to go to Elder Trinidad's dwelling...

quests.description_chs: 依照与基尼奇的交易，你们准备在部族里逛逛，为他拉扯出一些行动的空间…
quests.description_en: Following your deal with Kinich, you prepare to walk around the tribe, making room for him to maneuver...

quests.description_chs: 你们做好了准备工作，最后的回火夜也将来临了…
quests.description_en: Having finished your preparations, the last Turnfire Night approaches...

quests.title_en: Those Searching for the Mysterious Island
quests.description_chs: 在野外游历的你听到了两名游客的呼救声，你和派蒙决定施以援手…
quests.description_en: While wandering in the wilderness, you hear two tourists crying for help, and you and Paimon decide to aid them...

quests.title_en: The Legend of the Mysterious Island
quests.description_chs: 被勾起好奇心的你们决定前往流泉之众，向部族首领打听有关神秘岛的传说。
quests.description_en: Your curiosity having been piqued, you decide to head to the People of the Springs, and ask the tribal leader about the legends of the mysterious island.

quests.description_chs: 原来前往神秘岛的必要条件是一名可以互相托付的向导…
quests.description_en: It turns out that in order to reach the mysterious island, it is necessary to have a guide, one with whom mutual trust is shared...

quests.description_chs: 出发前的准备都已经完成，是时候前往与玛拉妮约定好的地点了…
quests.description_en: The predeparture preparations are complete. It's time to go to the location you and Mualani agreed on...

quests.title_en: The Riddle of Sea and Sky
quests.description_chs: 根据从山谷中拿到的线索，玛拉妮成功找到了下一个目的地，但那里似乎又有新的挑战等待着大家…
quests.description_en: Mualani successfully figures out the next destination based on the clues found in the valley, but it seems that new challenges await you there...

quests.description_chs: 你们终于确定了神秘岛的最终所在，但能否如愿完成神秘岛之旅，犹未可知…
quests.description_en: You finally determine the mysterious island's location, but whether or not you'll be able to finish your journey as you desire remains to be seen...

quests.description_chs: (test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
在「回声之子」中，「穆胡鲁宝石铺」的伊蜜似乎遇见了大麻烦…
quests.description_en: Within the Children of Echoes, Imix, from Muhuru's Gemporium, seems to have run into some major difficulties...

quests.description_chs: 与特拉佐莉的约定时间快到了，你们准备再次前去拜访，询问燃晶名刻的制作进度。
quests.description_en: The time you and Tlazolli agreed upon has almost arrived. You prepare to pay her a visit to check on the Blazegem Inscription's progress.

quests.description_chs: 希诺宁已经窥到了「燃晶名刻」的制作工艺，也推测出了特拉佐莉制作它的用意。为了保险起见，她会在完全拆解这枚「燃晶名刻」，并完全分析其内部结构后，再决定是否要帮助特拉佐莉拯救重病的妮赫佳。
quests.description_en: Xilonen has caught a glimpse of the Blazegem Inscriptions' forging process and has guessed what Tlazolli means to use them for. For safety reasons, she will dismantle this particular Inscription and analyze its inner workings first, and then decide whether to help Tlazolli save the gravely ill Nechca.

quests.description_chs: 特拉佐莉已然露出了自己的獠牙，她胁迫着「妮赫佳」前往了自己那座对外宣称已废弃的工坊。如果想要拯救那个向你们求救的孩子，就必须追上去。
quests.description_en: Tlazolli has revealed her true intentions, coercing "Nechca" into her self-proclaimed "abandoned" workshop. If you wish to save the child who sought your help, you must pursue them.

quests.description_chs: 特拉佐莉正等待着接受惩罚，妮佩卡重新获得了自己的「名字」，「燃晶名刻」也即将被销毁。噩梦与囚笼都消弭于无形，一切都结束了。希诺宁也已经将妮佩卡带回了自己的工坊，或许，她还有着下一步打算…
quests.description_en: Tlazolli awaits her punishment, Nepecha has regained her "name," and the Blazegem Inscriptions are about to be destroyed. The nightmare and entrapment have both dissipated, and it is all over. Xilonen has also brought Nepecha to her own workshop. Perhaps she still has something in mind...

quests.description_chs: 你们按照约定的时间去拜访了夏温。在她的邀请下，你们决定去见一见那位「前铸名师」特拉佐莉。
quests.description_en: You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli.

quests.description_chs: 行至图兰大火山外围，你们在路边偶遇了一位少女…
quests.description_en: As you arrive at the outskirts of the Great Volcano of Tollan, you come across a young girl by the roadside...

quests.description_chs: 在花羽会附近，似乎有位失意的人…
quests.description_en: There seems to be a crestfallen person near the Flower-Feather Clan...

quests.description_chs: 解决完失翼者的问题后，你们又赶往试炼场地…
quests.description_en: After resolving the Wingless's problem, you rush back to the trial site...

quests.description_chs: 花羽会的飞行试炼正式召开，但在试炼现场却出现了惊人的一幕…
quests.description_en: The Flower-Feather Clan's flying trials have officially started, but a shocking sight greets those at the site...

quests.description_chs: 柯娅为了救回自己的女儿奇梅而袭击了人类。如今一切线索都指向一位名叫「特帕尔」的工匠…
quests.description_en: Coya attacked humans to rescue her daughter. The clues point toward a craftsperson named Tepal...

quests.description_chs: 在远离地面的高天之上，空中工坊沉默地见证着执念的堆积与毁灭…
quests.description_en: In the distant skies, far from the surface, the airborne workshop bears silent witness to the amassing and annihilation of obsession...

quests.title_en: Calling from the Masters of the Night-Wind
quests.description_chs: 偶遇了一只幼年暝视龙之后，某种神秘的存在引导你进入烟谜主的驻地…
quests.description_en: After happening across a baby Iktomisaurus, a mysterious presence guides you into the Masters of the Night-Wind's settlement...

quests.description_chs: 你接受了烟谜主首领的嘱托，决心完成自己被赋予的使命…
quests.description_en: You accept the Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind's commission, and are determined to complete the task that you have been entrusted with...

quests.title_en: A Commission Catches You in Natlan
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙在烟谜主部族驻地偶遇了一支愚人众小队，并结识了他们的雇主，一份从枫丹追来的委托就此找上了你…
quests.description_en: You and Paimon bump into a squad of Fatui at the Masters of the Night-Wind, and you meet their employer. Thus does a commission from Fontaine find its way to you...

quests.description_chs: 在你的诚恳请求下，茜特菈莉终于答应出山帮忙。但令你意外的是，黑曜石奶奶的名号带来的似乎不只是助力…
quests.description_en: After you sincerely beseech her, Citlali finally agrees to help. But to your surprise, Granny Itztli's name does not merely bring with it assistance...

quests.description_chs: 在茜特菈莉的协助下，你们成功找到了七彩之战的遗址。然而，等待你们揭开的真相似乎远比预想中要多…
quests.description_en: With Citlali's assistance, you find the ruins left behind by the Battle of Seven Colors. However, the truth that awaits your discovery is far beyond your expectations...

quests.description_chs: 妥善解决事件后，茜特菈莉邀你前往她的住所，之前困惑她的那个问题似乎终于有了答案…
quests.description_en: After all has been settled, Citlali invites you to her dwelling. It seems she's found an answer to the question that was troubling her before...

quests.description_chs: 转眼间就到了「豪宴热斗」开始的日子，你们决定前往挑战。
quests.description_en: The fateful day of the Epic Feast Showdown has arrived, and you hunger for the taste of challenge.

quests.description_chs: 下定决心之后，你们和瓦雷莎一起行动起来，调查「蕈之贤主」的真实身份与它的目的。
quests.description_en: With hearts as one, you and Varesa set out to investigate the true identity and intentions of the Sage-Lord of Fungi.

quests.description_chs: 终于寻到了关键的材料，接下来就是烹饪蘑菇，看看会发生什么…
quests.description_en: You've finally found some key materials. All that's left is to cook the mushroom and see what happens...

quests.description_chs: 瓦雷莎陪同你们来到她的家园「沃陆之邦」，打算为你们介绍这里的风土人情。
quests.description_en: Varesa accompanies you to her home, the Collective of Plenty, to introduce you to the local customs.

quests.description_chs: 在旅行中寻常的一天，身体却莫名地感到不适…
quests.description_en: On an otherwise ordinary day on the road, you suddenly feel a strange discomfort...

quests.description_chs: 丝柯克答应帮忙调查神秘人的下落。在此期间，努力提升自身的实力吧。
quests.description_en: Skirk agrees to help investigate the mysterious person's whereabouts. In the meantime, you should work on improving your strength.

quests.description_chs: 特训结束，丝柯克也定位到了幕后真凶所在之处，小心地前进吧。
quests.description_en: Your training is over and Skirk has located the culprit behind the scenes. Proceed with caution.

quests.description_chs: 丝柯克的力量恢复得很快。但她似乎对此仍不满意，认为身体出了什么问题，想要通过冥想来解决。与她约定两天后再次见面，希望一切顺利…
quests.description_en: Skirk's strength is returning quickly but she still doesn't seem to be satisfied. She thinks something's wrong with her body and hopes to solve her problems through meditation. You arrange to see her in a couple of days. Hopefully, everything works out as planned...

quests.description_chs: 重新醒来后，与自身和解的丝柯克重新取回了力量。该给幕后真凶一点教训了。
quests.description_en: After reconciling with herself, Skirk awakens once more and reclaims her full powers. It's time to teach the culprit a lesson.

quests.title_chs: 出发！无忧无虑的度假之旅？
quests.description_chs: 夏日再临，你与派蒙来到了特诺奇兹托克，准备迎接一场无忧无虑的度假之旅…
quests.description_en: As summer blooms once more, you and Paimon arrive in Tenochtzitoc and prepare yourselves for a carefree vacation...

quests.description_chs: 你听班尼特说「彩彩崖」有着一处名为「沫彩花海」的胜地…
quests.description_en: Bennett told you about a scenic spot called "Foamflower Fields" at Colorfall Cliffs...

quests.description_chs: 你听恰斯卡说「刺梨岩」有些具备对抗性质的的挑战项目…
quests.description_en: Chasca told you about some head-to-head challenges at Guiztli Ridge...

quests.description_chs: 你听玛拉妮说「浪浪湾」有着丰富的水上项目…
quests.description_en: Mualani told you about the many aquatic attractions on offer at Wavey Bay...

quests.title_chs: 畅玩！举目之处皆为画布！
quests.description_chs: 暖融融的阳光照耀后背，催促你们再次出发。那还等什么呢？撒开脚丫，与同伴们在悠悠度假村尽情游玩吧！
quests.description_en: The warm sunlight shines on your back, urging you to set off once again. Well, what are you waiting for? Stretch your legs and enjoy the Easybreeze Holiday Resort with all your friends!

quests.title_en: The Surprise That Awaits Us All!
quests.description_chs: 悠悠纪念册填满了你与大家共度的欢乐时光，终于，兑奖的时间到了…
quests.description_en: The Easybreeze Album is filled with the happy memories of your time spent with everyone. At last, the time has come for prizes to be presented...

quests.title_en: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!
quests.description_chs: 直到太阳又一次升起…
quests.description_en: Until the sun rises once more...

quests.title_en: A Gift From the Sea Spirits
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹水色温柔的海边，你与派蒙遇到了一位需要帮助的美露莘…
quests.description_en: By the gentle shores of Fontaine, you and Paimon meet a Melusine who needs your help...

quests.description_chs: 在外游历的你忽然收到了艾莉丝的邀请，她希望你和派蒙能帮助杜林完成一件事，而这件事正好与杜林的母亲——那位已经逝世的魔女M有关…
quests.description_en: While traveling, you receive a sudden invitation from Alice. She hopes you and Paimon can help Durin fulfill a wish — one connected to his late mother, "M"...

quests.description_chs: 书中的故事所描述的似乎是杜林的经历，你和杜林都很好奇这个故事还有什么等待补全的地方。于是你们再次进入了书中的世界，寻找那些尚未被揭示的秘密…
quests.description_en: The story in the book seems to describe Durin's experiences. Curious about what remains untold, you and Durin step back into its pages to uncover the missing parts of his story.

quests.description_chs: 书中的故事告诉你们，杜林背负着来自一个预言的诅咒。但你想起了在希穆兰卡用祝福帮助杜林战胜诅咒的往事，在书中重现这件往事，或许就是补全这个故事的办法…
quests.description_en: The book reveals that Durin is bound by a curse born of prophecy. You recall how a blessing once helped him overcome it in Simulanka — maybe reliving that moment will complete the story...

quests.description_chs: 杜林为何会被他人遗忘？对于如何解答这个问题，你和派蒙都没有头绪。这时，魔法书又给出了新的提示——原来魔女M书写的故事并没有在希穆兰卡迎来结局，新的篇章似乎指向了杜林刚刚来到这个世界时落脚的地方…
quests.description_en: Why do people start to forget Durin? You and Paimon have no clue. Just then, the magic book offers another hint — M's story does not end in Simulanka. And the next chapter seems to lead to where Durin first set foot in this world...

quests.description_chs: 根据从上一个篇章中获得的线索，你们前往蒙德雪山寻找阿贝多。杜林身上的谜团似乎都将在这里获得解答，但「命运」准备的难题也已经等候多时…
quests.description_en: Following the clues from the previous chapter, you head to Dragonspine to find Albedo. It seems the mysteries around Durin are about to be revealed, but the trials prepared by "fate" are waiting for you as well...

quests.description_chs: 魔法书还没有给出后续篇章的提示，你决定休息一段时间再去找杜林…
quests.description_en: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...

quests.description_chs: 魔法书还没有给出后续篇章的提示，你决定休息一段时间再去找杜林…
quests.description_en: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...

quests.description_chs: 杜林遭遇的意外打乱了你们原先的计划，你们不得不先等待杜林醒来…
quests.description_en: Durin's unexpected accident disrupts your original plans, and you have no choice but to wait for him to wake up...

quests.description_chs: 你们已经找到了关键的线索，但在阿贝多回来之前，你们仍旧无从得知完整的答案…
quests.description_en: You find an important clue, but until Albedo returns, the full truth remains out of reach...

quests.description_chs: 在众人的奋战之下，北方的深渊灾厄似乎已经平定…\n凯旋之期，已在近前。
quests.description_en: Through everyone's united efforts, the Abyssal calamity in the north seems to have been quelled...\nThe day of triumph draws near.

quests.description_chs: 水占盘里倒映出未来的幻景，狼灵之中寄宿着往昔的追忆…\n命运之数，变幻无常。
quests.description_en: The scryglass reflects visions of the future, the wolf spirit harbors memories of the past...\nThe threads of fate are ever-changing.

quests.description_chs: 来时纵有千军万马，末路亦不免孤军奋战…\n孤独之人，请上前来。
quests.description_en: Even if you had an army of ten thousand men, in the end, you must face this fight alone...\nStep forward... lonely warrior.

quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱度过了一段安宁祥和的时光，去问问凯瑟琳最近有没有什么值得注意的事情吧。
quests.description_en: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.

quests.description_chs: 顺利完成海选赛后，莉奈娅提出去斯佩兰扎好好庆祝一下…
quests.description_en: Having completed the qualifiers successfully, Linnea suggests going to Speranza to celebrate properly...

quests.description_chs: 梦醒之后，莉奈娅决定再次去找刻莱诺，问清楚一切的真相。
quests.description_en: After waking from her dream, Linnea decides to seek Celaeno out once more and uncover the whole truth.
